listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Karl Eau de Toilette Spray Hamburg Alster 60 ml
listings.description: The "Karl Lagerfeld" brand continues to enjoy great popularity and constant demand. It stands for exclusive cosmetic products and fashion. Karl Otto Lagerfeld was born in Hamburg in 1933, but lived and worked mainly in Paris. Lagerfeld developed his own style, which still characterises the brand today. The career of the famous fashion designer developed continuously. It began in the mid-1950s, when Karl Lagerfeld started working for famous names in the fashion world. He also worked as a costume designer and photographer. Born in Hamburg, he had a formative influence on fashion. His clear signature was also expressed in the fragrances he created for men and women. His white powdered plait, Kent collar and sunglasses were his very personal trademarks. Karl Hamburg Alster - a striking eau de toilette spray Karl Hamburg Alster is the new eau de toilette spray for the style-conscious gentleman who knows what he wants. This fragrance contains a combination of mint and mandarin flavours in the top note. The heart note of Karl Hamburg Alster is restrained and elegant with the scent of freesia, sage and lavender. The base note is dark and mysterious with notes of moss, wood and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Les Parfums Matières Eau de Toilette Spray Bois d'Ambre 50 ml
listings.description: Each and every one of us probably has the desire to appear attractive and appealing to our fellow human beings. This is confirmed by a quote from Karl Lagerfeld: "I think perfume must always have something intensely sensual about it. You don't just wear a perfume to smell nice, but to feel beautiful and desirable." The jack-of-all-trades Lagerfeld has not only created exclusive fashion, but also exquisite fragrances for men and women. These include the men's fragrance Les Parfums Matières - Eau de Toilette Spray Bois d'Ambre . Les Parfums Matières has transformed this aromatic fragrance into a new perfume line. Full of charm, the sensual fragrance envelops its wearer. The Karl Lagerfeld Eau de Toilette Spray Bois d'Ambre combines a high-contrast potpourri of warm, powerful woody tones and fresh fruity notes. Orange, bergamot and plum harmonise in the top note. The heart note combines the fruity, sparkling aromas of clary sage, cedarwood and gardenia. The creamy base note is characterised by amber, tonka bean and gujac wood. They give the fragrance an intense finish. The Karl Lagerfeld Eau de Toilette Spray Bois d'Ambre by Les Parfums Matières is offered for sale in a 100 ml pump flacon. With its stylish and functional design, the bottle is sure to suit the tastes of most men.

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Les Parfums Matières Eau de Parfum Spray Fleur de Thé 50 ml
listings.description: With the Les Parfums Matières line, Karl Lagerfeld has dedicated himself to reinterpreting the essential fragrance notes of haute parfumerie. Fleur de Thé Eau de Parfum Spray focuses on a harmonious combination of citrus freshness and floral elements. The opening is sparkling with an interplay of mandarin, lemon and neroli. These bright nuances lead into a heart characterised by the eponymous note of green tea. The central tea accord is complemented by floral facets of Sambac jasmine and camellia blossom, which lend the composition an elegant depth. The base note forms a gentle contrast to the initial freshness, with light woods, musk and amber providing a warm finish. Visually, the transparent glass bottle with its turquoise-coloured liquid underlines the clear character of the fragrance. The design remains minimalist and timeless. Fragrance: Floral and citrus composition with a fresh character. Head note: Sparkling accords of mandarin, lemon and neroli. Heart note: Green tea combined with Sambac jasmine and camellia blossom. Base note: Warm finish with light woods, musk and amber. Design: Transparent glass bottle with turquoise-coloured liquid.

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Karl Eau de Toilette Spray Vienna Opéra 60 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the city of Vienna, Karl Lagerfeld presents a charming men's fragrance with woody and spicy notes . The potpourri from the Karl collection invites you to take a trip to the Vienna Opera House, which is exactly why it bears this name: Vienna Opéra! The eau de toilette spray entices you to take a sensual break from everyday life, even on occasions other than an event at the theatre. Opera feelings like in Vienna Let fragrances by Karl Lagerfeld whisk you away to distant worlds; this time to the vibrant capital of Austria. Vienna is characterised by pure elegance and artistic flair . The Vienna Opéra fragrance by Karl Lagerfeld skilfully captures both. The fragrance from the Karl collection opens with a mix of fruity grapefruit, spicy basil and black pepper that tickles the nose. The seductive art of the men's fragrance then culminates in the heart note of gentle sage, garnished with lavender and a hint of apple. In the base, warm scents such as vetiver, sandalwood and cedarwood bring you back to the here and now and provide a classic finish to the Vienna Opéra Eau de Toilette Spray. Become a star in your life with just a few spritzes of the eau de toilette spray!

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Les Parfums Matières Eau de Parfum Spray Fleur de Pivoine 50 ml
listings.description: As part of the Les Parfums Matières collection, Karl Lagerfeld interprets the peony as the central element of a floral-fruity composition with Fleur de Pivoine. The Eau de Parfum Spray opens with a clear top note that combines the sparkling freshness of mandarin with the fine acidity of redcurrant and green accords. This invigorating start flows smoothly into a velvety heart that focuses on the eponymous blossom. A bouquet of peony, jasmine and lily of the valley creates a delicate, floral depth that always remains transparent and light. To give the fragrance stability and warmth, a combination of white cedar and amber was chosen for the base, which gently rounds off and grounds the floral notes. The design of the bottle also reflects the characteristics of the fragrance: The glass is translucent, revealing the pink liquid inside, while the transparent cap features a colour-coordinated insert. Packaged in a white case with a leather look, the product emphasises a modern, purist aesthetic that focuses on the essentials. Fragrance family: Floral-fruity with an accentuated peony note Top note: Combination of mandarin, redcurrant and green notes Heart note: Floral bouquet of peony, jasmine and lily of the valley Base note: Warm finish with white cedar and amber Design: Translucent bottle with pink-coloured liquid and matching lid insert

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Les Parfums Matières Eau de Toilette Spray Bois de Cyprès 50 ml
listings.description: The Karl Lagerfeld Bois de Cyprès Eau de Toilette Spray comes from the versatile Les Parfums Matières collection. It is a charming men's fragrance that delights as a perfume with spicy and fruity elements . There is also a hint of flowers, which lends a certain lightness to the whole. Scented highlights: Fruits, spices and more Welcome the intense top note of the Bois de Cyprès Eau de Toilette spray by Karl Lagerfeld and discover accords such as mandarin and lemon that put you in a good mood. Add to this the pleasant spiciness of cardamom; slightly exotic and a perfect match for the fruity duo. The heart note is also based on three accords. It blends mint with cypress and lavender, which creates a floral but never overpowering character. In the base, the Karl Lagerfeld brand relies on classic men's fragrances such as vetiver, sage and warm cashmere wood to create a sensual, masculine finish. Look forward to wonderful moments and memorable appearances with your perfume from the Les Parfums Matières collection! Use the Bois de Cyprès Eau de Toilette Spray as your future striking everyday companion or choose it deliberately for the special events in your life!

Elizabeth Arden Green Tea Eau de Toilette Spray Scent 30 ml
listings.description: The Green Tea Eau Parfumée Scent Spray by Elizabeth Arden is a composition that has been appreciated for its refreshing and light nature since its launch in 1999. Created by perfumer Francis Kurkdjian, this fragrance exudes an aura of carefree energy. It opens with a sparkling wave of citrus notes such as bergamot, lemon and orange peel, accompanied by fruity rhubarb and a hint of caraway. At the heart of the composition is the eponymous green tea, which blends harmoniously with cool peppermint and delicate jasmine. Subtle accents of fennel, clove and celery spices lend the fragrance an interesting complexity. The finish is gentle and persistent with a base of warm amber, earthy oakmoss and a subtle hint of musk. A light and sparkling fragrance for women. Combines aromatic notes of green tea with fresh citrus accords. Created in 1999 by perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. A base of amber, oakmoss and musk provides a gentle finish.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The White Tea Eau de Parfum by Elizabeth Arden is a finely crafted composition that combines floral freshness with woody warmth. It opens with sparkling notes of Italian mandarin and clary sage, which are given a clear lightness by a maritime touch. At the heart of the creation is a present white tea accord that blends harmoniously with the richness of mate absolute, delicate jasmine petals and a subtle rose water. The base of sun-dried tonka bean, a trio of musks and warm amberwood gives the fragrance a gentle depth and ensures a long-lasting, pleasant finish. Developed using VivaScentz™ technology, the individual notes are brought into a particularly balanced relationship. With its elegant and unobtrusive character, this fragrance proves to be a versatile companion for a wide variety of occasions. The minimalist, linear design of the bottle with its satin finish and gold-coloured cap emphasises the pure character of the perfume. Fragrance: floral, woody, fresh Heart notes: White tea accord, mate absolute, jasmine Special features: 100% vegan formula with 66.5% organic ingredients Character: Elegant, understated and versatile

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Sunflowers Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: A fragrance that captures the lightness of a summer's day - that's Sunflowers by Elizabeth Arden. This eau de toilette opens with a composition of fresh notes of bergamot, melon and peach. A floral bouquet unfolds in the heart, harmoniously combining jasmine and cyclamen. The base rounds off the fragrance experience with warm accords of sandalwood and moss, giving it a gentle depth. The result is a balanced, floral-fruity fragrance that feels pleasant on the skin and supports a positive aura. The simple, transparent bottle with the engraved sunflower reflects the clear and carefree character of the fragrance. Sunflowers is a timeless companion for everyday wear. Fragrance family: Floral-fruity Head note: bergamot, melon, peach Heart note: jasmine, cyclamen Base note: sandalwood, moss

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The White Tea Eau de Toilette Spray by Elizabeth Arden is a woody-floral composition that is characterised by its clear yet multi-layered elegance. It opens with an invigorating blend of sparkling Italian mandarin and the herbal essence of clary sage. A sensual sea breeze accord and the green note of Japanese white fern give the top note a special freshness. At the heart of the fragrance, the eponymous white tea extract unfolds, accompanied by mate absolute from Paraguay and a graceful accord of white iris. Facets of Turkish rose and the warm, nutty nuance of paradise nut add a subtle depth. The base note anchors the composition with a warm and velvety melange. Madras wood, ambrette seed and Venezuelan tonka bean combine with Ambermax® and a harmonious musk triad to create a long-lasting finish. Fragrance direction: woody-floral Head note: Italian mandarin and sea breeze accord Heart note: White tea extract and white iris Base: Warm wood, musk and amber notes

listings.description: Since its launch in 1989, Red Door by Elizabeth Arden has been a timeless fragrance classic that epitomises elegance and sensuality. The composition is an opulent bouquet made up of a variety of rare and precious flowers. It opens with a fruity-floral blend of peach, plum and aniseed, accompanied by delicate violets, rose and orange blossom. At the heart of the fragrance, the full floral splendour unfolds with notes of freesia, jasmine, lily of the valley, orchid and ylang-ylang, rounded off with a hint of honey. The base note provides a long-lasting and warm finish, in which sandalwood, cedar and vetiver meet the soft nuances of musk, amber and oakmoss. This complex and expressive fragrance is particularly suitable for the cooler seasons and emphasises the feminine charisma of its wearer. A timelessly elegant fragrance classic since 1989 Opulent, floral composition with a heart note of rare flowers Warm and long-lasting finish with sandalwood, musk and honey Especially suitable for the cooler months of the year

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Toilette Spray Gingerlily 30 ml
listings.description: The Elizabeth Arden White Tea Ginger Lily Eau de Toilette Spray combines floral warmth with a spicy dynamic to create a multi-layered composition. The top note opens with an invigorating blend of sparkling bitter orange, bergamot and mandarin, which is complemented by the subtle nuances of neroli. At the centre of the creation is the eponymous ginger lily blossom, which, together with white ginger root and delicate violet leaves, develops a fresh yet floral character. These lively accords merge gently into a harmonious base characterised by white cedarwood, tonka bean and mate absolute. Musk lends the fragrance profile an earthy depth and provides a warm finish. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, rectangular glass bottle whose clean lines are emphasised by a white, square cap and a golden ring. The red lettering "GINGER LILY" on the front adds a visual accent to the transparent glass. Due to its concentration as an eau de toilette, the spray is ideal for everyday use as it has a pleasant presence without being heavy. The formulation makes partial use of modern approaches and utilises ingredients that enable a balanced fragrance experience. Customised fragrances can also be created by layering the spray with other fragrances from the White Tea collection as desired. Fragrance family: Warm spicy and floral notes with musky accents. Main ingredients: Bitter orange, ginger lily blossom, white cedarwood and tonka bean. Design: Transparent, rectangular glass bottle with white cap and gold ring. Application: Suitable as a light eau de toilette for everyday wear and can be combined with other fragrances in the collection.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Toilette Spray Wild Rose 30 ml
listings.description: The name Elizabeth Arden stands for high-quality and luxurious cosmetics that are popular all over the world. Her name was Florence Nightingale Graham and she was the daughter of Scottish-English immigrants. She spent her youth in poor circumstances in the Canadian province of Ontario. She moved to New York in 1908 and opened her beauty parlour on Fifth Avenue with a business partner in 1910, where she became very successful. Initially she sold toners and creams, which she soon had created by the company's own chemists. She developed her own range of products. As a result, her customer base and the popularity of her products continued to grow. After Elizabeth Arden's death in 1966, the company was initially sold to several groups. Since 2003, the Elizabeth Arden Group has belonged to FFI Fragrances, a US company that now operates under the name Elizabeth Arden Inc. The White Tea Wild Rose fragrance is available as an eau de toilette spray The White Tea Wild Rose eau de toilette spray is available in a practical fragrance diffuser. Enjoy these wonderful scents of white tea and wild rose. A subtle note of madras wood, ambrette seed absolute and musk lend the White Tea Wild Rose Eau de Toilette Spray its subtle sensuality. Let this incredibly feminine fragrance work its magic on your senses.

listings.description: The Narciso Rodriguez for her Eau de Parfum Spray Intense Pure Musc Blanc presents itself as a modern interpretation of classic chypre fragrances with a clear and pure aesthetic. At the centre of this composition is an intense musk accord, which forms the heart of the fragrance and can create a soft, enveloping presence. This base is complemented by bright, floral notes, with jasmine providing a radiant accent in the top note. A special clean accord emphasises the clean character of the perfume and lends it a certain lightness. The base note rounds off the olfactory experience with warm nuances of cedarwood and vanilla, which can lend the fragrance depth and longevity. With its milky white glass and frosted cap, the bottle reflects the purity of the fragrance composition and picks up on architectural lines. The vegan formula was developed by perfumer Sonia Constant and can also be layered with other fragrances in the line to emphasise individual facets. listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez NARCISO Eau de Parfum Spray Poudrée 30 ml
listings.description: The NARCISOPoudrée Eau de Parfum Spray by Narciso Rodriguez is a tribute to feminine elegance. As part of the iconic NARCISO collection, the perfume has a lasting, finely tuned presence. The minimalist design of the bottle emphasises the timeless character of the creation with its clean lines. Presented in a minimalist bottle with clean lines.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez for her Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The for her Eau de Parfum Spray by Narciso Rodriguez is an elegant fragrance composition that unfolds around a warm heart of musk. As a more intense interpretation of the original eau de toilette, this fragrance was created in 2004 by the renowned perfumers Christine Nagel and Francis Kurkdjian. The central musky note is caressed by delicate floral accents of rose and the fruity sweetness of peach. This harmonious combination lends the perfume a graceful lightness and feminine radiance. In the base, warm notes of amber and earthy patchouli ensure a long-lasting depth and unforgettable sillage. The fragrance family can be described as floral, with the characteristic musky accord always taking centre stage and giving the perfume its modern yet timeless signature. A floral fragrance with a central, warm musk accord. Combines floral notes of rose with peach, amber and patchouli. A more intense composition than the original eau de toilette. Created by perfumers Christine Nagel and Francis Kurkdjian.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml

Created by Olivier Cresp, this fragrance stands for an understated elegance that radiates creativity and a sense of style. As the fragrance progresses, a multi-layered heart unfolds, combining classic floral accords of white jasmine, rose and violet with the delicate nuances of hibiscus and heliotrope to create a harmonious bouquet. The complex base note, which combines the woody depth of sandalwood and cedarwood with incense, labdanum and a velvety suede accord and musk, ensures a long-lasting and warm finish. The design of the bottle picks up on this clear line visually: A slender, rectangular glass body with rounded corners and pale yellow contents is topped by a cylindrical cap with a textured, gold-coloured surface. On the front, the characteristic gold-coloured crocodile logo is emblazoned on a vertical label, discreetly underlining the affiliation with the brand. Created by Olivier Cresp, this fragrance stands for an understated elegance that radiates creativity and a sense of style. Fragrance family: Floral-woody with musky nuances Top notes: Combination of freesia, black pepper and green apple Base: Warm accords of sandalwood, incense and suede Design: Elegant glass bottle with gold-coloured accents and crocodile logo

listings.description: The Lacoste L.12.12 Noir Eau de Toilette Spray is a men's fragrance inspired by the brand's iconic polo shirt. The simple, black bottle echoes the design of the polo shirt and features an embroidered crocodile emblem. listings.rawTitle: KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO Eau de Parfum Spray refillable / 15 ml
listings.description: The FLOWER BY KENZO Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition that captures the poetry of a single flower in the urban world. The fragrance opens with the subtle spiciness of pink pepper, which arouses curiosity about the heart of the creation. There, a delicate bouquet unfolds, dominated by the noble Damask rose, which gives the perfume its unmistakably floral and slightly powdery character. In the base, sensual vanilla, soft white musk and a hint of incense combine to create a warm and deep melody on the skin. This timeless fragrance is characterised by its subtle but present nature and is suitable as a companion for every day and every season. The slim, clear bottle, reminiscent of a poppy stem, emphasises the delicate elegance of the composition. A timeless, floral-powdery fragrance with a feminine allure. Composition of pink pepper, damask rose, vanilla and white musk. Decent intensity and good longevity for everyday use. Presented in an iconic bottle inspired by the poppy flower.

listings.rawTitle: KENZO Kenzo Homme Eau de Parfum Spray 60 ml
listings.description: The KENZO HOMME Eau de Parfum Spray by perfumer Quentin Bisch is a woody-maritime fragrance composition. At the centre of the fragrance, a maritime accord combines with the warmth of leather and the earthy depth of patchouli to create a multi-faceted and expressive character. The bottle itself makes a clear statement: inspired by the vertical strength of bamboo, it comes in deep black with bluish nuances. The design of the cap is reminiscent of the diagonal cut of a katana. The concept also takes sustainable aspects into account. The bottle is made from 15% recycled glass and the weight of the glass has been reduced by 23% to allow for 10 ml more perfume in the 110 ml size. The cap saves 34% plastic, while the outer packaging is made from untreated kraft cardboard and FSC®-certified paper. Scent direction: woody-maritime Fragrance notes: Maritime accord, leather, patchouli Design: Bamboo-inspired bottle with a katana-cut cap Sustainability: bottle made from recycled glass and packaging from responsible sources

listings.rawTitle: KENZO Kenzo Jungle Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: KENZO JUNGLE Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition by master perfumer Dominique Ropion that is characterised by an unmistakable, spicy-amber character. The fragrance opens with a lively top note of cardamom, clove and a hint of mandarin. An opulent bouquet unfolds in the heart, in which the exotic sweetness of mango meets floral notes of ylang-ylang, gardenia and heliotrope, rounded off by a fascinating nuance of liquorice and vanilla flower. The base note anchors the composition with the warm depth of vanilla, amber and earthy patchouli. listings.rawTitle: KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO Eau de Parfum Spray Le Rouge 30 ml
listings.description: LE ROUGE FLOWER Eau de Parfum by KENZO reinterprets the iconic FLOWER signature in a powerful and sensual way. This floral-gourmand fragrance for women stands for intensity, depth and emotional radiance and is aimed at women who embody strength and elegance in equal measure. The opening is clear and pure: delicate musk meets fine rice vapour and gives the fragrance a modern, almost floating lightness. At the heart, the Damask rose unfolds in a more intense, multi-faceted form that redefines floral sensuality. The base seduces with a warm, enveloping composition of vanilla and sandalwood, enhanced by Amberever®, a powerful woody molecule that gives the fragrance depth and a long-lasting presence. As an olfactory interpretation of the colour red, LE ROUGE FLOWER combines vibrant energy with the Japanese DNA of the Maison KENZO and at the same time stands for a conscious commitment to sustainability. Intense floral-gourmand fragrance for women Pure opening of musk and rice vapour Powerful damask rose with new depth Warm base of vanilla, sandalwood and Amberever® Fragrance with a high proportion of ingredients of natural origin

listings.rawTitle: KENZO L'EAU KENZO Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: L'EAU KENZO is a tribute to the vitality and purity of water, captured in an eau de toilette that has been inspiring since 1996. The fragrance opens with an invigorating composition of fresh mint, mandarin and a subtle hint of pink pepper. At the centre of the creation is the delicate lotus blossom, whose aquatic facets are complemented by juicy peach and give the fragrance its characteristic lightness. A base of white musk and cedar wood provides a gentle and clear finish. The composition leaves an unobtrusive, fresh impression that is reminiscent of the feeling after a refreshing shower and is particularly suitable for the day and the spring and summer months. The commitment to nature is also reflected in the minimalist bottle, which is made from recycled glass and presented in packaging made from sustainable materials. listings.description: The KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO Ikebana Eau de Parfum Spray is an olfactory homage to Kenzo Takada's love of flowers and the art of living. Inspired by the Japanese art of flower arranging, Ikebana, a floral-woody composition created by perfumers Alexandra Monet and Alberto Morillas unfolds. At the centre of the fragrance is a balance of three distinctive notes: It opens with the unique aroma of sobacha tea, followed by the delicate sakura cherry blossom, enhanced by Indian tuberose absolute. A warm base of Australian sandalwood, cedarwood and vetiver gives the fragrance a lasting depth. Made in France, the eau de parfum consists of around 90% ingredients of natural origin. The bottle, which is reminiscent of a Japanese kakemono, emphasises the brand's conscious approach through the use of recycled materials and a recyclable cap. listings.description: The KENZO HOMME Indigo Eau de Parfum Spray is a men's fragrance composition inspired by the power of nature. The base note anchors the composition with a warm leather accord, which is characterised by smoky nuances and the depth of Akigala wood, sandalwood and vetiver. The alcohol used comes from French farms that are switching to regenerative agriculture. The design of the bottle picks up on this closeness to nature: The opaque, indigo blue lacquer with a matt texture is reminiscent of a bamboo cane, while the bevelled cap is inspired by the shape of a katana samurai sword. listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Eau de Toilette Spray Mirto di Panarea 50 ml
listings.description: Panarea: The smallest and oldest Aeolian island radiates peace and tranquillity. Fragmented bays, bordered by luminous olive groves, are lapped by emerald-green waters. The myrtle plant grows among wild pistachios, agaves and broom. Even the goddess Venus wanted to adorn herself with a myrtle wreath when she was chosen by Paride. Myrtle has always symbolised beauty and love, and in the Middle Ages its fragrance was known as "angel's water". The fragrance of Mirto di Panarea caresses the skin and soul with a pleasant, intensely regenerating breeze from the Italian Mediterranean. The unmistakable scent of myrtle spreads slowly and pleasantly. The fragrance opens with an elegant, sparkling top note, characterised by citrus accents such as Calabrian lemon and sweet orange. It is emphasised by the simple and unadulterated aroma of basil. The heart note unfolds a blossoming core of velvet and elegance, where accents of jasmine, rose and lilac meet a light sea breeze and traces of blackcurrant. A feeling of deep well-being that reaches its full perfection in the woody base note with the aromatic scents of wild pistachio and juniper as well as cedarwood and amber.

listings.description: The Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum Spray from the Signatures Of The Sun fragrance line by Acqua di Parma combines exquisite spices with warm woody and appealing oriental fragrance accords. With spirited pepper and elegant agarwood The Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum Spray is a self-confident fragrance for men, based on a slightly tart base, which is livened up by sparkling fruity nuances in the top note. An exquisite blend of spices rounds off the fragrance, which has been available since 2021, and gives it temperament. Upon application, Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum Spray initially envelops you in an invigorating blend of tangy bergamot and seductive raspberries, which combine with an elegant rose nuance. The heart note consists of pink pepper , cloves and cinnamon and gives the creation strength and an excitingly passionate tone. The base has a gentle and calming effect: warm agarwood meets creamy ladan resin and oriental patchouli, which has a pleasantly rough and masculine effect.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Sandalo 50 ml
listings.description: Sandalo is a fresh and woody eau de parfum spray from the exclusive Milanese boutique Acqua di Parma. Launched in 2016, the unisex fragrance is characterised by a harmonious composition full of elegance and freshness . Very precious and rare sandalwood from India, which is characterised by the particular richness and intensity of its aromas, is the olfactory theme of this perfume. The citrus notes typical of the Colonia creation create a fascinating arc of tension. Timeless elegance in a trendy style Acqua di Parma Sandalo opens sparklingly fresh with a wide range of citrusy notes. The multi-faceted fragrance of petit grain, the oil from the leaves of the bitter orange, is joined by sparkling notes of subtly tart bergamot, ripe lemon and juicy orange. In the heart note, Acqua di Parma Sandalo Eau de Parfum Spray presents an irresistible play of colours and aromas. The intense, unmistakable scent of lavender from Provence is given additional character and depth by spicy, creamy accents of cardamom. In the base of the fragrance, the precious sandalwood impressively brings its elegance to the fore. Delicious, opulent tonka bean and soft ambergris bring this enchanting eau de parfum spray to an impressive close with a hint of irresistible sensuality. A unisex perfume that fascinates with its sophisticated composition and the intensity of its notes.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Oud 50 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Oud is a new fragrance from Acqua di Parma. Launched in 2019, the Eau de Parfum Spray is a variation of Colonia Oud, which has been available since 2012 and is an Eau de Cologne Concentrée. Of course, both woody-spicy fragrances are men's fragrances, but some women also like to wear them. The eau de parfum spray from Acqua di Parma is naturally significantly stronger in its presence and has enormous longevity and sillage, just as you would expect from an eau de parfum spray from the traditional Milanese brand. A fragrance that definitely stands out The top note of Acqua di Parma perfume begins with Italian orange and Calabrian bergamot. It gives way to heart notes of Russian coriander, Haitian amyris and, of course, precious oud. In the almost opulent base, the flavours of Atlas cedar meet Indonesian patchouli, fine sandalwood and musk. The result is a noble masculine composition that is particularly suitable for wearing on cooler days, but can also be worn on summer evenings. Acqua di Parma Oud is a fragrance that flatters the modern man of today. This is because the fragrance has a clear but not overpowering presence.

Acqua di Parma Ginepro di Sardegna Eau de toilette spray 30 ml
listings.description: The eau de toilette spray Ginepro di Sardegna comes from the product repertoire of the brand Acqua di Parma. The perfume is designed as a unisex fragrance and emits a touch of freshness, which lasts for the whole day. The special thing about the eau de toilette spray is that it reflects the Mediterranean feeling of the coast of Sardinia. The fragrance is dynamic and light: Juniper berry essences imitate warm rays of the sun and a salty sea breeze. It is simply a masterful fragrance composition, which is captivating with its versatile aromatic notes. A breath-taking fragrance The perfume Ginepro di Sardegna is based on the essences of juniper berries, bergamot and various spices. The heart note is based on cypress and sage. Cedar and Virginia create a harmonious balance of contrasts, which creates a lot of excitement and variation. Only one spray spreads the feeling of the Mediterranean attitude to life, which is a huge success from an olfactory point of view. The elegance and versatility of the Acqua di Parma fragrances still remains unrivalled. Let yourself be covered by a true everyday companion, which guarantees elegance and style in any situation!

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Iris Nobile Eau de parfum spray 50 ml
listings.description: The embodiment of feminine Italian elegance and a sensual new interpretation of the iris - that’s Iris Nobile. A feminine fragrance through and through from the house of Acqua di Parma, it was exclusively created for the confident woman with elegance and style. The structure of the top note distinguishes itself with the tingling and fresh notes: Bergamot from Calabria, the typical component of the Chypré scent chord, mandarin, star aniseed and an absolute from orange water. The extraordinarily feminine heart note becomes voluminous and sophisticated with the elegant Florentine iris, ylang-ylang, caraway and peach. The base note, which consists of oak tree musk, cupid crystals, Madagascar vanilla and patchouli adds fascination and warmth.

Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Quercia 50 ml
listings.description: The Colonia Quercia fragrance dates back to 2016 and was released as an eau de parfum spray by Acqua di Parma in 2019. The fragrance of the masculine eau de parfum spray is spicy and woody . It is debatable whether the perfume is more of a unisex fragrance or a men's fragrance. However, you won't argue about the elegant composition, the chic black bottle or the enormous longevity and sillage. Querica by Acqua di Parma is not an eau de parfum spray for everyone. The fragrance is aimed at people who are looking for the extraordinary , but don't want to find it in screamingly loud compositions. They are not looking for a fragrance with rough edges, but something expressive. Intensity sends its regards The top note of Acqua di Parma Quercia consists of pink pepper, petitgrain, lemon and bergamot. The heart note combines rose geranium, cardamom and cedarwood. Patchouli, tonka bean absolute and oakmoss absolute round off the eau de parfum. Acqua di Parma Quercia is suitable for everyday wear, but can also be worn in the evening. The eau de parfum spray has the all-round qualities typical of the Milanese label, which is aimed at the modern man of today, who feels just as comfortable in jeans as in a suit.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Osmanthus 50 ml
listings.description: Acqua di Parma Osmanthus is a floral-fruity unisex perfume from 2019. The eau de parfum spray is a wonderful addition to the 'Signature of the Sun' fragrance line, which presents particularly precious olfactory ingredients against a radiant, sun-drenched backdrop. Acqua di Parma Osmanthus invites you to take an unforgettable walk through the green forest landscape of south-east Asia . This is the home of the shrub from whose flowers the irresistibly fruity-scented absolute that gives the eau de parfum spray its name is extracted. Its delicate, delicious peach aromas carry subtle nuances of wood and leather and ensure elegant sensuality. An elegant floral fragrance with a sparkling opening Acqua di Parma Osmanthus opens sparkling and fresh with juicy, green mandarin from Sicily and fragrant neroli oil, which powerfully reveals its citrusy richness. The top note brings subtly sensual accents into play. The floral fragrance of delicate peony is joined by beguiling ambrette with its soft, creamy musky scent. A hint of pink pepper discreetly limits the intense notes and gives the eau de parfum spray a fascinating tingle. In the base of the perfume, the star of the show, the osmanthus fragrance, unfolds all its magic. Mossy, woody patchouli supports its sensual elegance with mossy, woody accents.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Yuzu 50 ml
listings.description: The citrus-aromatic Eau de Parfum Spray Yuzu is the latest member of the 'Frutti d'Oro' family from the traditional luxury perfume house Acqua di Parma. Launched in 2019, the unisex fragrance by French star perfumers Nicolas Bonneville and François Demachy is dedicated to Japan's most delicious fruit , the yuzu. Its unique, bitter-sweet aroma combines with the citrusy accents so typical of Acqua di Parma fragrances to create a tingling, fresh fragrance experience with an addictive character. A sparkling fragrance with plenty of elegance and a touch of sensuality The Eau de Parfum Spray opens with a revitalising cocktail in which an intense yuzu accent is joined by the aromas of juicy bergamot from Calabria and sparkling Szechuan pepper. Delicate, graceful blossoms unfold their magic in the heart of the perfume. It presents an elegant, white bouquet of noble lotus, delicate mimosa and fragrant jasmine, gently framed by a green nuance of violet leaf. The extraordinary base of the Eau de Parfum Spray from Acqua di Parma is decidedly sensual. Soft, warm musk, precious sandalwood and liquorice and a hint of liquorice bring the fragrance to an impressive close.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Magnolia Infinita 100 ml
listings.description: Italian sophistication and discreet luxury: this is what Acqua di Parma has stood for since it was founded in 1916. Created by Baron Carlo Magnani from Parma for personal fragrances, Acqua di Parma has maintained its reputation as a centre of elegant fragrances to this day. The Signatures Of The Sun series with the composition Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum Spray is a testament to the craftsmanship of Italian perfumery. listings.description: Experience the quintessence of Italian perfumery with Acqua di Parma's Colonia Il Profumo Eau de Parfum Spray. The sparkling top note opens with a fascinating interplay of sun-ripened bergamot, juicy blood orange and refreshing grapefruit, refined by the elegant spice of petitgrain. This citrus symphony blends harmoniously into a floral, aromatic heart, where delicate orange blossom combines with tart rosemary and exotic ylang-ylang to create a seductive composition. Sensual unisex fragrance by Acqua di Parma for special occasions The full strength of character of the fragrance unfolds in the base note through the combination of earthy patchouli and woody vetiver, which give the perfume its unmistakable depth and persistence. Colonia Il Profumo is an aromatic-citrusy eau de parfum spray that is perfect for people who are looking for something special. The classic flacon design with the characteristic yellow label emphasises the timeless elegance of this extraordinary creation. A fragrance that skilfully blurs the boundaries between masculine and feminine, creating an exclusive aura that delights from morning to night. The perfect choice for individualists who value Italian craftsmanship and authentic luxury products.</p

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Eau de Toilette Spray 40 ml
listings.description: Davidoff Cool Water Eau de Toilette Spray is an iconic fragrance that evokes the untamed power and freshness of the ocean. Since its launch in 1988, this fragrance has been regarded as a timeless classic. It opens with an intense, aromatic wave in which marine notes blend with fresh mint, coriander and lavender. As the fragrance develops, the composition transitions into a heart of sandalwood, jasmine and neroli, which lends the scent a clear yet subtle depth. The base note ensures a long-lasting and warm finish, with nuances of musk, ambergris and cedarwood blending harmoniously. Presented in the distinctive blue bottle, the atomiser allows for easy and precise application. The eau de toilette unfolds best when sprayed from a short distance onto warm areas of skin such as the wrists. A timeless fragrance classic with a fresh and aquatic character. A composition of marine top notes, a woody heart and a warm musk-amber base. Ideal as an invigorating fragrance for everyday wear. Eau de Toilette in the iconic blue spray bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Night Dive Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Cool Water Night Dive: Fresh in a new way Davidoff stands for quality and innovative men’s fragrances without doubt. With the perfume Cool Water Night Dive perfumer Jean-Christophe Hérault has succeeded in creating a perfume that is a cut above the rest. Hérault learnt his trade from scratch with Pierre Bourdon, who created a milestone with Cool Water in the history of perfumery a quarter of a century ago. The Eau de Toilette Spray from Davidoff that is currently conquering the market is paying homage to the great master. A clear and sensual perfume for men The new scent is green-oriental, a vital prerequisite for the mysterious aura that surrounds this otherwise cool and composed perfume. The basis of the scent is the wood of the pistachio , an extremely valuable and rarely used raw material that is also known as mastic wood. The precious Eau de Toilette Spray develops opening with a note of fresh fruit and mint that is an ideal match for the sensual woody note. A hint of cashmere adds an oriental component to the mix. The successful composition is rounded off through typically male ingredients such as amber, sage, black pepper, tobacco and musk. And yet, words alone can’t do it justice. Cool Water Night Dive from Davidoff is a clear enticement to get a sniff of it.

listings.description: Calvin Klein Eternity for Men fragrance is an intense and multi-faceted interpretation of the fougère fragrance family with gourmand accents. The perfume is presented in a luxurious cognac glass bottle that pays homage to the classic Eternity line. listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Intense Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Eternity Intense Eau de Parfum Spray by Calvin Klein is a modern homage to the iconic original fragrance CK Eternity from 1988. The composition is inspired by the romantic atmosphere of an encounter at sunset and unfolds an intense floral-spicy character. It opens with a striking top note of Sichuan pepper, which arouses curiosity about the heart of the fragrance. A bouquet of precious Turkish rose absolute and feminine Arabian jasmine absolute unfolds there. The base note, which combines warm sandalwood with cashmeran, ensures a long-lasting and sensual depth. The vegan formula is based on the use of sustainably sourced and partially upcycled ingredients. We recommend spraying the fragrance onto warm areas of skin such as the wrists or neck for ideal fragrance development. The well-known, iconic bottle underlines the fragrance character with its feminine colouring in a delicate nude-pink. listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum Spray - refillable 30 ml
listings.description: The Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum Spray by Viktor & Rolf is a multi-layered fragrance composition that combines a wealth of floral notes with warm, deep accents. The fragrance opens with a sparkling and invigorating blend of bergamot and green tea, which creates a clear and fresh first impression. Shortly afterwards, an opulent bouquet of precious Sambac jasmine, delicate freesia, precious centifolia rose and exotic orchid unfolds at the heart of the fragrance. This floral diversity is complemented by the delicate sweetness of African orange blossom, giving the creation its unmistakable character. Earthy notes of patchouli and a hint of musk provide a long-lasting and intense base, giving the fragrance a warm and expressive dimension. This composition is bottled in a distinctive, faceted glass bottle in the shape of a garnet, whose pale pink colour elegantly reflects the contents. Its multi-layered nature makes Flowerbomb a suitable companion for everyday wear as well as for special occasions. listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Spicebomb Eau de Toilette Spray by Viktor & Rolf is a composition based on an exciting interplay of contrasts. Created in 2012 by perfumer Olivier Polge, the fragrance unfolds with a fresh top note of bergamot and grapefruit, which is given a special vibrancy by the accents of pink pepper and elemi. At the heart of the composition, the warmth of cinnamon and saffron meets the intensity of red pepper. This spicy heart note transitions into a base of notes of vetiver, tobacco and white leather, which give the fragrance its deep and masculine character. The eau de toilette is particularly suitable for the cooler seasons and the evening. The experience is rounded off by the iconic bottle in the shape of a hand grenade, which visually emphasises the nature of the fragrance. Fragrance direction: Spicy-woody Character: Lively, powerful and masculine Fragrance notes: A composition of citrus fruits, intense spices and a base of tobacco and leather Occasion: Ideal for the cooler months and for evening occasions

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Eau de Parfum Spray Nightvision 50 ml
listings.description: The Spicebomb Nightvision Eau de Parfum Spray by Viktor & Rolf is an intense and multi-faceted fragrance composition that was launched in 2020. The fragrance opens with an exciting top note in which the freshness of grapefruit, lemon and green apple meets an ensemble of warm spices such as cardamom, clove and nutmeg. A hint of chilli provides an unexpected accent. At the heart, an aromatic depth unfolds with notes of lavender, rosemary, clary sage and coriander, which are given a special nuance by mastic resin. The base gives the fragrance its dark and long-lasting character. Here, woody and resinous accords of cedarwood, fir balsam and incense merge with the warmth of Peru balsam and patchouli to create an elegant and masculine signature. This composition differs fundamentally from the eau de toilette of the same name and is particularly recommended for the evening and the colder months of the year. An intense fragrance with an elegant, dark and mysterious character. A complex fragrance pyramid of fresh, spicy, aromatic and woody-resinous notes. The composition differs significantly from Spicebomb Nightvision Eau de Toilette. Ideal for the evening hours and the cooler months of the year.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum Spray Ruby Orchid 100 ml
listings.description: The Flowerbomb Ruby Orchid Eau de Parfum Spray by Viktor & Rolf is a composition that has been enriching the world of fragrances since 2021. The fragrance unfolds with a fruity top note of vine peach and freesia, which creates a lively opening. At the heart of the creation is a floral bouquet that combines jasmine with the eponymous ruby orchid. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm and sweet base note consisting of red vanilla pod and fine bourbon vanilla. This combination of floral, fruity and gourmand elements gives the perfume an intense and sensual character. For a long-lasting presence, the spray can be applied from a short distance to warm areas of skin such as the inside of the wrists or behind the ears. Flowerbomb Ruby Orchid is a fragrance for anyone who appreciates an expressive composition. Sensual, floral-fruity fragrance with gourmand notes. Composition of vine peach, ruby orchid and bourbon vanilla. An intense eau de parfum from 2021. It is particularly suitable for spring and daytime wear.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum Spray Tiger Lily 50 ml
listings.description: The Flowerbomb Tiger Lily Eau de Parfum Spray by Viktor & Rolf, released in 2023, is a floral-fruity composition for women that transports you to a sunny, exotic location. The fragrance opens with a creamy accord of coconut milk, whose gentle sweetness is balanced by the tangy freshness of bergamot. This inviting top note transitions into an opulent floral heart. The eponymous tiger lily takes centre stage here, lending the fragrance a striking, wild facet and accompanied by delicate jasmine and freesia. This bouquet creates a multi-layered floral depth. The composition finds its warm conclusion in the base note. A juicy mango accord provides a fruity sweetness that blends harmoniously with the resinous warmth of benzoin. The overall result is a sunny and warm fragrance with an unmistakable solar character. listings.description: The Eau de Toilette Spray Girl is presented by Rochas 2021. The floral and sweet fragrance is feminine and captivates with a mature yet romantic presence. Created by Anne Flipo and IFF, the top notes are neroli, pink pepper and blackcurrant. The heart note brings the flavours of orange blossom, jasmine and orchid. Woody notes appear in the base, with sandalwood and cedarwood complemented by vanilla. The result is a wonderful fragrance for spring and summer, when the temperatures slowly rise. The Eau de Toilette Spray Girl by Rochas is clearly perceptible, but not overpowering or heavy. This all-rounder is for you Girl is a women's fragrance that really always works. The eau de toilette spray scores just as well in your free time as it does at work, in the evening or when going out. No matter where you go, Rochas Girl will accompany you. After all, the fragrance is aimed at all women who go through life in a relaxed manner, who can laugh at themselves and who feel just as comfortable in jeans as they do in a dress. With this fragrance, you appear groomed and elegant , but also casual and casual . And because it is a Rochas Eau de Toilette, it also offers that certain luxury.

listings.description: The Eau de Rochas Eau de Toilette is a classic fragrance that has been a favourite since its launch in 1970. This composition pays homage to the invigorating freshness of waterfalls and unspoilt nature. The fragrance opens with a sparkling combination of mandarin, bergamot and lemon, which creates a clear and refreshing first impression. At the heart, a bouquet of narcissus, jasmine and rose unfolds, giving the fragrance a subtle floral depth. The base note rounds off the experience with oakmoss, myrrh and vetiver, leaving an earthy, slightly woody signature on the skin. The eau de toilette is presented in an elegant glass bottle, whose textured surface is reminiscent of flowing water and also visually reflects the fragrance experience. Fragrance direction: Citrus-fresh Head note: mandarin, bergamot, lemon Heart note: narcissus, jasmine, rose Base note: oakmoss, myrrh, vetiver Character: Invigorating and elegant

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: With Intuition Eau de Parfum Spray, Aramis presents a modern evolution of the traditional art of fragrance, which is technically categorised as Woody Green Neo-Fougère. Launched in 2025, this creation skilfully combines green accents with a woody depth and stands for contemporary elegance. The olfactory opening is characterised by a crisp grapefruit note that lends the fragrance an immediate, citrusy clarity. Aromatic lavender then unfolds at the centre of the composition, creating a harmonious link to the more complex base notes as a classic element. The foundation of earthy vetiver and the special Cuirissima LXR, an exclusive accord that creates a warm and leathery signature, is particularly influential for the character of the perfume. Accompanying nuances of patchouli, amber and orris round off the fragrance experience and lend it a subtle persistence. Visually, the purity of the fragrance is reflected in a slim, cylindrical bottle made of transparent glass, which reveals the clear liquid. A silver cap and vertical lettering on the front complete the minimalist design. The projection of the eau de parfum changes from an initial freshness to a subtle, body-hugging warmth as it is worn. Fragrance family: Woody Green Neo-Fougère with woody and green facets. Top notes of tangy grapefruit and heart notes with aromatic lavender. Base note with earthy vetiver and exclusive Cuirissima LXR leather accord. Minimalist, cylindrical glass bottle with silver cap. Evolution from citrusy freshness to warm, leathery depth.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 10 ml
listings.description: With its expressive fragrance composition, Aramis Intuition Intense Eau de Parfum Spray emphasises a confident presence in everyday business life as well as at evening events. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, deep-blue glass bottle with a contrasting silver cap. Immediately after spraying, the combination of juniper berry and black pepper imparts a spicy freshness that can create a pleasantly invigorating sensation. As the fragrance develops, lavender and osmanthus reveal their aromatic facets, lending the composition a harmonious depth. This intense formulation offers a long-lasting fragrance experience, meaning that reapplication during the day is often unnecessary. The base notes of oakwood, vanilla and the characteristic Aramis leather essence round off the profile and leave a warm, memorable impression. The fine spray nozzle allows the perfume to be dispensed precisely and sprayed evenly. Expressive fragrance composition with spicy, floral and woody notes Long-lasting fragrance experience thanks to the intense Eau de Parfum formulation A practical atomiser allows for precise and fine application Versatile enough for everyday wear as well as special occasions

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted Perfume Spray The Most Wanted 50 ml
listings.description: Azzaro Wanted The Most Wanted Le Parfum unfolds as a profound fougère-amber composition characterised by spicy, woody and sweet notes. It opens with the powerful spiciness of red ginger, which immediately creates a present and fiery first impression. At the heart of the fragrance creation are complex, smoky woody notes that lend the perfume a dark and magnetic depth. The base is characterised by warm bourbon vanilla, which adds a gentle, balsamic sweetness and harmoniously rounds off the composition. The result is a fragrance with a charismatic and self-confident aura. The bottle picks up on this character: In an elegant, matt-glossy black, it retains the iconic cylindrical shape of the Wanted range. The fragrance is characterised by good longevity and develops into a pleasant, close-to-the-skin presence over hours. Fragrance family: Fougère Ambery Fragrance notes: Red ginger, woody accords, bourbon vanilla Fragrance character: Intense, charismatic and profound Flacon: Elegant design in matt black

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted Eau de Parfum Spray Intense The Most Wanted 100 ml
listings.description: The Most Wanted Eau de Parfum Intense by Azzaro is a composition that captivates with its intense and charismatic aura. This men's fragrance from the fougère fragrance family unfolds a complex aura that combines spicy, sweet and woody elements. It opens with a lively note of cardamom that immediately awakens the senses. As the fragrance progresses, an unexpected toffee accord develops at the heart of the fragrance, adding an attractive and pleasurable sweetness. Finally, the base note of warm amber wood provides a long-lasting and striking depth, giving the fragrance its masculine character. The result is a sensual and spicy fragrance experience that unfolds best on the pulse points. The Eau de Parfum Intense is presented in the iconic, deep black bottle in a barrel design, which visually emphasises the powerful elegance of the contents. Intense men's fragrance from the fougère fragrance family. Combines spicy cardamom with a sweet toffee accord. The base note of amber wood lends a masculine depth. Presented in the iconic black barrel design bottle.

This floral-spicy composition unfolds with a lively top note of Italian bergamot, spicy clove oil, neroli and a hint of peach. At the heart of the creation is a harmonious bouquet of rose centifolia, jasmine from Grasse and gardenia, which is given a special sophistication by ylang-ylang and cloves. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with warm, gentle accords of sandalwood, iris, musk and cedarwood, giving the perfume a long-lasting depth. The fragrance is presented in an elegantly curved glass bottle with a cap crowned by two embracing doves - a timeless symbol of peace and love. With its elegant and feminine aura, L'Air du Temps is a versatile companion for any occasion. A timeless, floral-spicy fragrance classic. Composition of carnation, rose, jasmine and sandalwood. Elegant bottle with dove stopper as a symbol of peace. Character: feminine, elegant and long-lasting.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Nina Eau de Parfum Spray Le Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: The Nina Ricci Nina Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Spray gives everyday life a fruity-floral fragrance composition that exudes a fresh lightness. The pink bottle in a stylised apple shape with silver-coloured leaf elements is a modern eye-catcher. The top note of Italian lemon and apple opens the fragrance experience and brings an invigorating freshness to start the day. White flowers such as gardenia, tuberose and orange blossom then unfold their character, maintaining an elegant presence for the next few hours. In the base note, amberwood and vanilla provide a warm, sweet finish. This combination lingers on the skin for a long time and is ideal for the transition from afternoon to evening. The vegan and cruelty-free formulation also enables conscious application with every spray. Fruity-floral fragrance composition with woody and citrus notes Lemon and apple top notes for a fresh opening Long-lasting base of amber wood and vanilla Vegan and cruelty-free formulation Versatile wear for day and evening

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Nina Eau de Parfum Spray Illusion 50 ml
listings.description: Spices, citrus fruits, sweet fruits and patchouli The Illusion Eau de Parfum Spray Nina by Nina Ricci impresses with its successful coordination in the fragrance pyramid. It is available at parfumdreams.de in 30 ml, 50 ml and 80 ml pump bottles. With an attached blossom and green cord bow on the front, the bottles attract attention as soon as you look at them. The Illusion Eau de Parfum Spray Nina by Nina Ricci is a perfume that inspires many modern women and many men. On the market since 2024 and as an interesting perfume as popular as tried-and-tested products. The effect of spices in combination with fruits and patchouli! Fragrance pyramid harmonises perfectly with the illusion The Illusion Eau de Parfum Spray proves just how important a well-harmonised fragrance pyramid is for the success of a perfume. The top note opens with fresh citrus scents and light spices. Sweet raspberry and fruity orange clearly define the heart note, while vanilla and patchouli create a pleasant, slightly exotic finish. Sesqui terpenes are responsible for relaxation and stimulation. The Nina Spray from Nina Ricci owes its spiritual effect to the ideal blend of natural ingredients. When the right components complement each other perfectly, as they do here, the result is fantastic!

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy 2 Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Moschino Toy 2 Eau de Parfum Spray, created by perfumers Alberto Morillas and Fabrice Pellegrin, was launched in 2018. This fragrance for women belongs to the floral-woody musk family and has a multi-layered character. It opens with a lively top note of juicy mandarin and crisp Granny Smith apple, accompanied by the floral elegance of magnolia. At the heart of the composition, the delicacy of peony meets pure jasmine petals, whilst white currant adds a surprisingly fruity facet. The base note anchors the fragrance with warm tones. Here, sandalwood and amberwood combine with the gentle clarity of musk to create a harmonious finish. The Eau de Parfum is presented in a distinctive bottle that echoes the iconic shape of a teddy bear. A fragrance for women from the floral-woody musk family A lively opening with mandarin, apple and magnolia A warm base note of sandalwood, amberwood and musk Iconic bottle in an unmistakable teddy bear design

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy Boy Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Moschino’s Toy Boy Eau de Parfum Spray is a fragrance full of contrasts and playful elegance. Created by perfumer Yann Vasnier, this composition belongs to the spicy-woody fragrance family and surprises with floral and fruity notes. The opening unfolds with a lively blend of Italian bergamot, pear and the subtle heat of pink pepper and Indonesian nutmeg. This is followed by the heart note, in which a bouquet of magnolia, rose absolute and flax blossom blends with the spicy warmth of clove. The base note leaves a lasting impression, creating a warm, earthy depth with Haitian vetiver, sandalwood and Ambermax®. The fragrance’s distinctive character is also reflected in the bottle’s design: a black teddy bear that serves as an ironic statement, emphasising the dynamic side of the creation. Fragrance family: Spicy-woody with floral and fruity accents Top note: A lively opening with Italian bergamot, pear and pink pepper Heart note: Floral notes of magnolia and rose meet spicy clove Base note: A warm, long-lasting base of vetiver, sandalwood and Ambermax® Character: Distinctive, dynamic and playful

listings.description: Presented in a playful teddy bear-shaped bottle, whose surface shimmers with a mesmerising mother-of-pearl effect, Moschino Toy 2 Pearl is a modern unisex fragrance from 2023. The result is a multi-faceted fragrance that combines fresh, aquatic and floral elements with a subtle warmth. Its elegant yet vibrant character makes it a truly special fragrance experience. listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Explorer Eau de Parfum Spray by Montblanc is a warm woody fragrance for men that is refined with spirited aromatic spices. With elegant Akigalawood and spirited pepper The Explorer Eau de Parfum Spray by Montblanc is a charismatic men's fragrance with an elegant oriental undertone and energising spices. The creation initially refreshes you when you spray it on with an invigorating blend of bergamot, hot pink pepper and clary sage. The heart note is characterised by a masculine leather nuance , which is complemented by earthy Haitian vetiver grass. The base is given an exotic flair by Indonesian patchouli leaves. The warm scent of Akigalawood, gentle ambroxan and cocoa fruits add a mild, subliminal sweetness to the bouquet. When you hear the name "Montblanc", you first think of stylish writing instruments and elegant leather goods, but the company, which originally came from Germany, has also launched more than 25 perfumes on the market since 2001. Like all of its products, the fragrances also exude a classic elegance - the Explorer Eau de Parfum Spray, available since 2019 and created in collaboration with master perfumers Olivier Pescheux and Antoine Maisondieu, is no exception.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: With the fresh, woody Eau de Parfum Spray Legend, the Hamburg-based luxury label Montblanc is continuing its line of 'legendary' men's fragrances, which have long since achieved cult status. Launched in 2020, the fragrance is, like its predecessors, a creation by star perfumer Olivier Pescheux . Following the fresh fougère composition from 2011, the casually elegant Spirit version presented in 2016 and the seductively sensual Night version presented in 2018, a creation with an emphatically intense signature and sensual, charming orientation is now being presented. This gives the Eau de Parfum Spray Legend by Montblanc impressive longevity and particularly good sillage. An exclusive, successful perfume with innovative charm The new version of Montblanc Legend also captivates with the familiar and successful accord with notes of beguilingly fragrant jasmine and soft, green moss, underlaid with sweet and tart nuances of bergamot. However, the Eau de Parfum Spray from 2020 expands the exquisite fragrance sequence with green, aromatic facets of dewy violet leaves and seductively graceful magnolia. Strong accents of resinous wood and fresh, soft leather add irresistibly elegant nuances to the composition. Lovers of the original perfume will also find the original notes in this excitingly modern fragrance and yet be delighted by the deep radiance of the characterful new creation.

The Explorer perfume range was launched in 2019 with the perfume of the same name, which quickly became very popular . With Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum Spray, Montblanc has launched a fragrance that bridges the gap between spicy and sweet woody notes - a perfume that is appreciated for its distinctive originality. With a top note of violet leaf and a heart note of aromatic-balsamic clary sage, the men's fragrance gains sweetness and freshness. The eau de parfum spray is rounded off with a base note of cedar wood, which carries and summarises the composition with its dark depth. Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum Spray was created by three well-known perfume artists: the highly experienced Fabrice Pellegrin, who has already worked for a number of major perfume houses from Dior to Gaultier, Bruno Jovanovicz (e.g. Armani, Lagerfeld) and Nathalie Lorsson, whose list of previous activities also reads like a Who's Who of famous perfume brands. The perfume is supplied in a high-quality silver bottle in the typical Explorer look.

listings.description: The Libre Eau de Parfum Spray by Yves Saint Laurent is a floral fragrance composition presented in a glass flacon designed as a piece of jewellery. At the centre of the fragrance is the interplay of French lavender and Moroccan orange blossom, complemented by musky accords. The composition opens with notes of bergamot and mandarin before moving into a heart of lavender and orange blossom. A base of vanilla bourbon, heliotrope and amber rounds off the fragrance experience. The asymmetrical bottle with its gold-coloured chains and the iconic Cassandre logo combines classic couture elements with modern aesthetics. A special focus is placed on the sustainable concept: the fragrance is refillable, which is a resource-saving alternative to buying a new one. The 100 ml refill is suitable for the 10 ml, 30 ml, 50 ml and 90 ml bottle sizes and is easy to use. Floral composition with notes of lavender, orange blossom and vanilla. Iconic bottle in a couture design with the Cassandre logo. Refillable system for a more conscious use of resources. The 100-ml refill is compatible with the 10-ml, 30-ml, 50-ml and 90-ml bottles.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Eau de Parfum Spray - refillable 40 ml
listings.description: MYSLF by Yves Saint Laurent is a modern men's fragrance that emphasises the versatility of its own personality with a woody-floral composition. The fragrance opens with a lively freshness created by the citrusy accords of Calabrian bergamot and green bergamot. At the heart of the fragrance is an absolute of orange blossom from Tunisia, developed exclusively for the House of Yves Saint Laurent, which gives the perfume its characteristic note. The base note rounds off the olfactory experience with a woody, sensual accord of Indonesian patchouli and Ambrofix™, which gives the fragrance texture and a long-lasting sillage. The design of the bottle is not only purist and modern, but also designed for sustainability. All bottle sizes are refillable, which reduces the consumption of glass, metal, plastic and paper compared to buying several new bottles. The bottle itself contains recycled glass and the outer packaging is FSC™ Mix-certified. Modern men's fragrance with a woody-floral character Fragrance composition of fresh bergamot, orange blossom and patchouli All bottle sizes are refillable Refill concept to reduce packaging material Flacon contains recycled glass and FSC™ Mix-certified cardboard

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum Spray 40 ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum is a composition based on the interplay of fresh and woody notes. The fragrance opens with a clear combination of bergamot, ginger and apple, which is complemented by aldehydes. Aromatic nuances of sage, juniper and geranium unfold in the heart, giving the perfume its fougère character. The base anchors the creation with warm and earthy tones of cedarwood, vetiver and amberwood, rounded off by the depth of incense and tonka bean. The fragrance is characterised by a long-lasting presence. Its fragrance progression remains remarkably stable for hours, giving it a straightforward character. Fragrance direction: Aromatic fougère Character: Fresh, spicy, woody Top notes: bergamot, ginger, apple Special feature: Long-lasting with stable fragrance development

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Spray Berry Crush 30 ml
listings.description: The Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Spray Berry Crush presents itself as a fruity-floral reinterpretation of the well-known Libre signature. Juicy raspberries open the composition in the top note and give the fragrance a lively, berry character. A creamy coconut note unfolds in the heart, bringing a gentle warmth to the arrangement. The base note combines classic diva lavender from France with Moroccan orange blossom and Madagascan vanilla, creating a harmonious balance between freshness and sensuality. This fragrance is characterised by a higher concentration of perfume oils, which can ensure a long-lasting presence on the skin. The bottle picks up on the berry theme visually and comes in vibrant red tones reminiscent of ripe fruit. The design retains the elegant, slim shape of a dinner jacket, accentuated by the iconic, gold-coloured Cassandre logo that wraps around the glass bottle. An asymmetrical, black cap with golden details completes the jewel-like appearance. Compared to other variants in the line, the focus here is clearly on the fruity accents, while the lavender note remains somewhat more subtle in the background. Fragrance family: Fruity-floral with warm undertones. Main notes: Raspberry, creamy coconut, lavender and vanilla. Character: A fruitier, modern interpretation of the classic Libre fragrance. Design: Elegant glass bottle in berry red tones with gold logo detail. Concentration: Eau de Parfum for an intense fragrance experience.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L'Homme Le Parfum 60 ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit de L'Homme Le Parfum is an intense, woody-aromatic interpretation characterised by a striking and sensual depth. The composition opens with an invigorating blend of bergamot, black pepper and aniseed, which leaves an energising first impression. The heart note combines the elegance of lavender with the warmth of French labdanum and fruity accents, giving the fragrance a sophisticated complexity. The base of sweet vanilla, earthy patchouli and vetiver provides a lasting and warm finish. Thanks to its high concentration as a perfume, the fragrance has remarkable longevity and is an excellent companion for special moments and formal occasions in the evening. The iconic bottle emphasises the elegant character of this creation with its deep black, mystical look. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Le Parfum - refillable 40 ml
listings.description: MYSLF Le Parfum by Yves Saint Laurent is an expressive, woody-floral fragrance for men. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L'Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 60 ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent presents La Nuit De L'Homme, an eau de toilette spray that is characterised by its exciting contrasts and elegant radiance. The fragrance composition begins with the intense spiciness of cardamom in the top note, which is balanced by the sparkling freshness of bergamot and leaves an invigorating first impression. At the heart of the fragrance, a striking combination of aromatic lavender and powerful cedarwood unfolds, giving the perfume a clear, woody structure and depth. The base note forms the final note and creates a lasting impression: this is where the earthy nuances of vetiver meet the warm spice of caraway. With its woody, spicy character, La Nuit De L'Homme is a suitable companion for the evening hours and the autumn and winter months. The hexagonal bottle reflects the complexity of the fragrance with its stylish colour gradient from dark to light tones. Woody and spicy fragrance character for men Composition of cardamom, cedarwood and vetiver Ideal for the evening, autumn and winter Presented in a hexagonal bottle with a colour gradient

listings.description: MYSLF L'Absolu by Yves Saint Laurent is an intense, woody-floral fragrance that was conceived as a powerful statement of modern masculinity. The composition opens with a fresh and spicy top note, in which bergamot meets tangy ginger essence and cardamom. The fragrance experience is rounded off by the elegant, metallic bottle, which reflects the avant-garde vision of Yves Saint Laurent and visually captures the strength and individuality of the perfume. listings.description: The Libre Flowers & Flames Eau de Parfum Spray Florale by Yves Saint Laurent reinterprets the iconic fragrance line with a new, emphatically floral yet warm intensity. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Le Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Le Parfum is an intense and multi-layered fragrance creation. It opens with a fresh combination of pear accord and green mandarin, which gently leads into the heart note. There, a rich bouquet of jasmine sambac and other white flowers unfolds, rounded off by the fruity sweetness of mirabelle plum and a fine cinnamon essence. The base of the fragrance is particularly striking and long-lasting, characterised by a dark coffee accord and earthy patchouli. A quartet of four different vanilla notes lends the composition exceptional depth and warmth. This eau de parfum is presented in a sparkling, midnight black bottle that visually emphasises the character of the fragrance. For ideal development, the perfume is applied to warm areas of the body such as the inside of the wrists or the décolleté. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Toilette Spray 60 ml
listings.description: The Y Eau de Toilette by Yves Saint Laurent is a mineral-woody fragrance composition that exudes a clear and modern elegance. At the centre of the fragrance is a fresh combination of lavender and aromatic clary sage, which originate from the French Provence. This composition is introduced by the tangy freshness of bergamot and ginger. A green geranium bourbon absolute from Madagascar unfolds in the heart, giving the eau de toilette its distinctive structure. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a base of sensual woods, warm ambergris and a hint of incense. This combination creates a fragrance that is both fresh and intense with remarkable longevity. The straightforward bottle with the incorporated, iconic "Y" emphasises the self-confident character of the composition. Fragrance direction: mineral-woody Main notes: Lavender, clary sage, geranium and sensual woods Character: Fresh, powerful and elegant Special feature: Offers a long-lasting fragrance experience

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 60 ml
listings.description: L'Homme by Yves Saint Laurent is a fragrance full of contrasts that combines elegance and modern appeal. The composition opens with an invigorating freshness of ginger, bergamot and lemon. At the heart, a spicy accord of white pepper, basil and delicate violet leaves unfolds, giving the eau de toilette an unexpected depth. The base creates a sensual and lasting impression, in which woody notes of cedar and vetiver meet the gentle warmth of tonka bean. Created by perfumers Anne Flipo, Pierre Wargnye and Dominique Ropion, this fragrance reflects a fascinating combination of strength and sensitivity. Its fresh, intense and woody character makes it a suitable companion for everyday wear, especially in spring and summer. listings.rawTitle: Baldessarini Bella Eau de Parfum Spray Absolue 30 ml
listings.description: With a lively combination of fruity and floral notes, the Bella Absolu eau de parfum spray from Baldessarini is a multi-faceted composition. A rich, floral bouquet unfolds in the heart of the creation, which significantly characterises the fragrance. This is where classic rose and intense rose absolute meet the elegant tones of gardenia, giving the whole a floral depth. The base note, which combines cool, aquatic elements with warm musk, provides a harmonious finish. Orcanox also contributes to a consistent and rounded finish. Visually, the bottle emphasises the impression of the contents with a rectangular, transparent glass in a delicate shade of pink that reveals the liquid. A silver, cylindrical cap and the stylised label on the front round off the design. This composition is part of the floral-citrus family of fragrances and focuses on a balanced interplay of freshness and floral accents. Fragrance family: Floral-citrusy orientation with musky and aquatic undertones. Top notes: Fruity interplay of blackcurrant, pink grapefruit, mandarin and marigold. Heart note: Floral bouquet of rose, rose absolute and gardenia. Base note: Rounded off with musk, aquatic notes and orcanox. Design: Rectangular glass bottle in pink with silver cap.
