listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Girl Eau de Toilette 50 ml
listings.description: Since its launch in the 1990s, this fragrance has established itself as a modern classic, renowned for its lively energy and carefree charm. The olfactory journey begins with a distinctly invigorating top note, in which the citrus freshness of bergamot and mandarin blends with the cool, crisp nuance of green mint. This invigorating opening sets the stage for a multifaceted heart, dominated by a lush bouquet of jasmine, rose and honeysuckle, whilst subtle tea accords lend an intriguing depth. The composition rounds off with a warm base of musk, ambergris and wild heather, lending the eau de toilette a gentle, lingering quality. The bottle’s design reflects the simplicity of its contents: A transparent, rectangular glass bottle with rounded corners reveals the slightly yellowish liquid. The appearance is enhanced by a cylindrical, silver-coloured cap and the distinctive red lettering on the front. As a floral-fruity creation, this spray offers a balanced blend of freshness and warmth that embodies the signature style of the Tommy Hilfiger brand. Fragrance family: Floral-fruity composition with a fresh character. Top notes: A combination of bergamot, mandarin and spearmint. Heart notes: A floral bouquet of jasmine, rose, honeysuckle and tea accords. Base note: A warm finish with musk, ambergris and wild heather. Bottle: Transparent, rectangular design with a silver cap and red lettering.

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Since its launch in 1995, Tommy Eau de Toilette Spray has epitomised a modern, aromatic classic. The composition starts with an invigorating freshness characterised by mint, lavender and tangy grapefruit, while bergamot provides a citrusy accent. An interesting heart note develops as the fragrance progresses, combining fruity Granny Smith apples and cranberries with the spice of cinnamon and nutmeg. This interplay is complemented by floral aspects of cactus blossom and rose. A warm and lasting finish is provided by the base note, which combines elements such as driftwood, maple and poplar with the softness of cotton and ambergris. This fragrance signature captures the atmosphere of a road trip through vast landscapes and symbolises independence. Visually, the rectangular, slightly rounded glass bottle with its "HILFIGER" and "EST. 1985" engravings on the sides and the blue lettering emphasise the timeless character of the brand. Fragrance: Fresh and aromatic with woody undertones. Head note: A combination of mint, lavender, grapefruit and bergamot. Heart note: Fruity accents of apple and cranberry meet cinnamon and cactus blossom. Base note: Warm nuances of driftwood, maple, poplar and cotton. Design: Classic glass bottle with silver cap and brand engraving.

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Impact Together Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Tommy Hilfiger developed the eponymous brand with a connection to the USA in 1985. Since then, his focus has been on sporty and elegant products. Initially designing only fashion, he introduced his first perfume for men, "Tommy", in 1994. It remains a popular classic to this day and is considered a quality product on which his other fragrances are based. This also applies to the newly released Impact Together Eau de Toilette Spray. It is a men's perfume that elegantly emphasises nonchalance as a daytime fragrance and powerfully brings robust masculinity to the fore with intense spicy components. Tommy Hilfiger Impact Together for the purposeful, modern man This eau de toilette spray opens with an exciting tingle in the nose and a balsamic, spicy top note with pepper. Slightly spicy, the perfume radiates powerful energy - perfect for a successful, motivated start to the day . After a few moments, a woody and earthy note follows, paired with floral and smoky nuances of mugwort and sage. In combination, these heart notes give men a strongly masculine yet slightly playful aura that inspires and energises. A fascinating and motivating aroma emanates from vetiver as a base note. In Tommy Hilfiger Impact Together Eau de Toilette Spray, it exudes strongly smoky and woody fragrance components with undertones of earthy accents and a fine chocolate flavour. This creates an oriental odeur touch that beguiles the senses and creates a lasting, attractive impression .

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml

Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum is contained in an elegant square bottle designed to be refilled. The refill is available separately. The pale pink packaging, decorated with a golden medallion, is a nod to the brand's rich tradition.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: In 2022, Burberry introduces the Eau de Parfum Spray Hero. The fragrance is sweet and woody and is intended for men. Created by perfumer Aurélien Guichard, however, it does not need a pyramid to develop its rather long-lasting presence. Pine needles meet benzoin, atlas cedar combines with Himalayan cedar and Virginia cedar before incense gently envelops everything. The composition of the Eau de Parfum Spray Hero not only has sweet and woody sides, but also resinous elements that prevent the fragrance from becoming too sweet. With Hero, Burberry presents an eau de parfum spray that breaks away a little from the label's well-known British understatement. Modern and casual, elegant Sweet men's fragrances are rarely found at Burberry, which makes this composition all the more exciting. Gentlemen who like it sweet and slightly resinous will get their money's worth with Hero. Especially because the fragrance develops into a really woody drydown over time. Burberry has once again proven that it has a good feel for elegant and timeless trends. And although the fragrance is sweet, it is also masculine , but with a conscious nonchalance , and does not impose itself, after all, it is an eau de parfum spray for the city, where it is often far too crowded and you don't want to wear expansive fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray Refill / 150 ml
listings.description: Discover the divine essence of femininity with the exquisite Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray from Burberry. This extraordinary perfume is a tribute to the timeless elegance and inner strength of every woman. Its skilfully crafted bottle, which reflects the iconic Burberry design, conceals a fragrance that combines sensuality and sophistication in perfect harmony. Exclusive perfume from Burberry The olfactory experience begins with a gentle breeze of lavender in the top note. This calming opening envelops you in an aura of serenity and freshness, reminiscent of sun-soaked lavender fields in Provence. It is the perfect introduction to a fragrance journey that will enchant your senses. A seductive composition of warm, sweet vanilla unfolds at the heart of Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray. This heart note gives the fragrance a creamy depth and a subtle sweetness reminiscent of golden honey and sun-warmed skin. The vanilla caresses your senses and envelops you in an aura of comfort and sensuality. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with earthy, sensual patchouli. This powerful note gives the perfume depth and character, while at the same time creating a mysterious, almost mystical aura. The patchouli is reminiscent of exotic lands and lends the fragrance an irresistible allure that lingers for a long time. Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray is more than just a fragrance - it is an experience, a transformation. With its intense formulation, the fragrance lasts all day and into the night, perfect for special occasions or when you just want to feel like a goddess.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Burberry Hero is an eau de toilette spray for men launched in 2021. The fragrance is spicy and woody , the straightforward bottle was designed by Riccardo Tisci. Perfumer Aurèlien Guichard composed Hero without a fragrance pyramid. He blends cedar from Virginia, the Atlas Mountains and the Himalayas with spicy black pepper, aromatic juniper and resinous bergamot. Designed in this way, the Burberry Eau de Toilette Spray is masculine but not overpowering, elegant and expressive, yet at the same time refined and discreet. It is the perfect fragrance for everyday wear, where the well-groomed man of today wants to smell good but not overpowering. These heroes also score points in everyday life Hero is a men's fragrance that doesn't need a costume. Sporty and casual , elegant and wearable , the ideal companion for jeans and boots as well as a suit, the Hero eau de toilette spray from Burberry is just like the fashion of the popular British label. A touch of luxury that is evident in the quality and versatility, which does not play itself into the foreground, but is simply there. Very British, very gentlemanly. This fragrance is a real must-have, not just for die-hard Burberry fans, but for anyone who likes a strong yet discreet scent.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray Amber Vanilla Refill / 150 ml
listings.description: Burberry Goddess Amber Vanilla Eau de Parfum Intense offers a warm, multi-layered fragrance composition for everyday wear. The top note, comprising aromatic lavender essence and sweet maple syrup, opens the fragrance experience and lends a touch of refined elegance to your appearance. At the heart of the fragrance, a sophisticated vanilla trio unfolds, creating an inviting aura with its toasted and caramelised notes. This combination is perfect for special evening occasions or moments of relaxation. Velvety amber notes in the base round off the profile and leave a distinctive impression. Spraying the fragrance directly onto pulse points such as the neck, wrists and décolletage intensifies the scent’s development and ensures a long-lasting presence. The refillable, square glass bottle, with its amber-coloured gradient and golden accents, perfectly encapsulates the elegant appearance. A multi-layered fragrance profile featuring lavender, maple syrup and a trio of vanilla notes A velvety amber base for a warm, inviting aura Applying it to pulse points intensifies the fragrance experience Suitable for everyday wear and special occasions Refillable glass bottle in an elegant design

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Perfume 150 ml
listings.description: With the Burberry Hero fragrance, the British designer house continues the success story of the eponymous fragrance range. The creation from 2024 combines balsamic, warm notes with smoky accents and a masculine, woody base . The result is a men's fragrance with a character that is as modern as it is elegant. Modern composition with a classic base The Burberry Hero fragrance opens with a top note dominated by cypriol oil. It sets a woody, earthy accent that is also reminiscent of leather. In the background, the heart note forms an exciting contrast with the warm, sweet and woody scent of amyris oil. The crowning glory of the composition is the base note of cedarwood, a classic ingredient for high-quality fragrances. This modern men's fragrance is perfect for making a statement. With its elegant charisma , it is perfect for the evening. It is equally at home at dinner, in a club or at special events. Burberry Hero perfume comes into its own in cooler weather thanks to its balsamic, woody character.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Elixir Eau de Parfume Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Burberry Her Elixir Eau de Parfume Spray was released in 2022 and enriches the popular Her fragrance range with a fruity gourmand . Its opaque, deep pink bottle cleverly embodies the fragrance's character: intense, sensual and creamy. The smooth, warm accords make it the perfect cosy fragrance for the cool season. However, its cheerful fruitiness gives Her Elixir a special twist . This also makes the fragrance an uncomplicated companion on warm spring days. Her Elixir - the intensifying flanker The fragrance DNA is closely related to the classic Burberry Her, but Her Elixir has a little more of everything: more creaminess, a pronounced powdery note and more powerful berry accords . These fruity notes dominate the eau de parfume spray at first spray. Strawberry and blackberry as the only top notes create a fresh sweetness in the opening. The heart consists of clear, minimalist and elegant pure jasmine. The result is a carefree, feminine fragrance full of sensuality and joie de vivre. In the dry down, the Burberry Eau de Parfume Spray ends with lush accords of warm vanilla and cosy sandalwood and amber - a composition made for women who like to push boundaries. But beware: you'll probably find it hard to save yourself from compliments.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Burberry Her Eau de Toilette Spray is a floral-fresh fragrance with fruity and green influences . The extravagant fragrance composition is suitable for women who want to emphasise their femininity and present themselves with confidence. Here, sensual sounds meet floral and sparkling notes. British model Fran Summers is the face of the perfume's advertising campaign. With her attractive, romantic and equally powerful charisma , she perfectly reflects the current zeitgeist and the direction of this perfume. The Her Eau de Toilette Spray by Burberry whets the appetite for more and envelops every woman in a cheerful, tender and extremely lively aura . A luxurious fragrance that invites you to dream In the top note, green bergamot, blackcurrant and pink pepper initially unfold their loving aromas. Honeysuckle, peony, rose and lily of the valley take the lead in the heart. In the base note, nuances of musk and cedar wood skilfully round off this unmistakable fragrance experience. Due to its lightness, Burberry Her Eau de Toilette Spray is particularly effective in the warmer seasons from spring to autumn . The minimalist and stylishly designed bottle made of solid glass with the atomiser placed on the side sets the scene for this fragrance in an appealing and tasteful way.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense Spray takes the iconic fragrance of the traditional British brand and gives it a new, even more intense facet . It goes without saying that this perfume is perfect for anyone who already loves the classic creation for women. Like these, the Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense Spray uses a combination of oriental, powdery and fruity extracts to create a varied and multi-layered fragrance. The bottle, which comes in a beautiful pale pink, is also an eye-catcher - and is guaranteed to catch the eye in the bathroom at home. An intense, delicious and exclusive perfume for women The top note of Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense Spray opens with very striking and fruity extracts of strawberry. The heart note is also fruity, with floral accords dominating, with orange blossom standing out in particular. The base note uses amberwood to give the entire creation a subtle oriental and exotic touch. The overall fragrance, which is both warm and sparkling, is truly unique. The aura of luxury that this creation exudes from the first spritz is unmistakable - also very suitable for special occasions.</p

listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Extra Eau de Parfum unveils a multi-layered world of fragrance that accompanies everyday life with an inviting presence. The floral and gourmand notes are ideal for moments of relaxation as well as for special occasions. This composition pays homage to life’s carefree moments and captures a playful spirit, inspired by values such as sisterhood and joy. listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Lola Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: She is flirty and a bit provocative, vibrant and relaxed, cool and self-confident, playfully charming and irresistibly seductive. May we introduce her? Lola by Marc Jacobs. Lola reveals her tantalising power of attraction with a playful wink, a sexy smile. With light pink pepper, succulent, ruby-red grapefruit, and delicious D’Anjou pear, the fragrance conquers everything around it. Fuchsia peony radiates in the top note. The sweet lingering of enveloping notes of creamy musk, indulgent vanilla, and tonka bean gives the fragrance a warm, sensual aura.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray is a modern and elegant interpretation of the classic rose, captured in a floral fragrance. The composition opens with a fresh top note of delicate pink peony, fruity lychee and airy freesia. At the heart of the fragrance, a delicate bouquet of magnolia and lily of the valley unfolds, giving way to a warm base. Notes of cedarwood, amber and a hint of honey lend the perfume its sensual, powdery and characterful finish. The overall result is a light and warm fragrance that combines French charm with a blend of floral notes and lively accents. The romantically designed bottle, inspired by the Chloé Fortune Plissé collection, emphasises the fragrance’s elegance. A silver-plated metal plate and a hand-tied beige bow complete the design. Its timeless appeal was recognised in 2024 with the Austrian Perfume Award in the ‘Classic Women’s Fragrances’ category. A floral fragrance offering a modern interpretation of the rose. A composition of peony, lychee, magnolia and cedarwood. A light, warm and powdery fragrance. An elegant pleated bottle with a hand-tied bow. Awarded “Women’s Classic” at the Austrian Perfume Awards 2024.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray is a floral chypre composition that combines gentle elegance with a sense of freedom. The fragrance opens with the floral freshness of freesia, which meets the sweet, fruity nuances of mirabelle plum in the heart note. In the base, intense oakmoss lends the composition a distinctive, mineral depth and rounds off the fragrance experience. This interplay creates a fragrance that is suitable for both everyday wear and special occasions. The bottle itself reflects the character of the perfume: transparent glass allows a rosé-beige shimmer to shine through, whilst the gold-coloured cap is adorned with a delicate leather strap. A floral chypre fragrance with mineral accents. A composition of fresh freesia, sweet mirabelle plum and intense oakmoss. Embodies a blend of natural elegance and freedom. Presented in a travel-inspired bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Love Story Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Love Story is an eau de parfum inspired by a modern romance set in the streets of Paris. The fragrance composition is floral and fresh, opening with a lively top note. Here, neroli and zesty citrus notes of bergamot, grapefruit and lemon meet the gentle sweetness of pear. As the fragrance develops, the heart unfolds: a bouquet of orange blossom, Madagascar jasmine and classic rose. Fruity accents of blackcurrant and peach lend the heart note a distinctive dimension. The fragrance concludes with a warm base of musk, cedar, patchouli and cashmere wood, which lends the fragrance its enduring character. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, delicate golden bottle, whose design emphasises the perfume’s allure. listings.rawTitle: Chloé Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Spray Refillable 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Le Parfum, a fragrance created in France by perfumer Romain Almairac, is an intense interpretation of the classic signature. The opening unfolds with a powerful accord of orange blossom, which immediately exudes a warm presence and appeals to the senses. This is followed in the heart by an essence of rose, which significantly shapes the structure of the fragrance and lends it an elegant character. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a base of vanilla and tonka bean, which lends the Eau de Parfum Spray a certain depth without becoming overly sweet. Visually, the product captivates with its iconic fluted glass bottle, which holds a light golden liquid and is crowned by a silver cap. A beige label and a hand-tied bow in a dark Bordeaux shade around the neck of the bottle add splashes of colour. The entire range is designed to be refillable in 30 ml, 50 ml and 100 ml sizes, promoting the responsible use of resources. For the nuances to unfold over time, we recommend applying it to pulse points such as the neck, décolleté or the insides of the wrists. Fragrance composition: Powerful orange blossom in the top note, combined with rose essence and a base of vanilla and tonka bean. Character: A warm, intense fragrance that makes a statement without being too sweet. Design: Iconic flacon made of ribbed glass with a silver cap and a burgundy bow. Sustainability: The Eau de Parfum spray is designed to be refillable. Origin: Created by perfumer Romain Almairac and manufactured in France.

It opens with a fresh and lively note of juicy raspberry, which gently transitions into the heart of the fragrance. There, the rose unfolds its classically feminine and floral character. The base note provides depth and a warm, long-lasting presence, blending woody accords of cedarwood with the sensual nuances of ambrox and cashmeran. This versatile fragrance is equally suited to everyday wear and special evening occasions. The fragrance is presented in an elegant bottle, adorned with a garnet-red bow, which is also refillable. A fruity-floral fragrance composition with a warm, woody base A blend of raspberry, rose, cedarwood and Ambrox A versatile fragrance for daytime wear and special occasions An elegant, refillable bottle with a garnet-red bow

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Nuit d'Egypt 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Nomade Nuit d'Égypte pays homage to the origins of perfumery and offers a modern interpretation of humanity’s first fragrance: kyphi. Created by perfumer Juliette Karagueuzoglou, this composition takes you on a fascinating journey. The fragrance opens with powerful accents of myrrh, which blend harmoniously with the spicy notes of ginger and cinnamon. At the heart, a bouquet of broom blossom nectar and the opulent orange blossom absolute—sourced directly from the Nile Delta—unfolds. Warm, balsamic nuances of cypriol and opoponax round off the heart note, before a soft vanilla note in the base provides a long-lasting finish. The Eau de Parfum consists of 90 per cent ingredients of natural origin. The bottle is adorned with a ribbon in ‘Egyptian Blue’, one of the oldest man-made pigments, which emphasises the fragrance’s refined character. The packaging also consists partly of recycled materials. An amber-floral fragrance with an intense and sophisticated character. A composition featuring notes of myrrh, orange blossom absolute and vanilla. Contains 90 per cent ingredients of natural origin. Inspired by the formula of the ancient Egyptian Kyphi perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Jasmin Naturelle 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Nomade Jasmin Naturelle Eau de Parfum Spray is a fragrance inspired by the beauty of the world. At the heart of this feminine fragrance creation by perfumer Caroline Dumur lies Egyptian jasmine, responsibly hand-picked at sunrise. Its floral note blends in the heart with the gentle accent of date, whilst a base of warm vanilla and sandalwood lends a harmonious depth. The composition unfolds with a floral-spicy character and is characterised by a soft, elegant warmth that avoids any cloying sweetness. The formulation is vegan and consists of 100% naturally derived ingredients, with no artificial colourants. The bottle, in earthy ochre tones with a braided detail around the neck, reflects the fragrance’s cosmopolitan character. A feminine, floral-spicy fragrance A composition with notes of jasmine, date and vanilla Vegan formula made from 100% naturally derived ingredients Free from artificial colourings

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray Lumineuse 50 ml
listings.description: Chloé Lumineuse is an Eau de Parfum created by perfumer Ane Ayo. At the heart of the composition, a full-bodied and complex rose unfolds, elegantly accompanied by velvety notes of Arabian jasmine. A subtle hint of vanilla lends the floral bouquet a special depth, gently underscored by warm amber and balsamic accents. The fragrance’s vegan formula consists of naturally derived fragrances, alcohol and water. The perfume is housed in an elegant, fluted glass bottle in a vintage style. A shiny silver cap and a beige ribbon with a delicate pink stitching adorn the design. The bottle is made from 25% recycled glass and the ribbon from 100% recycled polyester. The perfume is also available as a 150 ml refill pack. A floral fragrance with notes of rose, jasmine and vanilla. Vegan formulation with naturally derived fragrances. Bottle made from recycled materials and available as a refill pack. Elegant, vintage-style bottle design with a distinctive ribbon.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Jardin d’Égypte 30 ml
listings.description: As the third creation in the Nomade Égypte range, the Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Jardin d’Égypte takes you on an olfactory journey to the homeland of the brand’s founder, Gaby Aghion. The composition by perfumer Caroline Dumur captures the atmosphere of a sun-drenched Egyptian garden, where ancient traditions blend with modern lightness. The opening notes immediately surprise with an unusual combination of the rare cassia flower and papyrus, lending the fragrance a green, almost mystical freshness. At the heart, a complex interplay of sweet dates and figs unfolds, meeting a spicy kyphi accord. This ancient incense blend, refined with notes of cinnamon and myrrh, lends a resinous depth that nevertheless remains airy. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm base of creamy sandalwood, ambrette and solarwood, which lingers on the skin for a long time. Visually, the bottle reflects the connection to nature. The distinctive glass bottle, with its rounded shapes, offers a view of the pale yellow liquid. A woven element frames the front, whilst a green band and a matching tassel on the golden cap add splashes of colour. The golden metal element bearing the lettering “NOMADE” completes the elegant look. Fragrance family: Woody-amber with floral and resinous facets. Top notes: Cassie flower and papyrus for a fresh opening. Heart notes: Date, fig and a spicy kyphi accord (cinnamon, myrrh). Base notes: Sandalwood, Solarwood and ambrette provide warmth. Design: Transparent bottle with green details and a braided rim.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Lumière d'Égypte 30 ml
listings.description: The Nomade Lumière d'Égypte Eau de Parfum Spray pays homage to the majestic landscapes of Egypt. Inspired by a journey along the Nile, the fragrance opens with a floral and aquatic accord of blue lotus. This airy freshness gives way to a heart of velvety jasmine notes that unfold a sensual warmth. The fragrance concludes with a rich kyphi accord, a classic composition combining notes of cinnamon bark, sandalwood, myrrh, pink pepper and elemi oil. This blend creates a sophisticated fragrance composition that embodies fresh vegetation and the warmth of the desert. The iconic Nomade bottle emphasises the character of the fragrance with golden accents and an elegant blue-grey ribbon. Fragrance profile: Floral, warm Top note: Blue lotus accord Heart note: Jasmine Base note: Kyphi accord

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray Rose Naturelle Intense 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Rose Naturelle Intense Eau de Parfum Spray is a modern and intense interpretation of the iconic rose. Created by perfumer Alexis Dadier, the composition is based entirely on ingredients of natural origin and contains no artificial additives whatsoever. It opens with a sweet, fresh note of bergamot, which gives way to a heart of pure neroli and the exquisite essence of organically grown rose. The base notes lend the fragrance its distinctive character: slightly smoky, upcycled oak wood meets creamy sandalwood and a hint of cedarwood. On the skin, this unfolds into a woody-rosy aroma with a velvety, creamy depth that deliberately sets itself apart from classic floral fragrances. This commitment to naturalness is also reflected in the packaging, which uses recycled materials for the bottle, ribbon and box. A modern, woody-rosy fragrance composition A vegan formula with ingredients of 100% natural origin Elegant heart note of organically grown rose and neroli Warm base note of creamy sandalwood and upcycled oakwood

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Chloé Parfum Intense Spray Le Nectar Refill / 150 ml
listings.description: Chloé Le Nectar Parfum Intense offers a multi-faceted fragrance composition that perfectly enriches everyday life. The elegant glass bottle, with its ribbed texture and gold-coloured bow, blends stylishly into any perfume collection. A top note of bergamot opens the fragrance experience, creating an invigorating sensation the moment it is sprayed, perfect for starting the day. At the heart, neroli, orange blossom and rose unfold their floral facets, leaving a pleasant impression on special occasions or in the office. The base notes of tonka bean and patchouli round off the profile and provide a long-lasting depth, ensuring the fragrance remains noticeable for many hours. Thanks to its practical 30-millilitre size, the spray fits effortlessly into any handbag, making it easy to freshen up whilst out and about. Furthermore, the refillable system offers tangible added value, as users can simply reuse the bottle once it is empty. A multifaceted fragrance composition featuring bergamot, rose and patchouli for a long-lasting presence. The compact 30-ml size makes it easy to carry and refresh your fragrance throughout the day. The refillable design makes it easy to reuse the bottle. Versatile enough for both the office and special occasions.

listings.rawTitle: Laura Biagiotti Forever Eau de Parfum Spray Gold 30 ml
listings.description: The Forever Gold Eau de Parfum Spray complements the fragrances in the Laura Biagiotti Forever collection. The women's fragrance was launched in 2022 and has a floral-spicy presence . Annick Menardo is the nose and gives the eau de parfum spray a top note of plum, blackcurrant buds and Madagascan ginger. For the heart note, she uses the scents of jasmine, tuberose and ylang-ylang. Amber, vanilla and sandalwood form the delicate base. The composition is elegant, wonderfully wearable , feminine and sensual , but not heavy. This makes the Laura Biagiotti Forever Gold Eau de Parfum Spray perfect for spring or warm autumn days and evenings. A touch of Asia Plums and ginger are an extremely popular combination in Asia, both in the world of delicacies and in the world of fragrances. The freshness of the ginger and the slightly tart fruitiness of the plums are subtly framed in the sophisticated fragrance by Laura Biagiotti and exude a wonderful sensuality that is incredibly elegant. In keeping with the fragrance, the Forever Gold bottle is sophisticated and elegant, avoids straight lines, has a subtle golden glass and is also framed by golden elements. The Laura Biagiotti Forever Gold Eau de Parfum Spray is a visual and olfactory delight.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d'Issey Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Le Sel d'Issey by Issey Miyake is an eau de parfum spray that celebrates the olfactory encounter between sea and earth. This woody-aquatic composition, created by Quentin Bisch, is characterised by its intense and powerful character. It opens with a spicy freshness of ginger, sea salt and incense. In the heart note, a maritime accord of seaweed and sea grass unfolds, accompanied by sand vetiver. The base provides a warm and earthy depth, combining notes of amber, recycled cedarwood and oakmoss. The perfume is certified vegan and its formula consists of 94% ingredients of natural origin. The refillable bottle made from 20% recycled glass underlines the aesthetics of the fragrance with its smoky grey colour gradient and gunmetal-look cap. Woody, aquatic and spicy fragrance Composition of sea salt, ginger, incense, cedarwood and oakmoss Vegan formula with 94% ingredients of natural origin Refillable bottle made from partially recycled glass

listings.description: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme is an eau de toilette that is characterised by a clear, woody-aquatic signature. At the heart of the composition, a special combination of aquatic nénuphar notes and the warm spice of nutmeg and cinnamon unfolds. These facets give the fragrance its characteristic depth. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with a powerful blend of tobacco, ambergris, sandalwood and vetiver, leaving a striking impression. The design of the bottle reflects the character of the fragrance: a simple, rectangular glass container with a matt grey metal cap. The product is available in different sizes and there is a refill bottle that is only compatible with the bottles labelled "RECHARGEABLE". A fragrance from the woody-aquatic fragrance family. Composition of fresh yuzu, spicy nutmeg and warm sandalwood. Presented in a clear, minimalist glass bottle. Available as an eau de toilette in 75 ml, 125 ml and 200 ml sizes.

The outer packaging also reflects a conscious use of resources, as it is made from FSC™-certified materials and a proportion of upcycled seaweed. listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d'Issey Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The Issey Miyake Le Sel D'Issey Eau de Parfum combines fresh, nature-inspired fragrance accords into a minimalist composition for everyday use. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, cylindrical glass bottle with a subtle colour gradient. The top notes of yuzu, bergamot and lemon create a crisp opening that evokes a revitalising sensation in the morning. This is followed by a spicy-floral heart note of cinnamon, geranium, lily of the valley and saffron, which unfolds its aromas and lends the fragrance profile a pleasant depth. Woody notes of musk, cedar and sandalwood, combined with Sichuan pepper and fir balsam, form the base, ensuring a long-lasting presence throughout the day. Thanks to its aquatic character, the fragrance can be worn in a variety of ways throughout all four seasons. For the fragrance to develop to its full potential, it is best to spray the perfume directly onto warm areas of skin such as the wrists or chest; however, those with sensitive skin should avoid direct skin contact. Avoiding light-coloured garments and thin fabrics when spraying will help protect the textiles. A minimalist, aquatic fragrance composition for versatile everyday use Top notes of yuzu and lemon for a fresh opening A woody-spicy base note ensures a long-lasting scent Suitable for wear all year round, in all four seasons Elegant bottle design with a subtle colour gradient

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray Intense Wood&Wood 50 ml
listings.description: L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme Wood&Wood by Issey Miyake is an ode to the multifaceted power of nature, captured in a woody, citrusy fragrance. This intense composition from 2019 unfolds as an olfactory journey through the forest, revealing its depth with every spray. The opening is an invigorating combination of tangy grapefruit, which meets the spicy warmth of cardamom and the resinous aroma of elemi for a fresh first impression. At the heart of the fragrance is a striking duo of Virginia cedar and sandalwood. These powerful woods are complemented by a subtle apricot accent and the complexity of ambroxan, giving the heart note an unexpected softness. The base note anchors the experience with earthy notes of patchouli and Haitian vetiver. Additional woody accords and a hint of musk round off the Eau de Parfum Spray Intense and give it a long-lasting, present character that reflects the minimalist and modern style of the brand. listings.description: Inspired by the infinite power and depth of the ocean, Issey Miyake presents L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum Spray Intense. This refillable women's fragrance unfolds an intense floral-aquatic signature, conceived by perfumer Amandine Clerc-Marie as a bold and innovative composition. At the heart of the fragrance is a special Posidonia accord that evokes the vast, vibrant underwater meadows and gives the perfume its unique character. This aquatic note is complemented by exotic ylang-ylang in the heart note, while a base of warm vanilla provides a sensual depth. The formula is vegan-certified and consists of 91% ingredients of natural origin. The design of the bottle also pays homage to nature: the silver-coloured cap imitates metallic water reflections and, as a patented innovation, is made entirely from wood, thus avoiding the use of plastic. As a sign of conscious use of resources, the bottle is refillable for the first time. At the heart of the composition, a floral bouquet of rose super essence, lavender and jasmine unfolds, creating a clear and calming impression. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a base of creamy coconut milk, subtle white musk and earthy patchouli, which lends a harmonious and enveloping depth. As part of the Replica collection, which interprets familiar memories olfactorily, the fragrance is presented in a minimalist bottle with a cotton label reminiscent of the fashion house's iconic designs. listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Eau de Toilette Spray Never-ending Summer 30 ml
listings.description: The Replica Never-ending Summer Eau de Toilette Spray by Maison Margiela is a tribute to the carefree atmosphere of an endless summer on the Italian Amalfi Coast. This unisex fragrance, created by perfumer Christophe Raynaud, captures the essence of a sunny day with a sparkling and invigorating composition. At the centre is an accord reminiscent of an Italian spritz cocktail, characterised by the fresh note of bitter orange. This citrusy liveliness is harmoniously complemented by the earthy depth of vetiver. Never-ending Summer is a fragrance for anyone who appreciates fresh and spicy compositions and wants to capture the feeling of spontaneous summer adventures. listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Eau de Toilette Spray Afternoon Delight 10 ml
listings.description: The Replica Afternoon Delight Eau de Toilette by Maison Margiela is a composition that is reminiscent of a moment of pleasurable pause in a Parisian café. Created by master perfumer Carlos Benaïm, the unisex fragrance unfolds as a warm, spicy and sweet gourmand experience. It opens with a characteristic madeleine accord reminiscent of freshly baked pastries. As the fragrance progresses, this note blends harmoniously with the creamy and woody depth of sandalwood and the cosy sweetness of Madagascar vanilla. Inspired by Marcel Proust's novel "In Search of Lost Time", the fragrance captures the essence of a fleeting but unforgettable moment of pleasure. Its ambery warmth makes it an ideal companion for the autumn and winter months. Fragrance direction: Warm & spicy, gourmand Main notes: Madeleine accord, sandalwood, Madagascar vanilla Character: A sweet and light unisex fragrance Inspiration: A moment of pleasure in a Parisian café

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Eau de Toilette Spray On A Date 100 ml
listings.description: The Replica On A Date Eau de Toilette Spray by Maison Margiela is inspired by the atmosphere of a magical late summer evening in the vineyards of Provence. The fragrance opens with sparkling bergamot and unfolds a warm floral composition in the heart with the fruity sweetness of a blackcurrant liqueur accord and delicate Isparta rose petals. In the base, earthy patchouli lends the creation a special depth and rounds off the fragrance experience. Carefully selected ingredients are used for this eau de toilette, including sustainably sourced patchouli from Bali and rose essence from Isparta. The composition is reminiscent of the notes of ripe grapes and wild roses and captures the essence of an unforgettable moment. A floral-fruity fragrance with a warm character. Inspired by a romantic evening in Provence. Key notes of blackcurrant liqueur, Isparta rose and patchouli. Contains sustainable and ethically sourced ingredients.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Eau de Toilette Spray Up at Dawn 30 ml
listings.description: With the Eau de Toilette Spray Up at Dawn from the Replica collection, Maison Margiela captures the atmosphere of an early morning in an English garden. This olfactory snapshot begins with a fresh yet earthy top note that combines spicy pink pepper with a characteristic soil accord and elemi oil. A floral heart unfolds at the centre of the composition, characterised by rose absolute and gently underlined by powdery orris root and ambrette absolute from Guatemala. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with soft musky accords, creating a harmonious interplay of floral and woody facets. The bottle features the classic design of the Replica series and is reminiscent of traditional apothecary jars, while the cotton label provides detailed information on the origin and inspiration of the fragrance. The pink-coloured liquid inside visually reflects the delicate rose notes that form the heart of this creation. A "memory in a fragrance", Up at Dawn embodies the calm and freshness of a misty morning in Windsor and offers a sophisticated fragrance signature for lovers of floral-woody compositions. Fragrance family: Floral-woody with a balance of fresh and earthy elements. Top notes: A combination of pink pepper, soil accord and elemi oil provides a lively opening. Heart note: Rose absolute, powdery iris and ambrette form the centrepiece. Base note: Soft musky notes give the fragrance depth and longevity. Design: Classic apothecary-style glass bottle with informative cotton label.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Eau de Toilette Spray Sailing Day 100 ml
listings.description: Maison Margiela Replica Sailing Day captures the olfactory memory of a carefree day on the open sea. This unisex eau de toilette opens with a sparkling top note of aldehydes, juniper and a hint of red pepper, reminiscent of a fresh sea breeze. At the heart of the composition, aquatic accords combine with the powdery elegance of iris and the spice of coriander to recreate the feeling of cool surf on the skin. The base note anchors the fragrance with warm, woody nuances of cedarwood and the salty depth of ambergris, reminiscent of sun-dried driftwood on the shore. The fragrance is presented in a minimalist bottle with a cotton label inspired by Maison Margiela's fashion labels, emphasising the unique character of the Replica range. A fresh and aquatic unisex fragrance with woody and spicy accents. Inspired by the memory of a sailing day at sea. Fragrance composition with notes of aldehydes, marine accords, iris and cedarwood. Part of the Replica collection, which captures specific moments and places olfactorily. Presented in a purist bottle with a characteristic fabric label.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Eau de Toilette Spray Under The Stars 100 ml
listings.description: The Replica Under The Stars Eau de Toilette Spray by Maison Margiela is a composition that evokes the atmosphere of a clear night in nature. The fragrance unfolds a warm, spicy character characterised by woody and leathery notes. It opens with a striking note of black pepper, which fades into a heart of a striking leather accord. In the base, the composition finds its depth through a sophisticated blend of oud infusion, labdanum resinoid and Virginia cedarwood. Subtle nuances of cinnamon leaves emphasise the spicy orientation of the fragrance. As an eau de toilette, the long-lasting fragrance develops from an intense, leathery presence to a softer finish. For optimal development, we recommend spraying onto the pulse points, for example after showering or bathing. Fragrance: Warm-spicy, woody, leathery Head note: Black pepper Heart note: leather accord Base note: oud infusion, labdanum resinoid, Virginia cedarwood Product type: Eau de toilette spray

Lancôme La vie est belle Eau de Parfum Spray refillable 30 ml
listings.description: La Vie Est Belle by Lancôme is an eau de parfum that embodies joie de vivre in a fragrance. At the centre of the composition is the noble iris pallida from France, which is accompanied by the depth of sustainably sourced patchouli from Bali and a warm gourmand vanilla accord. The fragrance is housed in the iconic "le Sourire de Cristal" bottle, whose shape is reminiscent of a smile. A grey ribbon on the neck symbolises freedom. This version of the eau de parfum spray is refillable, enabling a more conscious use of resources. The bottle can be easily refilled at home: The spray attachment is unscrewed, the refill is put on and the filling process stops automatically as soon as the bottle is full. For optimum development, the perfume is applied to warm areas of skin such as the wrists or décolleté. Fragrance composition with iris pallida, patchouli and a gourmand vanilla accord. Iconic glass bottle "le Sourire de Cristal" (the crystal smile). Refillable design for reduced material consumption. Simple refill mechanism with automatic stop.

Rose unfolds at the heart of the composition, accompanied by the presence of jasmine. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a clear chypre-white accord that creates a powdery and musky base. This fragrance was developed by three talented perfumers from different continents who combined their perspectives to create a harmonious essence. The perfume is bottled in a remarkably slim bottle whose design is just as contemporary as the fragrance itself. The bottle is also refillable and therefore supports the conscious use of resources. Floral composition with rose, jasmine and a chypre-white accord. Developed by three perfumers from three different continents. Modern and particularly flat, refillable bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La vie est belle Eau de Parfum Spray L'Elixir Very Cherry 10 ml
listings.description: Lancôme’s La Vie Est Belle L’Elixir Very Cherry Eau de Parfum is a reliable companion throughout the day with its fruity-woody composition. The top note of black cherry offers a crisp fragrance experience that ensures an immediate, vibrant start to your morning. As the fragrance develops, violet leaves, iris, sambac jasmine and Damask rose unfold into a floral bouquet that elegantly enhances your presence on special occasions or in the office. Finally, the base notes of warm oud, vanilla, patchouli, cocoa butter, soft leather and cedarwood gently blend with your skin. This deep combination gives the fragrance remarkable longevity, meaning you won’t need to reapply it even on long evenings. The handy 30-ml bottle fits effortlessly into any handbag, making it easy to carry with you throughout the day. Simply spray the eau de parfum onto clean skin and allow it to dry briefly to experience the full development of the fragrance notes. A fruity-floral fragrance composition with a distinctive top note of black cherry Long-lasting wear for a sustained fragrance experience without the need for reapplication A warm base note of oud, vanilla and cedarwood blends gently with the skin The compact 30 ml size is ideal for hassle-free everyday use

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Aqua Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo transports you to the world of the oceans with Man Aqua. The eau de toilette spray is a homage to the sea in its seeming infinity, beauty and strength. However, you will not only find refreshment in the fragrance, but also a versatile blend of different nuances that inspires and can provide a spontaneous, mental holiday in almost any situation! A fragrance full of ocean magic The stage is set for Man Aqua, whose top notes are already captivating with their sweet spiciness. It is a duet of cardamom and grapefruit that puts you in a good mood and marks the ideal start to the day. In the heart note, floral geranium meets clary sage, along with the aquatic marine note that gives Jimmy Choo Man Aqua Eau de Toilette Spray its name. At this point at the latest, you will feel as if you have been transported to the beach or are travelling by boat across the ocean, feeling the waves and the wind. The base note of the fragrance also emphasises this idea with salted moss, amber and patchouli. These elements have been deliberately interwoven to create a fragrance component that is reminiscent of seafaring. Even the bright blue bottle fits perfectly into the picture. Who will you treat to a mental journey to the sea?

listings.rawTitle: Liquides Imaginaires Fortis Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Fortis by Liquides Imaginaires is a creation characterised by a striking woody-spicy signature. The composition unfolds with a powerful top note of saffron, cumin, oud and cypriol, which leaves an intense first impression. At the heart of the fragrance, warm woody nuances of guaiac and cedar wood combine with amyris and vetiver to create a multi-layered accord. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with sandalwood, musk, amber, patchouli and a subtle hint of vanilla, giving the perfume a remarkable depth. Fortis presents itself as a complex and enveloping fragrance whose character is characterised by a smoky, spicy warmth. As an eau de parfum, it has a high concentration of fragrance oils. The spray can be applied to warm areas of skin for a long-lasting fragrance experience. Scent: Woody and spicy Character: Complex, enveloping, smoky-warm Head notes: Saffron, cumin, oud, cypriol Fragrance intensity: High (eau de parfum)

listings.rawTitle: Liquides Imaginaires Les Eaux de L'Est Eau de Parfum Spray Fleur de Sable 50 ml
listings.description: The inspiration for this extraordinary niche perfume comes from the idea of a crystalline flower that thrives in the midst of dry dunes and defies the harsh desert wind. As part of the Les Eaux de L'Est collection, the Liquides Imaginaires brand presents Fleur de Sable, an olfactory journey that artfully combines spicy and floral elements. It opens with a fresh, almost mineral combination of bergamot, mandarin and a pinch of pink pepper, accompanied by an imaginary wind note and salty accents. At the centre of the creation developed by Amélie Bourgeois is wild eglantine, also known as dog rose, which is given a gentle, characterful sharpness by the unusual addition of paprika. Nuances of black pepper, myrrh and iris, which combine harmoniously with ambroxan, provide a profound finish in the base note. The cylindrical bottle with its transparent glass underside and striking gold-coloured cap with embossed ring underlines the exclusivity of the eau de parfum spray. Floral-spicy fragrance composition with mineral and salty accents. Top note combines bergamot, pink pepper and a special wind note. Heart notes of wild dog rose (eglantine) and paprika. Base note with myrrh, iris, black pepper and ambroxan. Elegant bottle with gold-coloured details and transparent glass base.

listings.rawTitle: Liquides Imaginaires Les Eaux Imaginaire Eau de Parfum Spray Île Pourpre 50 ml
listings.description: The olfactory journey to the "purple island" begins with an unusual, green freshness. Shiso leaves combine with the fine acidity of Italian bergamot and the subtle spiciness of ginger in the top note, while angelica seeds and incense add the first aromatic accents. The characteristic, dark fruity aroma of black fig then unfolds at the centre of the composition. This heart note is given a complex and multi-layered depth by the addition of fenugreek, davana and iris. The eau de parfum is supported by a solid base of cedar, patchouli and cashmeran, which is rounded off with ambroxan and provides a woody finish. As part of the Les Eaux Imaginaire collection, this creation represents the artisanal expertise of the Parisian brand Liquides Imaginaires. The design also emphasises its mystical character: the cylindrical bottle has a dark red body emblazoned with the silver lettering "ÎLE POURPRE". listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Fleur de Lait Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Fleur de Lait Eau de Parfum Spray by Miu Miu is a composition that is reminiscent of an exotic dessert and caresses the senses with a creamy texture. This floral-fruity fragrance is characterised by its bold yet feminine character, inspired by the carefree lightness of a mango dessert. The fragrance journey begins with the juicy and full note of mango in the top note. The floral subtlety of delicate osmanthus blossoms unfolds at the heart of the creation, lending the perfume an elegant facet. The base note of velvety coconut milk rounds off the olfactory experience and lends it a pleasant, sweet depth. The interplay of fruity juiciness, floral delicacy and creamy warmth creates a sensual yet sophisticated fragrance experience. For optimum development, the spray can be applied to warm areas of skin such as the wrists or neck, where the body heat intensifies the notes. Fragrance: Floral and fruity Character: Creamy, sensual and carefree Fragrance notes: Mango, osmanthus, coconut milk

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu L'eau Bleue Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Miu Miu L'eau Bleue captures the essence of a clear spring morning in a green, floral fragrance composition. Created in 2016 by perfumer Daniela Andrier, the eau de parfum epitomises carefree lightness and timeless elegance. It opens with the delicate and fresh note of lily of the valley, reminiscent of a walk through a dewy garden. At the heart of the composition, the green aroma of violet leaf unfolds, giving the fragrance its characteristic accent. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a gentle base of white musk, which creates a clear impression. The fragrance is presented in the characteristic, faceted turquoise bottle with a pastel yellow cap, whose design is inspired by Miu Miu's iconic matelassé bags. Its fresh nature makes L'eau Bleue a suitable companion for everyday wear, especially on warm days. listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu L'eau de Muguet Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Miu Miu L'eau de Muguet Eau de Parfum Spray captures a youthful and lively mood and presents itself as the first women's fragrance from the House of Miu Miu. The composition belongs to the olfactory family of fresh floral fragrances and is characterised by its contrasting facets. It opens with the clear and unmistakable note of lily of the valley, which gives the fragrance its characteristic freshness. As the fragrance progresses, green accords and the subtle nuances of dog rose unfold in the heart, leading to a surprising finale. The base note of Akigalawood provides depth and an exciting accent. This special woody accord with its earthy and subtly peppery notes creates a fascinating contrast to the floral lightness. The result is a clear, clean fragrance that emphasises a playful yet bold femininity. For optimal development, we recommend applying to warm areas of skin such as the wrists or neck, as body heat intensifies the fragrance notes. A fresh, floral fragrance with a contrasting character. Fragrance composition of lily of the valley, dog rose and earthy Akigalawood. Belongs to the floral frais fragrance family. Eau de parfum spray for women.

listings.rawTitle: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Finale Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: The J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Finale Eau de Parfum Spray is a tribute to the vibrant stage life of Berlin, where classic elegance meets modern avant-garde. This opulent and warm unisex fragrance captures the climax of an emotionally charged moment. The composition starts with an intense, fruity-spicy opening of red pepper, davana and a hint of nectarine liqueur. A captivating interplay of tobacco, sweet-resinous benzoin and black datura unfolds in the heart note. The long-lasting fragrance experience is rounded off by a base of balsamic and woody notes. Vetiver, amber and guaiac wood give the fragrance its characteristic depth and warmth. As a modern reinterpretation of a classic from 1914, Finale combines tradition with a visionary spirit. Fragrance character: Woody and balsamic Special notes: Red pepper, tobacco, guaiac wood Inspiration: A tribute to Berlin stage life Fragrance type: Opulent and warm unisex fragrance

listings.rawTitle: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin 1A - 33 Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The name, the fragrance, the brand - everything about this unisex fragrance is unusual. In 2012, the company J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin, originally founded in 1856, was revitalised by three young designers and began its triumphal march with the Eau de Parfum Spray 1A - 33. At the turn of the century, this was Berlin's car registration number. The bottle is just as classic as the name, with its straightforward shape standing out from the mass of ornate and decorated bottles. At the same time, it arouses curiosity about the clear, delicately golden contents. The fragrance 1A - 33 by J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin was first launched over 100 years ago for women; the 2012 reinterpretation is aimed at both men and women. A piece of Berlin history that everyone loves The eau de parfum spray is fresh and floral , perfect for summer and spring, with top notes of mandarin and red pepper. The design team created the heart note with lime blossom, magnolia and jasmine sambac. Finally, iris and cedarwood create a warm finish that makes 1A - 33 a very special summer unisex fragrance. Less is more and J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin has achieved the feat of creating an eau de parfum spray that perfectly combines freshness and warmth . Let yourself be seduced by this unusual fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Treffpunkt 8 Uhr Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Intense flavours for men and women The eau de parfum spray Meeting Point 8 o'clock comes from the product repertoire of the J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin brand. The fragrance pays homage to love stories and flirting and is therefore called "8 o'clock" - a reminder of the typical time for evening dates. The reinterpretation of the classic is based on a blend of intense essences such as mango, ginger and vetiver. The elegant aromas are framed by sage and lily, creating a stylish fragrance that can be worn in any situation. An exciting fragrance with an elegant twist With the eau de parfum spray Meeting Point 8 o'clock from J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin, you can enjoy an attractive fragrance experience that is enchanting and stimulating. The woody main fragrance note is framed by exotic scent nuances, which are intended to reflect the excitement and tension of a first date. The high-quality character of the fragrance can already be recognised by the design of the bottle. This is in elegant gold tones, which are intended to honour the special and exceptionally valuable character of the fragrance. Be ready for your first date and surround yourself with an intense fragrance that conveys a special flair.

listings.rawTitle: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Fougair Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Unisex, spicy and fresh , that's the scent of the Fougair eau de parfum spray. It comes from the small but fine niche label J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin. Launched in 2021, the fine fragrance breaks new ground and leaves the path that J.F. Schwarzlose in Berlin set with its formulas at the beginning of the 20th century. Fougair Eau de Parfum Spray has top notes of fern, pink pepper and bergamot. The heart note consists of artemesia, boxwood and cypress. Fir balsam forms the intense prelude to the base and blends with amber and patchouli. When past and present become the future When the founders of J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin found the old formulas and adapted them to modern requirements and specifications, it was more than important to them to maintain the classic, the art and the olfactory aesthetics. And it is precisely these demands that new creations such as Fougair must also fulfil. The eau de parfum is expressive, but not overpowering. It is perceptible and discreet and a wonderful all-rounder that is suitable anytime and anywhere. J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin has not only created a new fragrance, but also a signature fragrance. Ladies and gentlemen who appreciate something special will love the Fougair eau de parfum spray.

listings.rawTitle: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Etrango Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Etrango by J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin is a unique and vibrant unisex fragrance that reflects the diversity and charm of the city of Berlin . The perfume manufacturer J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin is one of the most renowned houses in Germany. Since 1929, unique and fantastic fragrance creations have been created in the heart of Berlin, which are now sought after worldwide. The Eau de Parfum Spray in its glamorous gold and black bottle is also a coveted collector's item. Fragrance description Etrango J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin The unisex fragrance is inspired by exotic spices, fresh citrus fruits and the diversity that characterises the city of Berlin. It is opulent, exotic and sensual at the same time. The top note is dominated by the fresh scent of bergamot and rounded off with cumin and saffron . The imaginative heart is formed by precious jasmine and the noble Damask rose as well as a pinch of carnation. The base and the long-lasting part of the fragrance is made up of patchouli, oakmoss and cypriol . Other natural fragrance components round off this exclusive eau de parfum spray. Immerse yourself in the fantastic world of fragrances by J.F. Schwarzlose and experience a sensational and unforgettable perfume that is just as multifaceted and interesting as the capital city of Berlin.

listings.description: Acqua Alpes Oud 3333 is a complex fragrance composition inspired by the majestic Schaufelspitze in the Tyrolean Alps, whose altitude of 3333 metres gives the eau de parfum its name. This unisex perfume unfolds its spicy, woody elegance both during the day and in the evening. It opens with a fresh, citrusy note of bergamot, which gently fades into a heart of incense and jasmine. However, the true depth and unmistakable character of the fragrance unfold in the base note. Here, the dominant note is a strong vanilla which, in combination with ambroxan, benzoin and elegant woody notes, creates a remarkable warmth. The result is a fragrance with a long-lasting presence that is particularly suitable for the evening hours or the cooler months of the year. The overall impression is rounded off by the stylish, deep black bottle, which is adorned with the iconic Mercedes-Benz star. A warm, spicy fragrance with a dominant vanilla note. Composition of bergamot, incense, jasmine and a woody base. Characterised by a long-lasting fragrance presence. Presented in an elegant, black bottle with a Mercedes-Benz star.

listings.description: The Mercedes-Benz Club Black Eau de Parfum Spray is a striking composition from the amber fragrance family. It opens with a crisp top note of fresh Calabrian bergamot and elemi, creating a striking first impression. At the heart of the fragrance, warm and woody accords then unfold, lending the creation a special depth and an expressive character. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience and leaves a lasting impression through the harmonious interplay of vanilla and warm amber. This composition offers a distinct identity and an appealing fragrance signature. The bottle follows the characteristic design of the Mercedes-Benz Club range, with the glass in a warm red-orange hue and the Mercedes logo adorning the front. Fragrance family: Amber-based Top notes: Calabrian bergamot and elemi Base notes: Vanilla and amber Character: A distinctive composition with warm, woody notes

listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume Man Eau de Toilette Spray Star 50 ml
listings.description: The refreshing Mercedes Benz Perfume Man Star Eau de Toilette Spray delights men with a subtle fragrance nuance composed of the finest essences. Delicate fruity pears, tart oakmoss, woody notes of rosewood and genuine musk mallow seed combine to create a tantalising fragrance that transports masculine men into a world of adventure. Created exclusively by the luxury brand Mercedes, Mercedes Benz Perfume is a contemporary fragrance experience for active, sporty men who love fast cars. Perfumer Oliver Cresp created the fragrance in 2015 for the Mercedes fragrance world. The masculine spray is available in two different sizes. Man Star Eau de Toilette Spray - fragrance for discerning men The dominant Mercedes Benz Perfume Man Star Eau de Toilette Spray is bottled in a visually appealing bottle in the colours black, silver and blue. The dark bottle with the silver-coloured star on a shimmering blue background is a symbol of the luxurious cars from Mercedes. At first glance, it is reminiscent of a car key that promises an exciting drive. The name of the eau de toilette can be read on the side of the dark bottle. Each spray from the innovatively designed eau de toilette spray lasts a long time on the skin and hair.

listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume Woman in Red Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Woman in Red - interesting Eau de Parfum Spray A Mercedes Benz perfume like Woman in Red demonstrates the versatility of parfumdreams.de. This perfume for women is characterised by the harmony of its individual fragrance components. There are scents of fruit that meet jasmine and gardenia in the heart. In the base note, benzoin, patchouli, sandalwood and tonka bean round off the entire composition perfectly. The well-known perfumer Honorine Blanc was responsible for creating this fantastic fragrance. The Eau de Parfum Spray Mercedes Benz Perfume is a fragrance that is well worth trying. Personal experience is always the best. The secret lies between pear and tonka bean As is so often the case, the secret to an impressive fragrance experience is the successful combination of top, heart and base notes. The top note of the Eau de Parfum Spray Woman in Red begins with mandarin, cherry blossom, pear and pistachio. This is followed by heart notes of gardenia and jasmine sambac. The fragrance complex is rounded off in the base note with benzoin, patchouli, sandalwood and tonka bean. The end result is a very well harmonised product. Parts and fragrances that harmonise perfectly with each other are the basis for a reliably functioning combination of fragrance nuances. When fragrances go together, everything is good!

listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume Sign Eau de Parfum Spray Your Power / 50 ml
listings.description: The Mercedes-Benz Perfume Sign Eau de Parfum Spray is a creation by perfumer Olivier Cresp that reveals a special depth and intensity. It opens with a multi-faceted top note in which spicy cardamom from sustainable cultivation in Guatemala meets pink pepper, grapefruit and apple. At the heart of the composition, a bouquet of lavender, orange blossom and rose geranium unfolds, creating a balanced elegance. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with warm and woody accords. Tonka bean, cashmere wood and patchouli combine here to create a long-lasting and striking base. The result is a modern yet timeless fragrance that impresses with the sophisticated balance of its high-quality ingredients. Powerful and intense fragrance composition by perfumer Olivier Cresp Characterised by a spicy top note with sustainable cardamom Balanced interplay of fresh, floral and warm woody notes The base note is characterised by tonka bean, cashmere wood and patchouli

listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume The Move Eau de Toilette Spray 60 ml
listings.description: "The Move" by Mercedes Benz Perfume is an eau de toilette spray made for the man who never stands still, is always on the move and is constantly setting himself new goals, which he intends to achieve with a pleasantly fresh fragrance behind him. The aromatic fragrance of "The Move" is dominated by various marine notes and transports its wearer to the sea, vibrant coastal cities and faraway lands. The minimalist bottle with its oval shape and innovative spray cap is also pleasantly eye-catching - the Mercedes logo is of course clearly visible on the front and is cleverly accentuated by the azure blue colour. To the sea with Mercedes Benz Perfume With its pleasantly light fragrance silhouette, the eau de toilette spray "The Move" is a successful all-rounder and escapes typical conventions. It is therefore undoubtedly aimed at a young or young-at-heart target group. The cardamom, tonka bean and grapefruit accords, for example, dominate this eau de toilette spray from Mercedes Benz Perfume. Many of the accords in this fragrance are those that we naturally associate with trips to the seaside. The eau de toilette is free from silicones, palm oil and parabens and has no oily ingredients, making it feel almost weightless.

listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume Air, Sea & Land Eau de Parfum Spray Sea 30 ml
listings.description: Like the Air product, the Sea Eau de Parfum Spray from Mercedes Benz Perfume is inspired by nature . Sea & Land and the air are the inspiration for these unique fragrances. A perfume like this conveys the longing for freedom and the departure for something new. The whole thing is packaged in a very stylish, refillable bottle made of aluminium and recycled glass. Even the outer packaging is something special: it contains small amounts of algae. Every perfume in this range is unusual and aromatic release for suppressed energies . The balancing base is formed by the woody scent of patchouli and the resinous and tart note of turmeric. The Sea Eau de Parfum Spray is just as special as the Parfum Air and the Land product. This fragrance trilogy conveys the elements of air, sea and land in an intense way.

listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume Air, Sea & Land Eau de Parfum Spray Air 60 ml
listings.description: With Air by Mercedes Benz Perfume , the name says it all: the creation by French perfumer Anne Flipo impresses with its airy and aromatic freshness. The men's fragrance is part of the Air, Sea & Land line launched in 2023. It combines modernity and sportiness to create an extremely versatile fragrance. Fresh all-rounder with modern appeal The fresh aura of Air Eau de Parfum Spray is created by a top note of mugwort in combination with citrusy essences. This is mixed with a further floral accent of angelica in the heart note. A masculine, spicy-woody base of turmeric leaf and patchouli discreetly rounds off this fragrance for men by Mercedes Benz Perfume. Air Eau de Parfum Spray is a light fragrance with an uncomplicated character. This makes it the perfect choice for a wide variety of occasions - for business, sport and leisure. A special feature: this perfume can be worn on its own or combined with the other two creations from the Air, Sea & Land collection. This creates a unique fragrance experience.

listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume For Men Eau de Parfum Spray Ultimate 75 ml
listings.description: The Mercedes Benz For Men Ultimate Eau de Parfum Spray is an expressive composition that was created to celebrate the 10th anniversary of the popular For Men range. This fragrance from the amber-woody family is characterised by its multifaceted and elegant character. It opens with a combination of lavender and cedarwood that exudes an aromatic freshness. The heart of the fragrance then unfolds, in which fruity notes of mandarin and apple meet the spicy warmth of nutmeg. This combination creates an exciting contrast that leads into a profound base. Here, cypress, patchouli, sandalwood and amber provide a woody and warm finish. As an eau de parfum, the creation has a high concentration of fragrance oils, which ensures intense perception. The fragrance is a companion for various occasions and underlines its striking features, especially in autumn and winter. Fragrance direction: Amber-woody Character: Fresh, spicy and woody-warm Fragrance intensity: Eau de Parfum Special feature: Anniversary edition of the For Men range

listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume Floral Fantasy Eau de Toilette Spray 60 ml
listings.description: With the Mercedes Benz Perfume Floral Fantasy Eau de Toilette Spray, there are literally no limits to your imagination - at least not when it comes to choosing your perfume. This feminine creation clearly demonstrates that neither beautiful cars nor multi-layered fragrances are the exclusive preserve of men. The feminine perfume, which features a beautiful floral bouquet on the bottle, is almost weightlessly light, is suitable for everyday wear as well as the office and, unsurprisingly, captivates with many beautiful floral fragrance accords. A perfume as colourful as spring The Mercedes Benz Perfume Floral Fantasy Eau de Toilette Spray opens with a multi-layered top note that harmonises powerful blackcurrants with carrot seeds, various citrus fruits and blood orange. The fruity fruit platter is then complemented by the eponymous floral accords in the heart note of Mercedes Benz Perfume Floral Fantasy Eau de Toilette Spray: Neroli, tea leaves and carrot seeds make for an imaginative and by no means standardised composition that demonstrates a great love of creativity. In order to ground the fruity-floral fragrance silhouette and wrap it in a subtle frame, the fragrance finally moves on to various warm woods, moss and musk in its base note.

listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume Floral Fantasy Eau de Toilette Spray 90 ml
listings.description: With the Mercedes Benz Perfume Floral Fantasy Eau de Toilette Spray, there are literally no limits to your imagination - at least not when it comes to choosing your perfume. This feminine creation clearly demonstrates that neither beautiful cars nor multi-layered fragrances are the exclusive preserve of men. The feminine perfume, which features a beautiful floral bouquet on the bottle, is almost weightlessly light, is suitable for everyday wear as well as the office and, unsurprisingly, captivates with many beautiful floral fragrance accords. A perfume as colourful as spring The Mercedes Benz Perfume Floral Fantasy Eau de Toilette Spray opens with a multi-layered top note that harmonises powerful blackcurrants with carrot seeds, various citrus fruits and blood orange. In order to ground the fruity-floral fragrance silhouette and wrap it in a subtle frame, the fragrance finally moves on to various warm woods, moss and musk in its base note.

listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume Air, Sea & Land Eau de Parfum Spray 60 ml
listings.description: Many people know Mercedes Benz from the automotive industry. The vehicle manufacturer is one of the best-known German companies in the automotive industry. Mercedes Benz Perfume is a noble series that not only inspires car drivers. The Air, Sea & Land perfume is a three-part fragrance that combines the elements of everyday life. The Air eau de parfum spray contains airy fragrance notes that have an energising effect. The sea exudes maritime odours and there are so many natural scents on land that it takes a special sense of smell to create a fragrance worthy of Mercedes. The top note is dominated by the spiciness of pepper. A powerful fragrance that sharpens the wearer's senses. Although there are many masculine elements in the fragrance spray, it is by no means masculine in character. Eau de Parfum Spray from the Mercedes Benz Perfume line Cocoa is considered a sweet in everyday life. Natural cocoa is very aromatic, slightly sour and only tastes and smells pleasant when sweetness is added. In the Eau de Parfum Spray, cocoa dominates in the heart note. In the base note, Air, Sea & Land by Mercedes Benz Perfume contains the harmonious scent of tonka bean. The fragrance combination is the ideal gift for self-confident people.

listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume Sign Eau de Toilette Spray Your Attitude / 50 ml
listings.description: In 2022, Mercedes Benz Perfume introduces the Sign Your Attitude Eau de Toilette Spray. It is a fresh green part of the Sign Collection and was developed for men. Like every perfume from the Mercedes Benz Perfume Sign Collection, the eau de toilette spray comes in a striking bottle that is instantly recognisable. After all, the star is emblazoned on the large rectangular bottle. The Sign Your Attitude bottle is silver in colour, while the other perfume bottles in the collection are black and blue. The perfumer of the eau de toilette spray is the great Fabrice Pellegrin. He combines the flavours of bergamot, ginger and mandarin in the top note. Lavender, cinnamon, nutmeg and cypress form the centre, with amberwood as a soloist at the end. Full luxury, on the street and in the bottle Mercedes Benz Perfume takes luxury off the street and puts it on the skin. Your Attitude Eau de Toilette is for men who like to appear well-groomed , but don't want to surround themselves with an overpowering perfume. The eau de toilette spray is simply the perfect companion anytime and anywhere, just like its travelling equivalent. The fragrance is simply a must, not just for fans of Mercedes Benz.
