Roberto Ugolini Derby Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Roberto Ugolini: This name stands for the Florentine way of life. Born into a family of shoemakers, he learnt the traditional craft at an early age. Simple repair work was followed by the step to becoming a shoe designer. His Italian flair for fashion and exceptional craftsmanship allowed him to design and produce marvellous shoe models. His fragrances are inspired by the characteristics of the shoes. With Derby, he presents an elegant spicy, woody unisex fragrance . Derby: a stylish, sporty fragrance for him and her The Derby is a versatile shoe model. Depending on the design, it can be worn with an elegant suit or casual chic. It is comfortable in any case. And when the shoe is made by a master of his trade like Roberto Ugolini, it is a stylish, unique model. The two perfumers Cristian Calabrò and Maurizio Cerizza have created a multi-faceted eau de parfum spray to match the shoe type, which can be worn by men and women on numerous occasions. The herbaceous, spicy fragrance of mugwort, basil and cardamom forms the top note. Cinnamon, caraway and allspice mingle with jasmine and myrrh in the heart note. The eau de parfum spray closes with a complex base accord of patchouli, birch, vetiver and musk, complemented by fine sandalwood and cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Ugolini 4 Rosso Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: 4 Rosso - an unusual name for an eau de parfum spray. But anyone who has ever visited Florence can solve the riddle. It is a business address that is marked in red in the Italian city. To be precise, it is the address of Roberto Ugolini, the Florentine shoe designer. The luxurious, exciting fragrance is aimed at all perfume lovers who attach particular importance to style and elegance. 4 Rosso - a creative unisex fragrance with Italian flair Most of Roberto Ugolini's fragrance creations are dedicated to shoe types and their peculiarities. The two Rosso fragrances are somewhat different. As with its predecessor 17 Rosso, 4 Rosso also focuses on the current business address of the renowned shoe designer. This fragrance reflects his creativity and craftsmanship. It is a reminder of how a harmonious whole is created from numerous, sometimes very different individual parts. The attractive eau de parfum spray will appeal to ladies and men alike. The multi-layered Ugolini fragrance opens unusually with saffron, smoky notes, angelica and a dash of bergamot. In the heart note, damask rose and ylang-ylang are given a spicy sharpness by black pepper. The base accord of musk, guaiac and ambergris is refined with sweet caramel and bourbon vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Ugolini Azzurro Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Azzurro Eau de Parfum Spray by Roberto Ugolini is an olfactory creation that captivates with its fruity, aquatic character. The fragrance opens with a lively and sparkling top note of grapefruit, juicy strawberry and a hint of coconut, which is elegantly accentuated by the subtle spiciness of pink pepper. A multi-layered bouquet of precious damask rose, davana and delicate magnolia unfolds in the heart note. This floral elegance is elevated to a special level by the fruity depth of blackcurrant and a sparkling champagne note. A warm and gentle base of amberwood, musk and ambergris rounds off the composition and gives it a pleasant depth. Designed as a unisex fragrance, Azzurro shows remarkable versatility and is suitable as a fresh, light companion for day and evening, especially on warmer days. It is a fragrance for all those who appreciate an unusual yet harmonious composition. Fragrance direction: Fruity, aquatic Character: Fresh, light and versatile Fragrance notes: A composition of fruits, flowers and warm woods Special feature: A universally applicable unisex fragrance

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Ugolini Loafer Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Loafer is actually the name of a Roberto Ugolini eau de parfum spray. The fragrance is floral and spicy , is aimed at both men and women and impresses with its above-average longevity. Why Roberto Ugolini named his fragrance after the loafer shoe is actually quite easy to explain. Loafers are fun, are popular and worn by men and women alike, are super comfortable, offer a casual elegance and are very pleasant to wear. Just like the Loafer eau de parfum spray. It really can be that simple Maybe it's a quirk, maybe it's effective advertising to name a perfume after a shoe. In any case, you can't get the scent out of your nose. This is due to the top notes of orange and cloves, the heart notes of rose geranium, nutmeg, amber and ylang-ylang and the base notes of vanilla, musk and patchouli. After a strong opening, the fragrance develops beautifully. In its entirety, Roberto Ugolini Eau de Parfum Spray delights with its expressive sillage, which is expressly masculine for men. For women, on the other hand, the unisex fragrance is more elegant, spicy and soft . In any case, this creation is incredibly harmonious and simply perfect for chilly days.

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Ugolini Kitten Heel Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The inspiration for this eau de parfum comes from the mid-heeled shoe of the same name, which stands for timeless elegance and carefree comfort. Roberto Ugolini translates these attributes into a multi-faceted olfactory composition that harmoniously combines fruity and woody nuances. The fragrance opens with a lively blend of rose geranium and exotic ylang-ylang, accompanied by fruity accents reminiscent of the sweetness of peach or apricot. As the fragrance develops, a warm, deep heart unfolds, in which amber, sandalwood and patchouli meet the slightly smoky aroma of guaiac wood. This complex structure finally leads to a soft base of musk, vanilla and tonka bean, which gives the fragrance a creamy and long-lasting finish. Visually, the bottle reflects the Florentine brand's tradition of craftsmanship. The striking red glass corresponds with a beige label, which is adorned with a golden rim and the brand crest. A marbled clasp in shades of white and brown, reminiscent of natural horn, and leather-look applications emphasise the close connection to traditional shoe craftsmanship. Made in Italy, the creation offers an intense presence with a fragrance oil concentration of 20%. Fruity-woody fragrance profile with creamy accents Contains notes of ylang-ylang, sandalwood, amber and vanilla High fragrance oil concentration of 20% for long-lasting fragrance Red glass bottle with horn-look cap Unisex fragrance, made in Italy

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Ugolini High Heel White Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The High Heel White eau de parfum spray is an exception from Roberto Ugolini. The green and spicy fragrance from 2019 is the only women's fragrance from this great label. In keeping with the name, the bottle of the fragrance is white and has a wooden cap. For Roberto Ugolini, high heels are the epitome of femininity, the expression of style, charm and a certain sex appeal. These extremely feminine shoes were introduced by style icons such as Marlene Dietrich at the beginning of the last century. In memory of this grande dame, the Eau de Parfum Spray High Heel White is sensual, sexy, feminine, elegant and perfect for the grand entrance, wherever and whenever it takes place. Feminine doesn't have to be sweet Roberto Ugolini shows how beautiful unsweet fragrances can be with the Eau de Parfum Spray High Heel White. The top note consists of mandarins and lemons as well as galbanum and coriander. The heart note carries the flavours of iris, roses, lily of the valley, rose geranium and cardamom. The base of woods, incense, tonka bean, amberwood, patchouli and vanilla is soft. If you like expressive fragrances without sweetness, then High Heels White is a must. Because the freshness and harmony of this fragrance is unrivalled. A real all-rounder.

Toni Gard Toni Eau de Parfum Spray 40 ml
listings.description: The Toni Eau de Parfum Spray by Toni Gard offers a modern interpretation of a fragrance that breaks away from classic structures. Instead of a sequence of top, heart and base notes, this molecular composition unfolds immediately upon contact with the skin. There, the fragrance develops a very personal and individual signature. The composition is characterised by a clear, woody character that emerges from a sophisticated blend of white cedarwood and woody amber. Facets of ambroxan and musk lend the creation a subtle depth and warmth. Conceived entirely without floral notes, the result is a straightforward and purist fragrance experience. The perfume is positioned as a unisex fragrance and is aimed at anyone looking for something special. The formula is also 100 per cent vegan and was produced without animal testing. Molecular fragrance without a classic fragrance pyramid Woody composition with white cedarwood, ambroxan and musk Unfolds immediately and develops individually on every skin Designed as a unisex fragrance 100% vegan and produced without animal testing

listings.rawTitle: Toni Gard Seaside Woman Eau de Parfum Spray 40 ml
listings.description: Seaside Woman is a fresh, light fragrance by Toni Gard. Toni Gard is an established fashion and design house from Düsseldorf that was founded in the mid-1960s. The company's philosophy has always been to create elegant and luxurious products that are not too obtrusive, but rather emphasise a good dose of understatement . And the Seaside Woman eau de parfum spray fits in perfectly with this guiding principle. A fragrance with a fruity note Seaside Woman is just the right perfume for confident women who want to emphasise their youthfulness and freshness at the same time. It is also intended to convey the beautiful, free feeling of a relaxing day by the sea. Aromatically, the notes of melon, cassis, juniper berries, lemon, amber, musk and soft woods as well as roses, magnolias and lily of the valley in the heart note create a successful overall composition. The eau de parfum spray is available in either a 40-millilitre or 90-millilitre bottle. The design of the bottle itself exudes a restrained yet fresh elegance that perfectly complements the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Toni Gard Iconic Eau de Parfum Spray 40 ml
listings.description: Woody, warm and expressive , the Iconic Eau de Parfum Spray by Toni Gard envelops you. The fragrance is aimed at women who strive for a special radiance through scents and are not averse to a slightly magical, mystical note. It also has a special feature: Typical elements of women's fragrances are left out. Warm and woody instead of fruity and floral Enchant yourself and those around you with the woody, intense fragrance from Toni Gard! It opens with cedar wood and thus goes straight into the warm depths. Ambroxan in the heart note and amber in the base note lend the fragrance and its wearer a mysterious charm. Fruity notes and floral elements, which are typical of many women's fragrances, have been deliberately left out here. Instead, the character of the fragrance takes you straight into the naturalness of nature and reveals its intensely fragrant secrets. The fact that this is Toni Gard's eau de parfum spray cannot be overlooked from the bottle. It is emblazoned with the word "TONI" in eye-catching letters. You will also stand out with Iconic! Some women long for an eau de parfum spray that consciously stands out from other perfumes. You've found it here! Emphasise your individuality with Toni Gard Iconic.

listings.description: The My Honey Eau de Parfum Spray by Toni Gard is a composition that combines fruity lightness with floral elegance. The fragrance opens with a sparkling top note that combines the juicy flavours of honeydew, nectarine and mirabelle plum with a hint of red fruits. Shortly afterwards, the centrepiece of the fragrance unfolds: a delicate bouquet of lotus blossom, white jasmine and magnolia, which provides a clear note. In the base, the composition is completed by the warm accents of light woods and soft musk. This base note gives the fragrance a pleasant depth and ensures that the fruity sweetness is harmoniously balanced. The result is a discreet and unobtrusive fragrance that is ideal for everyday wear and leisure and leaves behind a natural aura. listings.description: TRUE, the eau de toilette spray from TONI GARD, stands for strength, sincerity and reliability: a sensual fragrance for men who know what they want because they are not afraid to look deeper into their souls. Since 1965, the lifestyle and fashion brand TONI GARD has been developing elegant, high-class fashion and beauty products for men who always move with the times and dare to remain a gentleman through and through. The eau de toilette spray for the modern gentleman The designer's fragrances and cosmetics are made with exclusive ingredients that give each perfume and moisturising cream its individual, intensifying effect. TONI GARD's Eau de Toilette Spray TRUE has been composed by its perfumers from citrus extracts, violet blossom, musk, iris and moss. This gives the fragrance its unmistakable woody and at the same time aquatic-fresh note: masculine sensuality , reduced to calm and clear depth. A fragrance that radiates strength and straightforwardness: "Understatement means luxury" , as TONI GARD once formulated it as a credo for his fashion label and the traditional Düsseldorf house. Enjoy TRUE, the aura of simple elegance!

listings.description: The Secret Potion N.1 Eau de Parfum Spray by BULLFROG pays homage to the mysterious atmosphere of speakeasy bars during the Prohibition era in the 1920s. As the first fragrance from the Italian brand, which has its origins in a barbershop in Milan, it presents itself as an olfactory cocktail full of sophistication and depth. The composition opens with top notes of bergamot, patchouli, black pepper and a hint of cinnamon. At the heart, the unmistakable character of the fragrance is revealed through the prominent notes of rum, whisky and absinthe, which meet a warm leather accord. This interplay captures the mood of a secret meeting place. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a base of vanilla, amber, vetiver and the distinctive flavours of tobacco and coffee beans. Made in Italy, this woody, aromatic eau de parfum is aimed at anyone who appreciates an elegant and nostalgic fragrance with a strong character. Inspired by the mysterious atmosphere of the speakeasy bars of the 1920s. A woody-aromatic fragrance composition with warm and spicy notes. Characteristic aromas of rum, whisky, leather and tobacco characterise the fragrance. Eau de Parfum in a 100 ml bottle, made in Italy.

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Elisir Eau de Parfum Spray N.1 Deadly Nightshade 100 ml
listings.description: Elisir N.1 Deadly Nightshade Eau de Parfum Spray from BULLFROG is a very special fragrance. Because it is the first organic perfume from the barbershop label. BULLFROG is known for its uncompromising men's fragrances, which often only bear the name of one ingredient, around which the men's fragrances are then designed. But Elisir N.1 Deadly Nightshade Eau de Parfum Spray is different. The top note features fruity oranges and citrusy bergamot. The heart note features black orchids with tonka beans and leather. They are complemented by tobacco and cedarwood in the base. Men love this fragrance from BULLFROG, because it was inspired by a visit to the barbershop. This is masculine elegance in absolute perfection. Really just for him There are numerous men's fragrances that are also aimed, at least covertly, at women. However, Elisir N.1 Deadly Nightshade Eau de Parfum Spray is reserved exclusively for men. When creating it, BULLFROG had men in mind who also want to appear well-groomed and with a wonderfully masculine, woody and spicy fragrance in their leisure time. Deadly Nightshade is a fragrance with above-average longevity and a strong sillage. Just right for men who are also looking for something special in their fragrances in organic quality.

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Elements Eau de Toilette Spray Earth 100 ml
listings.description: The Elements collection from BULLFROG is dedicated to the four fundamental forces of nature, with ElementsEarth Eau de Toilette Spray capturing the essence of the earth. This composition aims to interpret stability and groundedness olfactorily. The fragrance opens with fresh citrus notes of mandarin, orange and bitter grapefruit. This invigorating start flows smoothly into a spicy heart note. This is where exotic spices and striking Sichuan pepper meet the floral accents of African rose geranium. A warm base of various woods rounds off the fragrance and gives it its characteristic, long-lasting finish. The design visually emphasises the concept with a transparent glass bottle that reveals the light yellow liquid. A brown label with a drawn rock motif and the black cap complete the look. Made in Italy, this fragrance stands for a harmonious combination of freshness and warmth. Fragrance family: A balanced blend of woody and citrusy notes. Top notes: Fresh accents of mandarin, orange and bitter grapefruit. Heart note: Spicy interplay of Sichuan pepper, exotic spices and African rose geranium. Base note: Warm, earthy woody notes for a solid finish. Design: 100 ml glass bottle with themed rock motif label, made in Italy.

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Men's fragrances Eau de Parfum Spray N.2 100 ml
listings.description: BULLFROG Eau de Parfum Spray Secret Potion N.2 is one of those men's fragrances that is almost impossible to describe. We'll try anyway: Cool art work by Ramon Maiden meets a spicy, delicate fragrance from BULLFROG. Secret composition as a special fragrance feature Normally, we would present the essences that make up the top, heart and base notes of the fragrance here. However, as the name suggests, the composition of Eau de Parfum Spray Secret Potion N.2 remains a secret. Are you ready to embark on an adventure? This time, the potpourri is aimed at fans of the mystical. The fragrance was inspired by a tattoo parlour. It captures the different works of art, but also the artist's worries and thoughts. The bottle features a frog sculpted by Ramon Maiden, who looks like a real gentleman: with a hat and a casual look. Like all men's fragrances from BULLFROG, there is a distinctive mix inside that only gradually reveals itself to the wearer. There are spicy accords, but earthy notes will also unfold. There is also a hint of wood. Do you also trust in the well-kept secret of Eau de Parfum Spray Secret Potion N.2?

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Elisir Eau de Parfum Spray N.2 Palo Santo 100 ml
listings.description: Elisir N.2 Palo Santo Eau de Parfum Spray is one of the aromatic men's fragrances from BULLFROG. The fragrance is spicy and woody and has a captivatingly beautiful and wonderfully short list of ingredients. Just four ingredients are enough for BULLFROG to create an elegant, very wearable masculine fragrance. Bergamot and amber, patchouli and palo santo create Elisir N.2 Palo Santo Eau de Parfum Spray. Palo Santo, the sacred wood, not only gives the fragrance its name, but also its wonderful aura. Palo Santo is a balsam tree, from the same family as myrrh and frankincense, and is strictly protected. Noble men's fragrances that are not mainstream Masculine, elegant, wearable and yet so far removed from the mainstream - these are the men's fragrances from BULLFROG. It is therefore not surprising that the label uses rare woods such as palo santo. The interplay of shade and smoke not only suits every time of day and season, it also emphasises a masculine charisma that doesn't need any grand gestures. With Elisir N.2 Palo Santo Eau de Parfum Spray, BULLFROG is targeting men who like to visit a barbershop and who are aware of the special nature of this men's grooming product and the associated aromas. These men don't wear mainstream men's fragrances , but value something special.

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Elements Eau de Toilette Spray Air 100 ml
listings.description: The Air Eau de Toilette Spray is part of the Elements Collection by BULLFROG launched in 2022. It has a fresh and woody presence that symbolises the freshness and lightness of air. BULLFROG wanted to capture the four basic elements of fire, water, earth and air in fine fragrances, but did not want to create a perfume. This is because most men prefer a somewhat lighter presence. The BULLFROG Elements Air Eau de Toilette Spray has a surprising fragrance pyramid. The top notes are fig leaves and green notes. The heart note combines orris roots with almond milk and fig juice, both of which are rarely found in a perfume. The fragrance is rounded off with vanilla and woody notes. On masculine skin, this composition develops into a sensual presence that flatters its wearer. Dreamy, thoughtful or both A man can have his head in the clouds and still have both feet firmly on the ground. And BULLFROG has developed Elements Air Eau de Toilette Spray precisely for these men. He puts his money where his mouth is and can easily get his hands dirty. But he can also simply relax. And relaxing is even easier when a fine fragrance touches the senses without weighing them down like a perfume.

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Elements Eau de Toilette Spray Water 100 ml
listings.description: In a collection dedicated to the four elements, the Elements Water Eau de Toilette Spray from BULLFROG is a must-have. Structured like a perfume, with a fine fragrance pyramid, the eau de toilette has a fine spicy-woody fragrance . The top notes of ginger and cardamom create a fresh opening. The heart note combines black basil with sage and cedarwood. Amber opens the base and rounds everything off with patchouli and sequoia. BULLFROG dedicates Elements Water Eau de Toilette Spray to men who are constantly on the move, who move things forward and for whom standing still is a horror. Fresh and carefree and constantly on the move Water is not a perfume, but water has a scent. Water is constantly on the move and is the most powerful drink in the world. It brings change and promotes life, has a primal power, but can also gently caress. BULLFROG also attributes this versatility to the men who wear Elements Water Eau de Toilette Spray. They want a light, fresh and modern fragrance that emphasises their personality. They don't need a perfume that weighs them down. And why should they? The masculine Water Eau de Toilette Spray is always and everywhere the perfect companion .

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Elisir Eau de Parfum Spray N.3 Dark Honey 100 ml
listings.description: Complex aromas come together in Elisir N.3 Dark Honey Eau de Parfum Spray to create an olfactory experience that is reminiscent of the tradition of old apothecary art. The Bullfrog brand presents a composition that deliberately plays with contrasts and creates a warm, woody mood. It opens with a fresh top note, in which tangy bergamot and grapefruit mingle with the green accents of galbanum. At the centre of the creation, however, is the eponymous dark honey, which lends the fragrance a deep, gourmand facet. This central accord is grounded by a solid base of leather and woods, which gives the eau de parfum its distinctive and long-lasting character. The combination of sweet and tart nuances creates a multi-layered fragrance profile that evolves as the fragrance is worn. The product also reflects this aesthetic visually: a brown glass bottle with a wooden cap and copper-coloured lettering underlines the classic style of the Elisir range. It is a fragrance that maintains balance and is ideal for lovers of ambery, leathery notes. Woody, gourmand fragrance profile with a distinctive honey note Layered composition of citrus, leather and woods Classic design in a brown glass bottle with wooden cap Inspired by traditional recipes and elixirs Long-lasting eau de parfum concentration

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Men's fragrances Eau de Parfum Spray N.3 100 ml
listings.description: BULLFROG men's fragrances such as Secret Potion N.3 Eau de Parfum Spray are always very elegant and wearable. The fragrance of Secret Potion N.3 Eau de Parfum Spray is spicy-aquatic and is perfect, but not just for summer. Spices, aromatic herbs and maritime notes - that's all this fine fragrance needs to emphasise the masculine charisma of its wearer. The fragrance was created for men who value something special. For them, grooming is more than just a shave in the morning. They celebrate a classic wet shave just as much as they regularly visit a barbershop - or would if they had one nearby. The men who use BULLFROG men's fragrances want to wear a purely masculine presence that is far removed from the mainstream and yet is not an olfactory cudgel. This is how beautiful a masculine fragrance can be At least when it comes from the barbershop label BULLFROG. Founded by Romano Brida, the label combines the classic American barbershop principle with the certain style and flair that the Italians are known for. This is applied not only to the barbershop products in the line, but also to all of the brand's men's fragrances. And thanks to the men's fragrances, such as Secret Potion N.3 Eau de Parfum Spray, you can now enjoy BULLFROG everywhere.

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Elements Eau de Toilette Spray Fire 100 ml
listings.description: An olfactory interpretation of the elemental forces, BULLFROG Elements Fire Eau de Toilette Spray is a striking part of a collection that captures the four elements of nature. This special composition is dedicated to the untamed and passionate energy of fire and translates this inspiration into a modern, multi-layered fragrance experience. The opening is particularly lively and fresh, characterised by the sparkling aromas of mandarin and various citrus peels, which are immediately present. An exciting contrast then develops in the heart of the fragrance, where the cool, herbaceous freshness of mint meets the dark, fruity notes of blackcurrant. The entire fragrance profile is rounded off by a classic, earthy base note, in which patchouli and oakmoss provide the necessary stability and depth. The eau de toilette thus harmoniously combines fruity accents with a solid, earthy base. The design of the bottle also picks up on the theme visually: The light yellow liquid is contained in a round, transparent glass bottle, which is adorned with a red label with a stylised flame graphic and a black, cylindrical cap. Lively citrus fragrance with top notes of mandarin and citrus peel Contrasting heart notes of mint and blackcurrant Earthy base of patchouli and oakmoss for depth and longevity Part of the Elements collection, inspired by the element of fire Transparent glass bottle with themed red label

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Genova Classic Eau de Cologne Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Acqua di Genova - Eau de Cologne Spray Classic is a fragrance with a wonderfully fresh note and very aromatic . This fragrance was created in 1853 by the famous perfumer Stefano Frecceri, who dedicated it to the Royal House of Savoy. The eau de cologne spray is equally suitable for men and women . The Acqua di Genova Eau de Cologne Spray is classic and wonderfully invigorating for all occasions. Subtle, aromatic and refreshing . Acqua di Genova - the scent of the Mediterranean Acqua di Genova Classic delights with its top notes of bergamot, orange, neroli, rosemary, lime and lavender . The heart of this fragrance enchants with floral citrus notes of jasmine, rose and orange , underpinned by amber, patchouli, sandalwood and musk . A truly classic fragrance that never goes out of fashion, caresses the senses and delights the heart .</p

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Genova 1853 Men Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Acqua di Genova 1853 Men Eau de Toilette Spray is a fragrance with a rich history, originally composed in 1853 by Stefano Frecceri for the Royal Court of Savoy. As a creation of the traditional Italian brand, this perfume embodies timeless elegance. The composition opens with an invigorating freshness of bergamot, mandarin and lemon. In the heart note, an aromatic bouquet of lavender, neroli and rose unfolds, which is given a striking depth by spicy pepper and sandalwood. The base rounds off the fragrance experience with warm notes of musk and patchouli, giving it a long-lasting character. The woody, aromatic chypre fragrance is characterised by its tart, fresh yet elegant orientation. It is presented in a stylish bottle with a vintage feel that emphasises its luxurious character. A woody, aromatic men's fragrance with a tart, fresh character . Composition of citrus fruits, lavender, pepper and sandalwood. A historic fragrance classic from the year 1853. Presented in an elegant 100 ml bottle with vintage charm.

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Immense Peony 100 ml
listings.description: In 2020, Angel Schlesser presents the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection with the eau de toilette spray "Immense Peony". The fragrance is unisex and has been given a floral and fresh presence by Ane Ayo. The perfumer only needs three ingredients to achieve this, so that each level of the fragrance pyramid presents a solo fragrance. Juicy and fruity strawberry carry the top note. The heart note features the eponymous peony, while soft musk forms the base. With the Immense Peony Eau de Toilette Spray, Angel Schlesser presents women and men with a wonderfully soft, only slightly sweet fresh fragrance that simply always fits. Casual, casual, elegant - a real all-rounder The Immense Peony Eau de Toilette Spray from the Les Eaux d'un Instant range is not a fragrance for special occasions. The Spanish fashion label Angel Schlesser wants you to be able to wear the unisex fragrance anytime you want. In your free time, at work, during the day or in the evening. Simply enjoy this wonderful peony, which also suits men so well. The Immense Peony Eau de Toilette Spray is a truly ravishing addition to the magnificent Les Eaux d'un Instant range, which has proven that Angel Schlesser can do more than fashion.

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Vibrant Woody Mandarin 100 ml
listings.description: Vibrant Woody Mandarin Eau de Toilette Spray is a charming men's fragrance by Angel Schlesser from the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection. The fragrance character is lively and fresh , reminiscent of a wonderful walk on the beach. The creators found inspiration in the natural world of Italy, for example combining the fruity scent of mandarins with the floral charm of lavender . The overall result is a radiant men's fragrance that brings the feeling of a holiday into your everyday life. Wonderfully versatile Vibrant Woody Mandarin Eau de Toilette Spray Discover the fragrance by Angel Schlesser! Look forward to the versatile ingredients of Les Eaux d'un Instant Vibrant Woody Mandarin Eau de Toilette men's fragrance. It captivates right from the top note with an exciting mix of cardamom, mandarin and lemon. Fresh and spicy, it gently tickles the nose and makes you curious for more. And you get more in the heart note with lovely lavender and violet fragrance, garnished with pink pepper. It is a hint of flowers, but never too feminine. This is also ensured by the tart base. Here, the creator of Vibrant Woody Mandarin Eau de Toilette Spray relies on classic men's fragrances such as patchouli, tonka bean and cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Instinctive Marine 100 ml
listings.description: The Instinctive Marine Eau de Toilette Spray comes from the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection launched by Angel Schlesser in 2020. The fragrance is of course unisex and was composed by Amandine Clerc-Marie from only three ingredients . As you would expect from a fragrance called Instinctive Marine Eau de Toilette Spray, the top note is made up of a variety of marine notes that are fresh, salty, vibrant and so unique. Lavender carries the heart note, proving that this plant is rightly one of the greats in the fragrance world. Everything is rounded off by creamy, soft and powdery tonka beans in the base. Sensuality from Angel Schlesser that delights HER and HIM It is easy to categorise the fresh and spicy Les Eaux d'un Instant Instinctive Marine Eau de Toilette Spray as a pure women's fragrance. However, it is also extremely popular with men because the maritime notes develop into an irresistible, present and casually casual fragrance on masculine skin with creamy tonka beans. If you know Angel Schlesser as a pure fashion label that values sustainability, then just take a sniff of the fragrances from the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection. You will be amazed.

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Luminous Violet 100 ml
listings.description: With the Luminous Violet Eau de Toilette Spray Les Eaux d'un Instant by Angel Schlesser , you can make yourself or a loved one very happy. It is a fragrance that is described by the manufacturer as unisex . This means that both men and women can wear this special fragrance. The flacon is attractively coloured in a delicate purple to match the individual fragrance. It comes in discreet packaging, making the perfume Luminous Violet Eau de Toilette Spray Les Eaux d'un Instant by Angel Schlesser ideal as a gift . The contents of a bottle of Luminous Violet Eau de Toilette Spray Les Eaux d'un Instant by Angel Schlesser are very economical: you opt for a large 100 ml bottle. The note is decent and equally timeless and suitable for any occasion. The top note blends bergamot with delicate pear and the stimulating scent of tea. Freesia, peony and violet are added as heart notes. A pinch of salt enhances this sweet fragrance. Vanilla and cedarwood form the base note and make the perfume particularly individual . It covers the skin like a pleasant veil for a whole day.

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Intimate White Flowers 100 ml
listings.description: The Intimate White Flowers Eau de Toilette Spray comes from the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection by Angel Schlesser. Ane Ayo created the fragrance for men and women with a floral and fresh presence. As with the other fragrances in the Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant collection, the Intimate White Flowers Eau de Toilette Spray uses very few aromas. Four, to be precise. Monoi, another name for tiare, is the top note. White flowers and jasmine take over in the heart note before the base of pure vanilla appears. The fragrance is radiantly bright , with a subtle sweetness and a wonderful aroma. Sustainable fashion and equally sustainable fragrances from Spain Each fragrance from the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection epitomises the elegance of the modern woman who is self-aware, who takes what she wants and doesn't wait for anything. Why should she? Life is too short for that. The fashion is elegant, casual, chic and functional and inspires both at work and at play. Just like the splendidly feminine Intimate White Flowers Eau de Toilette Spray. This fragrance by Angel Schlesser accompanies you wherever you go, whenever you want it to.

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Profound Orange Wood 100 ml
listings.description: In 2020, the Spanish label Angel Schlesser presents the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection. It also includes the Profound Orange Wood Eau de Toilette Spray. The fragrance is fruity and woody and was designed by Nathalie Lorson for men and women. She has created a fragrance that makes do with few, but all the more beautiful flavours. In keeping with the fashion that Angel Schlesser produces in Spain and where great importance is attached to sustainability, the fragrances are also very natural and emphasise the style of the wearer in a way that is both simple and sophisticated . And the fine Les Eaux d'un Instant Profound Orange Wood Eau de Toilette Spray shows that this does not require any over-the-top combinations. Summery light and wonderfully sensual The top note introduces fruity oranges as soloists. Citrusy, earthy petitgrain opens the heart note and combines with orange tree wood. In the base, patchouli offers a whole host of different flavours with an intense presence. If you have only known Angel Schlesser's fashion so far, take the opportunity to get to know fragrances such as the enchanting and elegant Profound Orange Wood Eau de Toilette Spray with the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection. Experience how the fragrance enhances your days and evenings.

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Tempting Bergamot 100 ml
listings.description: The Tempting Bergamot Eau de Toilette Spray presented in 2020 also comes from the Les Eaux d'un Instant range by Angel Schlesser. The fresh and creamy fragrance is for men and women and was composed by Alberto Morillas. Three ingredients are enough for the king of fragrances to compose the delicate Les Eaux d'un Instant Tempting Bergamot Eau de Toilette Spray for Angel Schlesser. Bergamot is, of course, the soloist in the top note. The experienced perfumer uses hedione for the heart. Everything is then rounded off by the diverse aromas of musk. The seductive bergamot, as the name of the fragrance translates, is light, neither feminine nor masculine but incredibly wearable. An all-rounder for everyone and always Angel Schlesser is of course world-famous as a fashion label. But its fragrances, such as the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection, are also captivating more and more people. This is because Angel Schlesser attaches just as much importance to the high quality of each fragrance as it does to fashion. Attention is paid to sustainability, environmental compatibility and versatility. Casual and elegant fashion combined with casual and elegant fragrances puts you in a good mood. If you are not yet familiar with the brand's fragrances, why not try the Tempting Bergamot Eau de Toilette Spray?

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Splendid Orange Blossom 100 ml
listings.description: The unisex fragrance Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Splendid Orange Blossom Eau de Toilette Spray pampers you with a refreshing sweetness of fruit . On summery days, the perfume emphasises the good mood, while on rainy days it transports you to places like Tunisia or Morocco. This is because the extracts of bitter orange blossom, which characterise the scent of Angel Schlesser's fragrance, were obtained there. Good mood and holiday feelings In addition to bitter orange, bergamot opens the fragrance and immediately creates a positive mood. Feel lively and motivated with Les Eaux d'un Instant Splendid Orange Blossom Eau de Toilette Spray! The heart note also remains wonderfully fruity. The orange blossom tickles your nose and exudes a feeling of freedom, perhaps in a Mediterranean or exotic setting. The base note is pleasantly mysterious with patchouli, but still garnished with the warmth and light sweetness of vanilla. With Les Eaux d'un Instant Splendid Orange Blossom Eau de Toilette Spray by Angel Schlesser, you can always look forward to soothing, thoughtful breaks from everyday life or use it as a highlight for going out on a warm summer evening.

listings.rawTitle: Widian Gold Collection Extrait de Parfum Sahara 50 ml
listings.description: The Sahara Extrait de Parfum from Widian's Gold Collection is both elegant and pleasantly playful. It harmonises the warmth of a blazing fire with the coolness of a starry night and impresses with its unique and exclusive fragrance. A perfume for real connoisseurs and gourmets who want to enjoy the lively and life-affirming interplay of fragrances. Smoky bergamot and cloves play gently on the nose and are perfectly complemented by cinnamon, raspberry and spicy pepper. The Sahara Extrait de Parfum from Widian's Gold Collection is a perfume that knows how to seduce. listings.rawTitle: Widian Sapphire Collection Eau de Parfum Spray New York 100 ml
Widian Black Collection Extrait de Parfum Black II 50 ml

The top note in the perfume is characterised by refreshing citrus notes, which have a pleasantly invigorating effect and give the fragrance a light and bright scent . In the heart note, however, the Black II Extrait de Parfum in the Black Collection unfolds its very special charm. listings.rawTitle: Widian Velvet Collection Extrait de Parfum Liwa 50 ml

listings.rawTitle: Histoires de Parfums Ceci n'est pas un flacon Bleu Eau de Parfum Spray Blue 1.2 15 ml
listings.description: Ceci n'est pas un flacon Bleu, this is not a blue bottle, is also the name of the Eau de Parfum Spray Blue 1.2 by Histoires de Parfums. Why the brand has named the fragrance this way, even though the bottle is clearly blue and decorated with lots of colourful dots, is one of those mysteries that invite you to puzzle over it. The name Eau de Parfum Spray Blue 1.2 somehow makes more sense. In any case, the floral and fresh fragrance from Histoires de Parfums is aimed at both men and women. Luca Maffei created the fragrance and gave it a top note of ivy and pink pepper. The heart combines lily of the valley, ylang-ylang and lilac. Sandalwood, white musk and vanilla come together in the base. Ceci n'est pas un flacon Bleu or is it? Eau de Parfum Blue 1.2, often referred to as "This is not a blue Bottle 1.2", is the perfect fragrance for all year round: during the day, when going out, at work or in your free time. It delights with its freshness, its lightness , its sillage and its casual nonchalance . Then the Eau de Parfum Spray Blue 1.2 by Histoires de Parfums can also be called Ceci n'est pas un flacon Bleu. Perhaps there need to be more enchanting fragrances that confuse the senses a little.

listings.rawTitle: Histoires de Parfums Library of Scents Eau de Parfum Spray 1899 60 ml
listings.description: Inspired by a literary legend, the Histoires de Parfums 1899 Eau de Parfum Spray tells a story full of elegance and character. This olfactory creation from the French fragrance house pays homage to Ernest Hemingway and captures the atmosphere of a legendary Parisian bar. It opens with an invigorating blend of Italian bergamot, juniper berries and a hint of black pepper. At the heart of the composition, a bouquet of orange blossom and Florentine iris unfolds, refined by the warm spice of cinnamon. The base note anchors the fragrance with the gentle sweetness of vanilla, earthy vetiver and warm ambergris, resulting in a long-lasting and multi-faceted fragrance experience. 1899 is a complex, spicy-aromatic fragrance that creates a sophisticated balance between freshness and warmth and leaves an unobtrusive but present sillage. A multi-layered, spicy-aromatic fragrance character. Composition of fresh, floral, spicy and woody notes. Inspired by Ernest Hemingway and the Paris of the 1940s. A creation from the French niche perfume house Histoires de Parfums.

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens COLLECTION NOIRE Eau de Parfum Spray Fleurs d´Oranger 50 ml
listings.description: The Fleurs d'Oranger Eau de Parfum Spray from the COLLECTION NOIRE by Serge Lutens is an olfactory journey inspired by the perfumer's arrival in Morocco in 1968. The composition captures the vivid memory of women picking the precious white blossoms of the bitter orange tree. At the heart of this fragrance, the radiant and pure note of orange blossom unfolds, accompanied by opulent Egyptian jasmine and delicate white rose. Facets of tuberose and hibiscus lend the creation an additional floral dimension, while a hint of cumin and a subtle animalic nuance provide an unexpected depth. The experience is rounded off with warm musky notes and woody accords. Presented in the brand's signature minimalist and clean bottle, Fleurs d'Oranger is a sophisticated unisex fragrance that captivates with its classic yet uncompromising composition. A floral fragrance from the Collection Noire. Centred fragrance notes of orange blossom, Egyptian jasmine and white rose. Sophisticated, classic unisex composition. Presented in a minimalist and clear bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens COLLECTION NOIRE Eau de Parfum Spray L'Orpheline 50 ml
listings.description: With an ethereal yet profound aura, the eau de parfum L'Orpheline is an integral part of Serge Lutens' renowned Collection Noire. Launched in 2014, this olfactory creation represents a return to purist and clear structures. A striking note of incense unfolds at the centre of the composition, giving the fragrance an almost sacred, cool and enveloping character. This smoky main accord is accompanied by the fine, vibrant spiciness of black pepper, which creates a spicy dynamic without overwhelming the senses. The base is defined by nuances of dry woods, which create a consistent and elegant depth. This creation deliberately dispenses with lush floral elements and instead focuses consistently on a minimalist, woody-smoky signature that moves beyond classic gender categorisations as a versatile unisex fragrance. This uncompromising straightforwardness is also reflected visually: the striking, rectangular bottle made of clear glass reveals a dark, almost black liquid that forms an aesthetic contrast to the simple black label with the white "SERGE LUTENS" lettering and the iconic SL logo. A round, black cap completes the harmonious overall look of this niche fragrance. Fragrance character: A purist composition with woody, smoky and spicy facets. Main notes: Dominated by incense, accentuated by black pepper and dry woods. Collection: Part of the minimalist and elegant Collection Noire by Serge Lutens. Target group: Designed as a unisex perfume without floral heaviness. Design: Rectangular glass bottle with black liquid, black label and SL logo.

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens COLLECTION NOIRE Eau de Parfum Spray Féminité du Bois 50 ml
listings.description: Féminité du Bois from the Collection Noire by Serge Lutens is a fragrance creation that is considered a milestone of the 1990s. The eau de parfum is characterised by an extraordinary composition in which a dominant cedarwood note defines the character. This woody presence is accompanied by a fruity plum note and a warm, spicy aura. Facets of cardamom, cinnamon and clove lend the fragrance a special depth, while floral accents such as orange blossom, violet and rose in the heart note ensure a multi-layered development. Sweet notes of honey, beeswax and musk round off the fragrance experience in the base. This fusion of traditionally feminine and masculine elements creates an innovative fragrance. The creation is presented in a simple, geometric bottle that reflects the clear and sophisticated style of the Serge Lutens brand. listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens COLLECTION NOIRE Eau de Parfum Spray La fille de Berlin 50 ml
listings.description: A fragrance that captures the fascinating duality of a rose is at the centre of this expressive composition from the renowned Collection Noire. Serge Lutens dedicates this creation to the city of Berlin, creating an olfactory portrait full of strength of character that tells a story. listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens COLLECTION NOIRE Eau de Parfum Spray La Fille Tour de Fer 50 ml
listings.description: A new facet of the renowned Collection Noire is revealed with this creation from 2024, which was developed in collaboration with perfumer Christopher Sheldrake. At the centre of the composition is an unconventional rose duo of Turkish and Bulgarian flowers, which offers a modern and multi-layered interpretation of classic floral notes. These floral accords meet the powdery, elegant nuances of iris, which lend the arrangement a certain depth. The bouquet is complemented by natural pink berry, which adds a spicy and fresh accent. The character of the eau de parfum deliberately plays with contrasts and wraps the delicate flower in metaphorical armour, giving the fragrance a rebellious and metallic note. The result is an olfactory impression that is both dark and luminous and emphasises independence. The purple liquid shimmers through the transparent, rectangular glass bottle, while a black label with white lettering and the stylised SL logo rounds off the minimalist design. A round, black cap completes the overall aesthetic look. The certified vegan formula is aimed at all genders and dispenses with rigid categorisation. Fragrance composition: Contains notes of Turkish and Bulgarian rose, iris and pink berry. Design: Transparent, rectangular bottle with purple-coloured liquid and black cap. Collection: Part of the Collection Noire, launched in 2024. Special feature: Certified vegan formula with unisex character.

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens COLLECTION NOIRE Eau de Parfum Spray Le Perce-vent 50 ml
listings.description: A fascinating interplay of coolness and warmth characterises this composition, which expands the Collection Noire in 2025. The olfactory journey begins with an intense, almost camphor-like freshness that is immediately present and evokes associations with icy, clear air. At the centre of the creation is clary sage, whose herbaceous and slightly tart nuances lend the fragrance a striking yet calm structure. Serge Lutens takes up the image of the eye in a cyclone here by gently transforming this cool opening into a luminous centre. White amber and soft musk form the reliable foundation and ensure an earthy, steady finish that harmoniously cushions the initial sharpness. Optically, the eau de parfum spray has the familiar aesthetic of the line. The rectangular, transparent bottle allows a clear view of the liquid, while the black label with stylised white lettering and the spherical cap underline the minimalist claim. This unisex creation deliberately dispenses with unnecessary embellishments and focuses entirely on the purity of the selected essences. Fragrance notes: A combination of clear sage, white amber and musk. Character: Starts with a menthol-like freshness and develops into a warm, earthy base. Design: Minimalist, rectangular bottle with black label and spherical cap from the Collection Noire. Concept: Olfactory interpretation of a calm centre in the storm ("eye of the cyclone"). Target group: Unisex fragrance for lovers of straightforward and conceptual perfumes.

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens COLLECTION NOIRE Eau de Parfum Spray La nuit tombée 50 ml
listings.description: A fragrance like a whisper of the night: this composition from the Serge Lutens universe unfolds quietly, profoundly and full of poetic intensity. Inspired by the transition between light and darkness, the result is a chypre fragrance that interweaves memories, silence and emotions. Frankincense opens with a mysterious, smoky aura, while cedarwood gives the fragrance structure and clarity. Patchouli rounds off the composition with earthy depth and creates a sensual, almost meditative atmosphere. The minimalist, purist fragrance line is also reflected in the iconic bottle - clear, angular and uncompromisingly elegant. For decades, Serge Lutens has been synonymous with olfactory works of art with extraordinary expressiveness that are more than just fragrances: they are personal stories captured in a subtle, fascinating signature. - Mystical chypre fragrance with incense, cedarwood and patchouli - Inspired by the poetic mood of the night - Expressive, elegant and deliberately minimalist composition - Iconic, purist bottle with clean lines - Fragrance with emotional depth and an individual signature

listings.rawTitle: Coach Wild Rose Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the carefree beauty of a wildflower meadow, Coach Wild Rose unfolds as a delicate yet expressive fragrance. listings.rawTitle: Coach Pure Platinum Parfum Spray 40 ml
listings.description: The Coach For Men Eau de Toilette Spray 60 ml offers an aromatic, woody fragrance that brings modern, cosmopolitan New York style straight into your everyday life. Fresh notes of zesty lemon and crisp lavender open the fragrance experience, imparting an energising, clear sensation immediately upon application. As the fragrance develops, spicy accents of cardamom, coriander and a subtle hint of geranium unfold on the skin. This harmonious combination creates a masculine and self-assured aura, ideal for the office, business meetings or evening events. Spraying the eau de toilette onto warm areas of the body, such as the neck or wrists, allows the aroma to develop particularly well. A metallic, gleaming bottle featuring an engraved horse-drawn carriage and an elegant pendant stylishly houses the fragrance. listings.rawTitle: Coach Open Road Eau de Toilette Spray 40 ml
listings.description: Enjoy your road trip across America - with Open Road by Coach! Because the eau de toilette spray was inspired by this adventure. It is one of those fragrances that transports you to another world after a few fragrant moments. Perhaps you are even planning a real road trip? Then use Open Road as a companion to remind you of your journey every time you smell it! A fast-paced scented journey The top note of the Coach fragrance begins with spicy pepper, tickling your nose and awakening your thirst for adventure. Get ready for the road trip! Fresh accords of apple and lemon complete the opening and make you want to discover the nature of the USA. The heart note of lavender and clary sage does not promise too much either. It blends the two fragrances for a pleasant contrast, just as your journey through the USA will certainly be full of contrasts between city and country. Sometimes you will constantly meet like-minded people, sometimes you will be travelling alone for hours through the wilderness. A breath of freedom! The Open Road Eau de Toilette Spray ends in a base of vetiver and woods - a feeling of arrival. Just as your road trip should end.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Beyond Collection Extrait de Parfum Le Musc & La Peau 50 ml

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 31 Tonka Bodykon 50 ml
listings.description: 31 Tonka Bodykon from the Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris is a fragrance that deliberately seeks closeness to the body and feels like a second skin. This unisex composition pays homage to the tonka bean, which is embedded as a central component in a sweet and soft amber structure. Inspired by the colour palette of a sunset, the eau de parfum is reminiscent of a fine tonka liqueur, enhanced by balsamic and fruity nuances. The fragrance journey begins with top notes of amber-coloured rum and the eponymous tonka bean. A gourmand accord of crisp apple, golden honey and soft vanilla unfolds in the heart. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a base note of pistachio and the warm resin of benzoin, which give the fragrance a pleasant depth and a long-lasting presence. The result is a body-conscious fragrance for anyone who appreciates a subtle yet expressive sillage. Fragrance character: Sweet amber composition with tonka bean at the centre Fragrance family: Gourmand, amber Speciality: Skin-friendly and body-conscious unisex fragrance Concentration: Eau de Parfum

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Black Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Liqueur Charnelle 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the multifaceted aromas of a fine cognac, Liqueur Charnelle is an eau de parfum spray from the Black Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. The composition interprets the five characteristic notes of the distillate in an olfactory way and combines vanilla, plum, caramel, orange and apricot to create a harmonious opening. This bouquet is complemented by floral and fruity facets of dried lime blossom, violet and pressed grapes. Spicy accents of pink berries, elemi and black pepper lend the fragrance a special depth, while a base of tonka bean, light tobacco and powdery woods provides a sensual finish. Depending on the wearer, the fragrance unfolds its complexity in different ways, sometimes spicy and woody, sometimes characterised by a gentle sweetness. Its warm radiance makes it a suitable companion for the autumn and winter months. Inspired by the characteristic flavours of a high-quality cognac . A multi-layered fragrance composition with notes of vanilla, plum, caramel and spices. Unfolds individually on the skin and reveals both spicy-woody and soft-sweet facets. Part of the exclusive Black Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. Especially suitable for the cooler seasons.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris White Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Intime.Extime 50 ml
listings.description: The Intime.Extime eau de parfum from the White Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris is defined as a powdery and floral-amber fragrance experience. This creation is a modern skin jewellery that addresses the delicate balance between private intimacy and public charisma. At the olfactory centre is a dominant accord of iris powder, which gives the fragrance a soft and decidedly dry texture. This powdery note is accompanied by the clear freshness of white tea, which provides an invigorating yet restrained lightness. The composition is given complex depth through the targeted use of exotic itauba wood and a hint of incense, which gives structure to the arrangement. Gentle vanilla rounds off the profile and combines the individual components to form a harmonious whole on the skin. The bottle consistently reflects the purist aesthetic of the brand. A rectangular glass jar, refined with a characteristic white ceramic element, protects the precious liquid. On the front, a round, silver sticker with the words EXTIME adds a modern accent, while the simple silver cap finalises the elegant design. This unisex fragrance is suitable for lovers of subtle but present compositions. Fragrance character: Powdery, floral and with warm amber nuances. Main notes: Iris powder, white tea, incense, vanilla and itauba wood. Collection: Part of the White Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. Design: Rectangular glass bottle with white ceramic insert and silver details. Concept: Unisex fragrance, designed as olfactory skin jewellery.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Beyond Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Volupté Noire 50 ml
listings.description: Balsamic & magnetic: Volupté Noire is an olfactory interpretation of ambrosia, the mythical food of the gods. Inspired by the high plateaus of the Moroccan Atlas Mountains, where a powerful floral nectar is harvested: euphorbia honey. The fragrance radiates with an opening of bergamot, davana and medjool date. A delicate bouquet of white flowers, lime blossom, acacia and jasmine unfolds in the heart, interwoven with the sweet tannins of black oak. The powerful amber and musky scent of euphorbia honey covers the fragrance like a golden veil, leaving behind the noble sillage of a velvety floral embrace.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Collection Parfumerie Générale Eau de Toilette Spray 09 Yuzu Ab Irato 50 ml
listings.description: Crystal-clear freshness is at the centre of 09 Yuzu Ab Irato from the renowned Collection Parfumerie Générale. With this composition, Pierre Guillaume Paris creates an olfactory bridge between the tranquillity of a Japanese garden and the lively vegetation of the Mediterranean. The eau de toilette spray opens dynamically with the striking citrus note of yuzu, which is given a special lightness by the green coolness of spearmint leaves. A multi-layered bouquet then unfolds in the heart of the fragrance, in which the floral tones of jasmine, hyacinth and magnolia harmoniously complement each other. The use of hyssop adds aromatic depth to the arrangement, which breaks up the floral character in an interesting way. A base of musk rounds off the experience and lends the creation a gentle presence. The design of the bottle reflects this clarity: a rectangular glass jar with yellowish contents, topped with a cylindrical black cap and a minimalist label. This unisex fragrance is classified as floral-aromatic and is characterised by its unobtrusive yet present sensual freshness. Fragrance family: Floral-aromatic eau de toilette for all genders. Top note: Sparkling yuzu combined with cool spearmint leaves. Heart note: A floral bouquet of jasmine, hyacinth, magnolia and hyssop. Base note: Gentle finish with musky accords. Character: A combination of Japanese clarity and Mediterranean nature.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 11.1 Indian Wood 100 ml
listings.description: The composition 11.1 Indian Wood from the Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris interprets the theme of the spicy-aromatic fragrance family in a nuanced and multi-layered way. Reminiscent of an olfactory walk through an exotic forest during the monsoon season, this creation skilfully plays with fascinating contrasts between coolness and warmth. The opening is initially invigorating and fresh thanks to the combination of peppermint, lemon and cardamom, with nutmeg adding a spicy note. This cool top note is followed by a complex heart that combines dry jasmine with the striking accords of cedarwood and allspice. The base harmoniously rounds off the fragrance, blending balsamic notes of fir balsam, vetiver and oakmoss with the creamy softness of coconut milk and sandalwood. Launched in 2016, the eau de toilette is considered an independent evolution of the classic Harmatan Noir and is characterised by its balance between spicy sharpness and soft, woody facets. The fragrance is presented in a simple, rectangular clear glass bottle with the characteristic black label, which draws attention to the high-quality essence. Fragrance: Spicy-aromatic with woody and fresh accents. Top note: A fresh combination of peppermint, nutmeg, lemon and cardamom. Base note: Warm finish with sandalwood, vetiver, fir balsam and coconut milk. Character: A contrast of cool freshness and balsamic warmth, inspired by Indian forests. Collection: Part of the Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris (11.1).

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 28 Peau d'Ambre 50 ml
listings.description: Historical Mediterranean trade routes in the 6th century BC serve as the inspirational framework for this special olfactory composition. With the Numbered Collection 28 Peau d'Ambre, Pierre Guillaume Paris presents an eau de parfum spray that is characterised above all by a complex interplay of precious resins. A striking and powerful accord of frankincense and fir balsam forms the aromatic backbone of the fragrance. This base is complemented by the warm nuances of opoponax and benzoin, which together create a deep, smoky signature. The resulting aroma is subtly reminiscent of antique leather containers in which precious oils were once transported across the sea. Mineral accents also lend the creation a certain airiness, reminiscent of coastal landscapes at dusk. The clear, rectangular glass bottle emphasises the simple elegance of the contents with its smooth, slightly rounded edges. On the front, a round, black label with white lettering and the central number 28 indicates that the fragrance belongs to the numbered collection. A cylindrical, matt black cap harmoniously rounds off the visual appearance. Lovers of amber and leather notes will find a balanced interpretation here that combines tradition and modernity. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 2.1 Cozé Verde 50 ml
listings.description: With 2.1 Cozé Verde, Pierre Guillaume Paris is expanding its Numbered Collection with an olfactory reinterpretation of the familiar theme of Cozé. Launched in 2012, the fragrance is defined by its woody orientation, which is kept neutral and has no specific gender classification. The characteristic tobacco leaf is at the centre of this creation, but here it is placed in a different context. Instead of heaviness, a green, vegetal freshness dominates, which is largely characterised by accords of lime and fig tree juice. These citrus and herbal nuances lend the composition a certain lightness. Cocoa pods and amyl salicylate complement the fragrance, while liquorice provides a subtle, woody spiciness. The result of this combination is often perceived as cool, fresh and informal. The eau de toilette spray is housed in a simple, rectangular glass bottle with transparent walls that reveals the light yellow liquid. A round, black cap and the corresponding round label with white lettering round off the visual appearance. Woody fragrance character with green and vegetal facets. Centred notes of tobacco leaf, lime and fig tree juice. Spicy notes of liquorice and cocoa pod. Released in 2012 as part of the Numbered Collection. Transparent glass bottle with black cap.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 22 Djhenné 50 ml
listings.description: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection 22 Djhenné captures the complex olfactory essence of a shady oasis in the middle of a vast, sun-drenched sandy landscape. This aromatic-woody fougère fragrance is characterised by an exciting interplay between initial cool freshness and an evolving warm dryness. At the beginning, a clear, concise note of grey lavender and mint unfolds, which has an almost mineral character and forms an invigorating prelude. As the fragrance develops, the profile shifts noticeably towards warmer, earthier accords, which are largely characterised by blond leather and sun-bleached cedarwood. Fine, powdery nuances of cocoa pod combine harmoniously with the subtle floral accents of seringa blossom to create a remarkably complex structure. A solid base of myrrh and wheat rounds off the composition and lends it a gentle, balsamic depth that lingers for a long time. Visually, the heavy, rectangular glass bottle with its black, cylindrical cap and striking round label emphasises the purist elegance of the collection. The light yellow eau de toilette embodies artisanal sophistication and offers a multi-layered fragrance experience. Fragrance family: Aromatic-woody fougère with leathery and sandy facets. Head notes: Fresh grey lavender, cool mint and seringa blossom. Heart and base notes: Blond leather, cocoa pod, cedarwood, myrrh and wheat. Character: An interplay of mineral freshness and balsamic, powdery warmth. Design: Minimalist glass bottle with the characteristic black Parfumerie Générale label.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 24 Papyrus de Ciane 50 ml
listings.description: The inspiration for this olfactory creation comes from the lush papyrus gardens on the banks of the River Ciane in Sicily, a place full of historical and botanical significance. As a modern interpretation of a green chypre fragrance, the eau de parfum combines complex facets that artfully alternate between light and dark nuances. The opening presents itself with a striking freshness, characterised by bitter-green galbanum and sparkling bergamot, which create an invigorating dynamic. As the fragrance progresses, the eponymous papyrus unfolds, its dry, woody character harmoniously complemented by the honey-like accents of broom and delicate neroli. These green and floral elements rest on a deep base that combines the classic mousse de saxe with earthy vetiver and soft white musk. Incense and cedarwood also contribute to the multi-layered structure and lend the arrangement a subtle, smoky depth. Visually, the rectangular, transparent glass bottle with its black cylindrical lid reflects the clear lines of the Numbered Collection. The characteristic black round label with the number 24 indicates that it belongs to this series by Pierre Guillaume Paris. It is a composition that combines naturalness with the French art of perfumery and radiates timeless elegance. Fragrance family: Green chypre fragrance with a balance of bitter, fresh and earthy notes. Main components: Galbanum, papyrus, broom, mousse de saxe and white musk. Inspiration: The wild vegetation and papyrus stands along the Sicilian river Ciane. Design: Minimalist glass bottle with black lid and numbered label (no. 24). Character: Complex interplay of dry woods, green freshness and subtle smoke.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 19.1 Néroli ad Astra 50 ml
listings.description: An airy and radiant interpretation of orange blossom is revealed in the creation 19.1 Néroli ad Astra from the renowned Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. This fragrance is characterised by a clear, floral-vegetable composition that rearranges familiar nuances in a modern way and offers a fresh perspective. At the olfactory centre is the precious neroli from Morocco, which is complemented by the characterful addition of agave blossom from Mexico and juicy pear. This harmonious combination gives the eau de toilette spray a noticeable lightness and transparency, while at the same time maintaining a constant presence on the skin. As a variation on theme 19, which is traditionally dedicated to orange blossom, this number focusses on brightness and expansiveness. Visually, the solid, transparent glass bottle emphasises the purity of the contents and reveals the clear liquid. A cylindrical, black cap and the characteristic round label with the white number "19.1" round off the minimalist and timeless design, which fits seamlessly into the brand's aesthetic. Fragrance direction: A fresh, floral-vegetable composition with a radiant character. Main notes: Contains accords of Moroccan neroli, Mexican agave flower and pear. Collection: Part of the Numbered Collection as a variation on the orange blossom theme. Design: Minimalist, transparent glass bottle with black cylinder cap and striking 19.1 logo. Character: Conveys impressions of airiness, transparency and brightness.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 16.1 Bois Naufragé 50 ml
listings.description: As part of the renowned Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris, the Eau de Parfum Spray 16.1 Bois Naufragé is an artful olfactory interpretation of driftwood. Launched in 2010, the composition is dedicated to the overarching theme of figs (Theme N°16), but approaches it from an emphatically mineral and woody perspective. Inspired by the photograph "Nu au bois flotté" by Lucien Clergue, the fragrance captures the poetic image of an Egyptian fig tree moulded by the tides and the elements. In the opening, green mint and fine salt flower combine with the characteristic green notes of the fig tree to create an invigorating prelude. As the fragrance develops, a complex structure unfolds in which the cool minerality of salt crystals meets the subtle warmth of ambergris. A solid base of fractionated vetiver emphasises the striking driftwood character and lends the arrangement a long-lasting depth. This fragrance from the Woody Fougère category is characterised by its ability to develop individually on the skin and offers a multi-layered fragrance experience that combines raw naturalness with French perfumery. Fragrance category: Woody fougère with a mineral character . Head notes: A fresh combination of salt flower, fig tree and mint. Base: A base of fractionated vetiver and driftwood notes. Special feature: Part of the Numbered Collection and inspired by the photograph "Nu au bois flotté". Character: Mineral, woody and multi-faceted thanks to the combination of ambergris and salt crystals.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 26 Isparta 50 ml
listings.description: The Numbered Collection by French perfumer Pierre Guillaume is dedicated to the famous summer rose from the Turkish province of the same name with the creation of 26 Isparta. This special rose forms the centrepiece of the eau de toilette spray and unfolds a voluminous, floral bouquet. Red fruits open the composition in the top note and contribute fruity accents that form an exciting contrast to the floral centre. Behind the initial freshness lies a complex structure of resinous and woody elements that define the Chypre Floral fragrance family. Peru balsam and benzoin lend the fragrance a balsamic warmth, while calamus adds a slightly spicy note. A base of dark patchouli and fine oud is responsible for the distinctive character. Frankincense adds a subtle, smoky facet that gives the arrangement depth. The olfactory experience is rounded off with soft nuances of musk and ambroxan. Visually, the perfume is presented in a simple, transparent glass bottle that reveals the light yellow liquid and is enhanced by a round, black label with white lettering. Fragrance: Chypre Floral with a dominant note of Turkish summer rose from Isparta. Head and heart notes: A combination of red fruits, Peru balsam and calamus. Base accords: Deep, woody nuances of patchouli, oud, incense and benzoin. Design: Minimalist glass bottle with black cap and Numbered Collection label.

With its woody-green and musky character, a fragrance experience unfolds that subtly captures the essence of a Mediterranean garden. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 05 L'Eau de Circé 50 ml
listings.description: A complex interplay of floral and fruity notes characterises Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection 05 L'Eau de Circé. Originally launched in 2005, this creation is part of the French house's established Numbered Collection. Visually, the fragrance is presented in a rectangular, transparent glass bottle that reveals the clear liquid. A black, circular label with white lettering and the striking number 05 rounds off the minimalist design. This composition is designed as a unisex fragrance and can be worn regardless of gender norms. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 10.1 Bouquet Massaï 50 ml
listings.description: The Numbered Collection by French perfumer Pierre Guillaume Paris presents an exciting olfactory evolution within the line with 10.1 Bouquet Massaï. As a modern reinterpretation of the original Aomassai theme, the focus of this creation clearly shifts towards a floral arrangement without losing the characteristic depth of the series. The fragrance opens with a striking and contrasting accord in which roasted notes of coffee meet soft cashmere wood. This initial, rather dark impression changes gently as it progresses, paving the way for a multi-faceted centrepiece. This is where the bright aromas of peony and magnolia unfold, giving the eau de toilette spray a lively, almost fruity and floral aura. Finally, the base provides a warm and velvety finish, combining tolu balsam with fiery wood tones and creamy sandalwood. Visually, the bottle emphasises the purist elegance of the brand with its clear, rectangular glass design, which is crowned by a solid black cap. On the front, a round, black label with white lettering and the number 10.1 indicates the exact affiliation to the series. As a unisex fragrance, this balanced composition is aimed at all lovers of niche fragrances who appreciate the complex interplay of floral lightness and woody warmth. Fragrance character: Floriental composition with an interplay of floral and woody notes. Top note: An unusual, warm accord of coffee and cashmere wood. Heart note: A lush floral bouquet dominated by peony and magnolia. Base note: Velvety finish with tolu balsam and sandalwood. Design: Minimalist glass bottle with characteristic black round label.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 7.1 Cologne Grand Siècle Intense 50 ml
listings.description: With the creation of 7.1 Grand Siècle Intense, Pierre Guillaume Paris reinterprets the theme of a classic cologne in a contemporary and intense way. Released in 2021, this version stands out as an eau de parfum due to its concentration and thus offers a long-lasting presence on the skin. At the centre of the fragrance development is a radiant accord of hesperides, in which the sparkling notes of bergamot, lemon and orange unfold dynamically. These citrusy facets are accompanied by a subtle mint note that provides a cool freshness. At the heart of the composition, a fine veil of powdery iris and sweet honey gently covers the arrangement. These softer tones form an interesting contrast to the profound chypre background that characterises the perfume. In the base, earthy vetiver and spicy cypress merge with nuances of tobacco, dry hay, patchouli and oakmoss. The absence of typical aromatic herbs creates a clear structure that combines the bitterness of citrus fruits with a woody, rounded depth. The result is a fragrance that exudes both invigorating freshness and elegant persistence. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 19 Louanges Profanes 50 ml
listings.description: A harmonious combination of floral and resinous notes characterises the Louanges Profanes eau de toilette spray from the Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. Launched in 2008, the fragrance opens with a fresh top note in which the aromas of neroli and hawthorn unfold. At the heart of the composition, the purity of white lily meets the deep, smoky nuance of incense, creating an interesting tension. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a warm base of benzoin and guaiac wood, which lends the perfume a gentle woody flavour. This creation is often described as luminous and immaculate, which emphasises its elegant character. Pierre Guillaume has created an interplay between floral lightness and balsamic depth. The fragrance signature is designed so that it can be worn regardless of gender. Visually, the yellowish liquid is presented in a classic bottle with a black cap and the characteristic round label bearing the number 19. Fragrance character: An elegant blend of floral, woody and resinous notes. Main components: Neroli, hawthorn, white lily, frankincense, benzoin and guaiac wood. Collection: Part of the Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. Target group: Designed as a unisex fragrance.
