listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg Les Secrets Eau de Parfum Spray SECRET N°VIII SOUFFLE DU DÉSIR 30 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Secret VIII Souffle du Désir from the exclusive Les Secrets collection by EISENBERG presents itself with an artful balance of warmth and spice. The top note opens the olfactory experience with a striking yet velvety blend of fruity plum, elegant saffron and a hint of smoky incense. This powerful opening flows smoothly into a multi-layered heart that combines the classic floral nuances of rose with the deep, earthy tones of patchouli and cistus. The base provides a long-lasting and harmonious finish, combining soft sandalwood and gourmand vanilla with a rich amber accord. The complex interplay of the selected ingredients creates an aura that is often described as mysterious and alluring. The product also sets visual accents: The bottle is made of clear, bulbous glass and reveals the amber-coloured liquid inside. The container is enhanced by a shiny gold cap and a textured ring on the neck of the bottle, which gives the design a special feel. The name of the fragrance and a reference to the fragrance direction can be found on the front, rounding off the elegant appearance. Fragrance direction: Amber-influenced composition with spicy and floral facets. Top notes: A combination of plum, saffron and incense. Heart note: A multi-layered interplay of patchouli, cistus and rose. Base note: Warm finish with vanilla, amber and sandalwood. Design: Bellied glass bottle with golden cap and visible amber-coloured essence.

listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg L'Art du Parfum Eau de Parfum Spray BACK TO PARIS 50 ml
listings.description: Parisian flair and a sophisticated lightness characterise the composition of Eisenberg L'Art du Parfum Back To Paris. This eau de parfum opens with a lively freshness created by the interplay of tangy rhubarb, juicy mandarin and bergamot, while pink pepper and blackcurrant add subtle accents. As the fragrance progresses, a floral heart note unfolds, combining the powdery facets of iris and violet with the timeless character of rose and jasmine. A warm depth defines the finish, in which woody accords of patchouli, sandalwood and cedarwood merge with the sweetness of vanilla, tonka bean and musk. Visually, the creation is presented in a minimalist, cubic glass bottle that reveals the golden yellow liquid and is crowned by a clear lid and a golden spray head. The formula is free from microplastics, parabens and palm oil and focuses on the complex fragrance structure. Initially, a fruity, fresh top note unfolds, in which sparkling bergamot and mandarin meet the subtle spiciness of pink pepper berries. At the centre of the creation is a floral heart that combines the classic notes of jasmine and violet with an unexpected, fresh marine accord. This combination gives the fragrance a special depth. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a warm base that combines creamy sandalwood with the gentle sweetness of vanilla, creating a long-lasting, powdery finish. Visually, the transparent glass bottle with its clear, rectangular cap underlines the aesthetics of the product and reveals the gold-coloured liquid inside, with the central inscriptions characterising the design. Fragrance family: A spicy and powdery composition with a multi-layered character. Top note: Fresh accents of bergamot, mandarin and pink pepper berries. Heart note: A floral bouquet of jasmine and violet, complemented by a marine accord. Base note: Warm finish with sandalwood and vanilla. Design: High-quality glass bottle with gold-coloured liquid and clear cap.

listings.description: The Émulsion Parfumée Corps I AM from Eisenberg Paris represents an elegant combination of high-quality texture and olfactory art. The fragrance composition combines floral notes of magnolia and rose with fruity raspberry accents, while a warm base of sandalwood and amber adds depth. These harmonious elements remain on the body as a subtle, long-lasting veil. Visually, the glossy black tube features a striking, artistic motif on the front, which depicts two people in a picturesque scene and bears the name I AM. Users can use the emulsion to support the intensity of the accompanying eau de parfum or simply to give the skin a gentle hint of the fragrance. Without leaving a heavy film, the product provides a refreshing sensation. Light, fast-absorbing texture Leaves the skin feeling soft and supple Decent fragrance with floral and fruity notes Elegant black tube with artistic motif Ideal complement to the I AM Eau de Parfum

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray by Juicy Couture delights with an exquisite fragrance that is glamorous, daring and feminine at the same time. It owes these characteristics to its sophisticated composition of diverse accords. The top note opens the fragrance with wild berries and fresh, wonderfully juicy mandarin. This is followed by a heart note that provides floral accents with honeysuckle, jasmine and gardenia. The long-lasting base note provides woody and sweet notes and impresses with a mixture of caramel, vanilla, praline, sandalwood and amber. An eau de parfum with an extravagant design The Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray by Juicy Couture not only stands out with its fragrant scent, but also with its opulent design . You can look forward to an elegant glass bottle with a bright pink bow and a detachable pendant. Thanks to this beautiful design, the Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray by Juicy Couture is also a great gift idea.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Gold Couture 30 ml
listings.description: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Gold Couture is a fruity-floral women's fragrance full of glamour and elegance. Launched in 2014, the artful composition by master perfumer Honorine Blanc is full of emotion and exudes a flair of irresistible feminine elegance. Fresh, fruity accords harmonise wonderfully with accents of delicate white flowers and a whole palette of sensual nuances. Like all creations by the trendy Californian cult label Juicy Couture, the perfume's artful, playful bottle immediately catches the eye. It is now very popular with collectors. Juicy wild berries framed by delicate white flowers The Eau de Parfum Spray Gold Couture from the lively, vibrant Viva La Juicy fragrance line opens sparkling and fresh with a cocktail of delicious, aromatic wild berries. The heart note of the fascinating fragrance features dreamy, sensual nuances with dewy white flowers of Arabian jasmine and graceful honeysuckle. The foundation of Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Gold Couture celebrates exhilarating femininity. Irresistible notes of delicious caramel combine with the sweetness of delicious vanilla. Exquisite sandalwood gently restrains the sweet notes and prevents the perfume from being too heavy. Golden yellow ambergris brings the fragrance experience to a discreetly sensual and harmonious close.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Rose 50 ml
listings.description: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Rose is an elegant floral fragrance for women from 2015. The romantic, very feminine composition from the exclusive Californian cult label combines a colourful array of intense, precious floral notes with gourmand, fruity and sensual, elegant accents. The luxurious perfume uses particularly precious ingredients to ensure its wearer makes an impressive appearance both during the day and in the evening. The ornate, playful bottle of the fragrance with a pink silk bow is an instant eye-catcher and has achieved cult status, and not just among collectors. Enchanting flowers with a radiantly sunny ambience The stars of Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Rose, delicate blossoms, already make their presence felt in the radiantly fresh fragrance opening. Tangy, juicy Italian mandarin and seductively sweet Williams pear are joined by blossoming, aromatic jasmine. The heart note of the perfume is dominated by the beguilingly sweet scent of the hundred-petalled rosa centifolia, the nuances of white peony and dewy, Arabian jasmine sambac, which give the eau de parfum an imposing frame. Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Rose sounds decidedly elegant with a hint of feminine sensuality. A multi-faceted absolute of iris root picks up on the floral theme and is given depth of character by sweet, leathery benzoin notes and the soft, balsamic fragrance molecule ambroxan.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Le Bubbly 100 ml
listings.description: The Le Bubbly Eau de Parfum Spray by Juicy Couture is an already iconic reinterpretation of Viva La Juicy , a fragrance that has countless fans worldwide. The fragrance is irresistible and decidedly sparkling: a real mood booster that carries summer with it all year round. This is ensured by the champagne alone, which gives Le Bubbly Eau de Parfum Spray a fascinating and almost sparkling aura. But the temperamental composition is also impressive in every respect. Juicy Couture gave the perfume juicy blood orange and bright mandarin in the top note, floral notes of gardenia, jasmine, vanilla and orchid in the heart note and finally warm nuances of amber, wood and delicious praline as a seductive finishing touch. The reinterpretation of Viva La Juicy: fireworks for the senses The Le Bubbly Eau de Parfum Spray by Juicy Couture gives you an unrivalled experience and is a real guarantee for a good mood. Speaking of "giving": It is also unbeatable as a gift, which is not only due to the wonderful fragrance, but also to the gorgeous pump bottle. It is so breathtakingly beautiful and stunningly feminine that every beauty-conscious woman will want to have it!

The top notes of watermelon, apple, passion fruit and water hyacinth open the fragrance experience and add a fresh touch to the start of the day. This is followed by the heart notes of rose, tuberose and lily, which unfold a crisp aroma. This combination is ideal for a wide range of situations, whether at work or during leisure activities. The curved glass bottle, with its pink-coloured liquid and golden details, adds a striking visual touch. Thanks to the balanced blend of fruity and sweet elements, the fragrance offers a simple way to subtly enhance your personal style. listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Noir 30 ml
listings.description: Exclusive women's fragrance brings real joie de vivre If you are one of those fun-loving, young women, the Viva La Juicy Noir Eau de Parfum Spray could inspire you. With this perfume from Juicy Couture , parfumdreams.co.uk offers you a creation that is attractive and true to life. The eau de parfum spray is available in 30 ml and 50 ml versions. Even the decorative glass bottle attracts attention. A pink bow with a gold-coloured chain and a safety pin underneath, also with a chain, immediately catch the eye. An equally decorative, elegant, slim glass cap forms the top. The perfume itself surpasses the already special outer frame with its effect. The choice of the right components makes for a successful fragrance This eau de parfum spray from the Viva La Juicy series develops perfection thanks to the perfect choice of individual fragrances. Overall, it is a typical perfume for women that is equally appealing to men. The top note opens fresh and fruity with mandarin and blackcurrant. Elegant floral notes of gardenia, honeysuckle and jasmine follow in the heart. The base note rounds off with amber, caramel, praline, sandalwood and vanilla. Viva La Juicy Noir by Juicy Couture is a highly interesting creation.

listings.rawTitle: Hollister Festival Vibes Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Hollister Festival Vibes Festival Vibes is floral, fruity-sweet and girly. The new fragrance from the well-known fashion label Hollister was launched in 2018. The perfumer is Steve DeMercado. His message with the eau de parfum spray is summer, sun, music, fun. Everything you can experience at festivals. What could be better than dancing and partying into the evening in glorious sunshine to the music of your favourite bands? You want to keep this atmosphere, this drive, forever. Festival Vibes epitomises this feeling of freedom, music and festival fun. Feel the beat and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere The fragrance makes a statement with its floral, fruity charm. The eau de parfum spray is cool, carefree and expressive. The top note starts with fruity notes of goji berry, Italian bergamot and quince. Nuances of vanilla orchid, coral hibiscus, peony and osmanthus lend the fragrance freshness and the wonderful feeling of the first balmy summer evenings. Hollister Festival Vibes is rounded off with musk, tonka bean and cashmere wood in the base note. They give this eau de parfum spray a slightly spicy character that adds the finishing touch to the fragrance. The pink and rose-coloured bottle for the eau de parfum spray is perfectly coordinated with the fragrance message. The silicone coating ensures optimum grip.

listings.rawTitle: Hollister Festival Vibes Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Hollister Festival Vibes Eau de Toilette Spray captures a carefree and lively atmosphere in a fragrance. The composition opens with a fresh sea breeze that combines with the fruity note of pineapple and the tart facet of birch leaf. As the fragrance progresses, green and woody accords unfold, which are given an interesting depth by the spicy warmth of ginger and bay leaf. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with the earthy tones of oak moss, the sweet presence of tonka bean and the gentle note of ambergris. This aromatic fougère fragrance is a pleasant everyday companion that supports a positive and dynamic aura. The bottle itself reflects the character of the fragrance: the bluish-turquoise glass and embossed lettering are reminiscent of summery days and a relaxed mood. Fragrance family: Aromatic fougère Top notes: marine accord, pineapple, birch leaf Heart notes: Green notes, woody notes, ginger, bay leaf Base note: oakmoss, tonka bean, ambergris

listings.rawTitle: Hollister Free Wave Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Hollister Free Wave Fresh, floral and fruity is the character of Hollister's eau de parfum spray. The fashion label's summer fragrance pays homage to cool holidays by the sea. It symbolises summer, sun and fun. The play of the waves breaking on the beach with foaming spray. The surfers dancing on the crests of the waves to the beat of the beach clubs. The message of Free Wave is clear: enjoy the here and now with friends while the sun kisses the sea and the beach. Hollister's Eau de Parfum Spray perfectly showcases this drive. Who wouldn't want to remember the feeling of sun, summer and freshness with a few spritzes of Free Wave ? Enjoy life and freedom to the full , that's what this fragrance stands for. Adventure, holidays, friendship - that's what this fragrance embodies. The top note starts with fruity-sweet mandarin, sparkling-spicy blackberry and lovely agave nectar. In the heart note, fresh nuances of apple blossom, elegant water lily and mysterious wild orchid take command. Hollister's Eau de Parfum Spray is rounded off with velvety green moss, patchouli and orcanox (amber-like). The bottle is lilac-coloured. Free Wave is a fragrance experience for the day. The character of this eau de parfum spray is spirited and tantalising.

listings.rawTitle: Hollister Canyon Sky Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The eau-de-parfum spray from the Canyon Sky series by the Hollister label pampers its wearer with an incomparable fragrance that is her faithful companion for the day. It transports her senses to California, where she finds herself surrounded by a fascinating rocky landscape and gazes relaxed into the sky. The scent of freedom The Hollister company is known for its laid-back lifestyle that epitomises coolness and freedom. This is also visualised by the logo of a flying seagull. In this eau-de-parfum spray, a sophisticated fragrance pyramid is responsible for the unique fragrance experience. The top note consists of bergamot, raspberry and redcurrant. The heart note is made up of heliotrope, peony and orange blossom. Finally, the base notes include musk, praline and sandalwood . This creates a fruity and floral fragrance. To match the fragrance, the bottle is an appealing yellow colour with a transparent logo and transparent lettering. The name of the Canyon Sky series, on the other hand, is in a chic pink colour. And it's not just because the bottle comes in creatively designed packaging that the product is also ideal as a gift. It can also be used as a partner fragrance, as there is also a version of this series for men.

listings.rawTitle: Hollister Feelin' Good Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Hollister Feelin' Good Eau de Parfum Spray creates a good mood - as the colourful bottle, which depicts a cool colour gradient from orange to violet to blue, makes clear. The perfume suits women of all ages, regardless of whether they are still young or at least young at heart. Thanks to the many open, light accords, the perfume is also an ideal choice for spring and summer. However, the Hollister Feelin' Good Eau de Parfum Spray could just as easily bring joy and lightness to the dreary winter - there are no limits to your creativity in this respect. A perfume that pulsates with energy and joie de vivre The Hollister Feelin' Good Eau de Parfum Spray is almost a small attitude to life - because feeling good often starts in the mind. That's where fruity accords open this fragrance, in the top note. Orange, clementine and grapefruit are brought together to create a delicious fruit basket that you can't eat, but you can smell in all its splendour. The heart of the composition is somewhat fresher thanks to mint, while powdery and soft accords of peach and freesia skilfully round it off, while the base notes of musk, vetiver and wood remain discreetly in the background.

listings.rawTitle: Halloween Man X Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Halloween Man X by Jesus Del Pozo is an eau de toilette spray that is characterised by its multi-faceted composition. The fragrance opens with an invigorating top note of fresh lemon, aromatic lavender and spicy cardamom. The heart then unfolds, in which notes of coffee, whiskey and leather meet warm cinnamon and a mineral accent. This combination creates a special character. The base note, which harmoniously combines tonka bean, amber and incense, ensures a long-lasting finish. The result is a creation with a spicy, woody character. The spray is applied to the neck and wrists from a distance of around 10 cm for ideal fragrance development. The most up-to-date list of ingredients can be found on the product packaging. Fragrance character: Spicy and woody Heart notes: A composition of coffee, whiskey and leather Base notes: Accords of tonka bean, amber and incense Fragrance type: Eau de toilette

listings.rawTitle: Halloween Man Mystery Eau de Parfum Spray 125 ml
listings.description: Discover the Halloween Eau de Parfum Spray by Man Mystery - the mysterious aura of the modern man, captured in an irresistible fragrance. This eau de parfum is a tribute to the unfathomable depth and complexity of the masculine character. The Halloween Eau de Parfum Spray surprises you with its unexpected top note, which combines tangy mandarin, peach blossom and lavandin. This refreshing yet warm introduction flows seamlessly into the heart note, where the masculine flavours of geranium and hazelnut unfold. In the base, patchouli and vetiver combine to create a base note that ensures a lasting presence and rounds off the overall picture of this sophisticated perfume. Seductive fragrance for the modern man The Halloween Eau de Parfum Spray by Man Mystery is more than just a fragrance. It is an olfactory narrative that tells of mystery and adventure and celebrates the uniqueness of the modern man. Each spray plunges you into a world of seduction, intrigue and masculinity that invigorates your senses and fills your day with a touch of mystery. The modern and elegant bottle fits perfectly in any bathroom or travelling bag. It is designed to fit comfortably in the hand and allows for precise application. A simple spray on the neck, wrists or clothing is all it takes to unleash the "Man Mystery Experience".

listings.rawTitle: Halloween Man Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: With Halloween Man Eau de Toilette Spray, Spanish designer Jesus del Pozo has created a fragrance that is as individual as it is suitable for everyday use . Sweet, fruity notes meet tart leather and emphasise a masculine aura. On the market since 2012, Halloween Man Eau de Toilette Spray is aimed at men who love the uncomplicated and want to embark on an adventure every day. Halloween Man - masculine, fruity-sweet and suitable for everyday use Perfumer Clément Gavarry has combined the individual accords in the eau de toilette spray to create a fine-tuned composition . He chose fruity mandarin and lively martini for the top note and rounded off this composition with spicy basil and lovely violet leaf. In the heart note, ginger and orange blossom as well as lavender unfold their aromas and gain a spicy accord through cinnamon. A base of ambergris and leather lends the fragrance its masculine aura. Musk and vanilla complete the successful impression.

listings.rawTitle: Halloween Halloween Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Halloween eau de toilette spray is an irresistible fragrance from the brand of the same name. Let yourself be enveloped by nuances from the fruity, woody and floral range and enjoy the oriental flair of the eau de toilette. A multifaceted fruit and floral journey The top note of the eau de toilette spray is a distinctive mix of fruits, characterised by lime and banana. This blend transports you to a fresh orchard! But before your mouth starts to water, floral accords take you to a flower meadow. Here, violets, magnolia and tuberose compete in fragrance and lend the wearer of Halloween a romantic, playful aura. The floral heart then leads into a warm base with incense, sandalwood and vanilla. A classically intense finish for the eau de toilette spray, which is concealed in a magical purple bottle with silver accents. This feminine, exotic fragrance full of sensuality and sophistication has been making its mark on more than just the Spanish perfume market for several years. It was created by the Halloween brand, which can look back on decades of history and has also made a name for itself as a designer.

listings.rawTitle: Halloween Blue Drop Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: A floral fragrance with a touch of lightness: the Halloween Blue Drop Eau de Toilette Spray by Jesus del Pozo is aimed at women who want to emphasise their feminine charisma . Floral fragrance notes give the perfume a sensual aura. It is not too heavy, so the fragrance creation can also be worn on warm days and guarantees a successful appearance for any occasion. Halloween Blue Drop Eau de Toilette - as sensual as it is exhilarating The finely balanced components make Halloween Blue Drop Eau de Toilette Spray a unique fragrance experience. Sparkling citrus fruits and fresh green apple unfold their flavours in the top note, supported by spicy lavender. As soon as the top note fades, the heart note comes with the floral accords of jasmine and white flowers, rounded off with lovely violets. Amber, cinnamon, spices and musk give the fragrance a warm base. The bottle is as uncomplicated and light as the fragrance. Blue glass and silver elements in round shapes emphasise the feminine impression that the perfume leaves behind.

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Muse Eau de Parfum Spray by Zarkoperfume is a tribute to purity and clarity. Inspired by the scent of freshly washed laundry, this fragrance exudes an aura that is both clean and distinct. Launched in 2020, this composition by the Danish brand eschews a traditional fragrance pyramid. Instead, the notes blend directly with the skin to create a highly personal scent signature. It opens with delicate cotton blossom, followed by a heart of warm, white oud. In the base, white musk ensures a long-lasting, powdery and gently woody finish. Conceived as a niche product, this unisex fragrance is ideal for anyone who appreciates something special yet understated. The perfume is also produced without animal testing. A clean, fresh fragrance reminiscent of freshly washed laundry. A composition of cotton blossom, white oud and white musk. Designed as a unisex fragrance for individual expression. Develops a personal and unique signature on the skin. Produced without animal testing.

This unisex perfume is ideal for a wide range of situations, from everyday office life to special evening occasions. listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Pink Molécule 090.09 Eau de Parfum Spray by Zarkoperfume is an olfactory interpretation of the Nordic landscape. The composition opens with a zesty freshness of elderflower and juicy apricot, complemented by the subtle elegance of black orchid. A distinctive element is the eponymous pink molecules, which lend the fragrance a mineral-like lightness. In this creation, Danish perfumer Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov breaks with the classic fragrance pyramid and deliberately omits a heart note. As a result, the top note blends seamlessly with the warm base of fine mahogany, creamy accords and dark woods. Developed in Denmark, this vegan fragrance really comes into its own on warmer days in spring and summer. Fragrance profile: Fruity and floral Fragrance notes: Elderflower, apricot, black orchid, mahogany Special feature: Composition without a traditional heart note Characteristic: Vegan eau de parfum

listings.description: The Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection gift set provides fascinating access to the world of molecular fragrances and combines three characterful eau de parfums in an elegant box. Characteristic of this line is the complex interplay of high-quality perfume oil and water, which is initially visible in the transparent glass flacons as separate phases in the colours orange, blue and green. Before use, the container should be shaken for around four seconds, causing the liquids to mix and briefly take on a milky, cloud-like appearance. The compositions are based on special molecules that can develop individually on the skin and react subtly to the environment, the weather and personal radiance. While No. 1, for example, picks up on nuances of sea buckthorn, jasmine and dark woods, the other variants add further olfactory facets from the Danish manufacturer to the spectrum. The minimalist design with golden accents makes this compilation a stylish way to fully discover the versatility of the collection. Contains Cloud Collection No. 1, No. 2 and No. 3 as eau de parfum (10 ml each) Based on molecular perfumery for customised fragrance development Visual effect thanks to activatable two-phase texture Compact glass bottles in a minimalist design, ideal for travelling

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Oud'ish Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Zarkoperfume Oud’ish Eau de Parfum Spray offers a light and crisp interpretation of the precious fragrance note of oud. The composition opens with the fresh note of Indian green tea, creating an invigorating opening. At the heart of the fragrance, the characteristic oud unfolds, its woody depth complemented by gentle, earthy nuances. This heart note blends harmoniously with the warmth of ambergris, lending the perfume a subtle complexity. In the base, white musk provides a soft and velvety finish that elegantly rounds off the individual components. The result is a fragrance that is both woody and fresh, captivating with its perfect balance. The creation is presented in a minimalist, cylindrical glass bottle with golden accents, reflecting the brand’s modern aesthetic. A woody and fresh unisex fragrance Combines notes of Indian green tea and oud With warm accents of ambergris Rounded off with a base of white musk

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray The Beach 100 ml
listings.description: Molecule C-19 The Beach Eau de Parfum Spray by Zarkoperfume is an olfactory tribute to carefree summer days on the beaches of Hornbaek. This unisex fragrance opens with the exotic warmth of coconut molecules, which immediately conjure up images of sun and sea. In the heart note, a crisp whitewood accord lends a bright, woody dimension, reminiscent of sun-bleached driftwood and salty air. The base note harmoniously rounds off the composition with soft, sweet musk and a hint of creamy vanilla. This combination lends the fragrance a pleasant depth and a long-lasting character. As an Eau de Parfum, this creation – launched in 2023 – features a high concentration of fragrance oils, ensuring it lingers for many hours. It is a fragrance that captures the essence of an endless summer in a bottle. A unisex fragrance, inspired by a summer’s day on the beach. A composition of coconut notes, light wood, musk and vanilla. A long-lasting fragrance experience thanks to a high concentration of perfume oils. A fragrance launched in 2023.

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Dreamer 100 ml
listings.description: With the Classic Collection Dreamer Eau de Parfum Spray, the Danish brand Zarkoperfume presents a fragrance that captivates with its clarity and subtle depth. Released in 2025, perfumer Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov dedicated this creation to his son Isak, seeking to capture a balance between fresh energy and serene constancy. A lively opening combines fruity notes of apple and Sicilian bergamot with the green freshness of fig leaves. This initial impression is complemented by spicy ginger and marine accords, which lend the fragrance an invigorating quality. At the heart of the fragrance, aromatic facets of rosemary, sage and juniper berry unfold, blending with the floral character of geranium. Ambroxan lends the heart note an additional modern structure. A warm base of cedarwood, vetiver and tonka bean rounds off the olfactory experience, whilst incense and musk provide a grounded finish. Designed as a unisex fragrance, this eau de parfum is aimed at anyone who appreciates herbaceous and woody notes. The cylindrical glass bottle offers a glimpse of the pale yellow liquid and is visually enhanced by a gold-metallic cap and an elegantly framed label. A fresh, herbaceous fragrance profile with woody accents and maritime notes A multi-layered composition of apple, sage, ambroxan and cedarwood Unisex perfume from the Classic Collection, launched in 2025 High-quality glass bottle with a metallic gold cap Inspired by quiet strength and the perfumer’s personal dedication

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Ménage à Trois Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Danish fragrance house Zarkoperfume presents ‘Ménage à Trois’, an eau de parfum based on a unique concept. At the heart of the composition are three large musk molecules, which form a harmonious blend and define the fragrance’s aromatic character. This gives rise to a fresh and dynamic olfactory experience, complemented by a crisp note of watermelon. Conceived as a molecular perfume, Zark Ahlmann Pavlov’s creation develops individually on the skin and is suitable as a unisex fragrance for all wearers. Launched in 2016, the Eau de Parfum is also vegan and was produced without animal testing. Aromatic and fresh fragrance character A composition of three musk molecules and watermelon Molecular unisex perfume Vegan and not tested on animals

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection Eau de Parfum Spray No. 1 100 ml
listings.description: A fascinating interplay of contrasts defines the character of Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection Eau de Parfum Spray No. 1. Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov developed this composition to re-explore the boundaries of classical perfumery and create a fragrance that can respond to the individual’s aura. Visually, the creation immediately catches the eye with its striking orange-coloured liquid in a clear glass bottle, which emphasises the vibrancy of its contents. Olfactorily, Danish sea buckthorn opens the experience, imparting a fruity, slightly tart note that instantly captures the attention. At the heart, the elegance of French jasmine absolute then unfolds, lending the composition a floral yet refined depth. The bouquet is rounded off by a warm driftwood accord in the base, which provides a consistent, woody nuance and grounds the lighter notes. Launched in 2017, the Eau de Parfum is often classified as floral-woody and is characterised by its complex layering. The result is an olfactory composition that harmoniously superimposes lighter and darker facets. The understated elegance of the bottle, with its black cylindrical cap and repeated lettering, reflects the brand’s modern, Nordic approach. Fragrance family: Floral-woody with fruity accents. Main notes: Danish sea buckthorn, French jasmine absolute and a driftwood accord. Special feature: The orange-coloured liquid symbolises the fragrance’s high-contrast layered concept. Design: Transparent glass bottle with a black cap and minimalist typography. Background: Created by perfumer Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov, launched in 2017.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Patchouli Dust Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In 2023, the niche label Pana Dora Sweden presents the extrait de parfum Patchouli Dust. It is unisex and has a green-woody fragrance . The eye-catching bottle with the deer head is typical of the luxury label and gives it an exceptional recognition value. Perfumer Ibrahim Al-Zoubi is behind the Patchouli Dust fragrance. He has created a top note of artemesia, saffron, cardamom, cypress and patchouli. The heart note contains the aromas of nutmeg, vetiver and Taif rose. The extrait de parfum Patchouli Dust is rounded off with cedar, amber, oud, tonka bean and vanilla. For everyone, but definitely not for everyone Pana Dora Sweden is well aware that the fragrance is offputting, but that is intentional. The company is proud to be a niche label and is happy in the role of olfactory outsider. The extrait de parfum Patchouli Dust divides opinion, either you love it or you can't do anything with it. Those who love it are thrilled by an unusual creation that is so gloriously non-conformist and, like its wearers, is simply something special. The Pana Dora Sweden label is as far removed from the mainstream as the people for whom a special fragrance is part of their normal demeanour because they are also beyond the mainstream.

listings.rawTitle: EL GANSO Limoncello Eau de Toilette Spray 125 ml
listings.description: The Spanish label EL GANSO is introducing the Limoncello Season eau de toilette spray in 2021. Lively, wonderfully wearable and inspired by the famous Limoncello liqueur, the Eau de Toilette Spray is a casual and relaxed companion for everyday and evening wear on all warm and hot days of the year. EL GANSO Limoncello Season Eau de Toilette Spray fulfils these requirements with lightness and a Mediterranean flair.

The heart note of EL GANSO Like Father Like Son Eau de Toilette Spray picks up exactly where the top note left off. The mint then provides sufficient freshness, inviting you to linger even on hot days. The EL GANSO Like Father Like Son Eau de Toilette Spray finalises its own fragrance with a base made up of extracts of sandalwood, amber and vetiver - and gives this fragrance the necessary warmth. For obvious reasons, it also makes a great gift for father and son or as a Father's Day present, for example.

Fortan is Sunday every day - at least on the skin! The heart note of EL GANSO Sunday Mood Eau de Toilette Spray fragrance is floral and fresh at the same time. The base note is deliberately natural and just as fresh, thanks primarily to the cedarwood. However, sandalwood and vetiver should not go unmentioned as counterparts in the base note of the EL GANSO Sunday Mood Eau de Toilette Spray fragrance. And the bottle? It's definitely a chic eye-catcher!

With a natural base note consisting of various woods and musk, the top and heart notes can radiate in full intensity and strength - much to the delight of the wearer of this great fragrance.

listings.description: Dancing On Goosebumps is an unusual eau de parfum spray from Emil Élise. The young company based in Essen is tapping into a new audience that traditional perfume manufacturers are unable to reach. Individuality is the key. The fragrance creations are not categorised. They are intended for anyone who wants to wear them. This eau de parfum spray is also a creative unisex fragrance for everyone who loves perfumes. Dancing On Goosebumps: a fragrance for individualists Emil Élise takes a fresh look at the perfume world. Men, women and fragrance categories do not play a role. Instead, each individual person with their own characteristics is important. Modern fragrances are just as flexible and multi-layered as the people who wear them. Dancing On Goosebumps is a successful example of how this concept works. The notes of the creation are spicy, woody, smoky and invite you to rediscover the fragrance again and again. The citrus elements dominate at the beginning: Bergamot and petitgrain create a sparkling accord. The heart note continues in an unusual way. It consists of a combination of pink pepper and incense. The final chord is earthy and woody. Cashmere wood and papyrus meet vetiver. The base note is rounded off with amber.

listings.rawTitle: Mihan Aromatics Petrichor Plains Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Petrichor Plains: an insider tip from Down Under. The charismatic unisex fragrance comes from Mihan Aromatics. The young company prefers to use raw materials from sustainable production. This also means that it primarily uses substances that are native to Australia. The result fascinates perfume connoisseurs all over the world. This is because these fragrance creations stand out from the classic perfumes of European origin - reason enough to try out this exciting eau de parfum spray. Petrichor Plains by Mihan Aromatics: the scent of rain The fifth continent is rich in breathtaking landscapes and unique natural phenomena. They don't just attract tourists. They also serve as inspiration for wonderful perfumes. This unusual eau de parfum spray is inspired by the petrichor phenomenon . It occurs when raindrops fall on dry, warm rocky ground. This creates a very specific scent that can often be experienced in Australia. Aquatic, woody, green : this is how the perfume can be described. The heart note is multi-layered: violets, fresh, spicy rosemary and cardamom blend to create a seductive accord. The harmonious base consists of amyris and Australian Buddha wood.

listings.rawTitle: Mihan Aromatics Guilty Story Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Mihan Aromatics Guilty Story Eau de Parfum Spray focuses on spontaneity and an unconditionally lived moment. It is up to the wearer of this unisex fragrance to decide whether this took place on a wild night of partying or on a lonely walk along a sandy beach swept clean in the early hours of the morning. This perfume is always intoxicating, an unrecognisable passion is immediately apparent with the first spritz of Mihan Aromatics Guilty Story Eau de Parfum Spray. The Australian brand also uses Australian sandalwood in this perfume, which adds a slightly more intense note - without losing its fresh fragrance character. A touch of the Orient - framed by exclusive woods While the Mihan Aromatics Guilty Story Eau de Parfum Spray opens with neroli, the heart note becomes even more oriental with saffron and cinnamon. The base note combines cedarwood, sandalwood and musk, while vanilla, also contained in the perfume, adds a sweet accent. This recognisable fragrance has become a real insider tip since its market launch in 2018 - and a great choice for anyone who loves oriental notes with subtle woody accords. The minimalist, elongated bottle with a black cap acts as an effective contrast to the multi-layered and sometimes exotic essences.

listings.rawTitle: Mihan Aromatics Kirra Curl Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Kirra Curl Eau de Parfum Spray by Mihan Aromatics is a fantastic fragrance that is suitable for all genders It has been on the market since 2021. Its unique fragrance composition enchants with sparkling marine notes and woody accords. It transports you to a sun-drenched beach in Australia, where countless surfers ride the waves and a refreshing sea breeze invigorates the senses. This irresistible perfume is the ideal choice for self-confident, sporty people who love adventure. Fascinating perfume for many occasions The Kirra Curl Eau de Parfum Spray by Mihan Aromatics is the perfect fragrance for many occasions thanks to its sparkling facets. It combines aquatic accents with spicy woody notes. Its top note combines sea salt with refreshing lemon peel. In the heart note, the strong aroma of leather meets the characteristic tones of surf wax. Finally, the unmistakable notes of Australian buddhawood and sandalwood surprise, harmoniously rounded off by a sweet hint of vanilla. Experience unforgettable moments with the seductive fragrance from Mihan Aromatics!

listings.rawTitle: Mihan Aromatics Sinful Rose Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Mihan Aromatics Sinful Rose Eau de Parfum Spray is as imaginative as it is a little intimate. Not surprisingly, given the name of this perfume, its fragrance world revolves entirely around the unmistakable accords of the sinful rose . The perfume wants to whisk you away: To a remote, tangled and completely secluded rose garden somewhere in Mediterranean climes, where you can savour the tranquillity of the moment as well as a pinch of passion to the full. In this Mihan Aromatics Sinful Rose Eau de Parfum Spray, the Turkish rose is present in both the top and heart notes and is therefore omnipresent in all fragrance phases. An almost mystical dance of flowers The perfume, whose bottle is discreetly understated, opens with the eponymous Turkish rose and a hint of geranium and bergamot. Mihan Aromatics Sinful Rose Eau de Parfum Spray then moves on to tonka bean, vanilla and ginger extracts in the heart note, framing this trio in the powdery, velvety scent of rose. The base note, meanwhile, is somewhat more powerful and spicy, thanks in particular to the eaglewood and oud accords and benzoin resin. This gives the fragrance an intimate yet mature and sophisticated feel.

listings.rawTitle: Mihan Aromatics Mikado Bark Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Mikado Bark is a harmonious, characterful unisex fragrance from Mihan Aromatics. The Australian perfume manufacturer has established itself on the market with its creations. Typical Australian ingredients are just as much a part of the company's philosophy as the use of high-quality sugar cane as an alternative to conventional ethanol. Each perfume is characterised by a distinctive Australian aspect and invites you to get to know the fifth continent better. Mikado Bark: a nostalgic fragrance for men and women Familiarity is an important aspect of the fragrances from Mihan Aromatics. The perfumers use ingredients that evoke memories and associations in everyone who comes into contact with the fragrance. It is hardly surprising that the eau de parfum spray is designed for men and women. Unisex fragrances appeal to everyone. They are not bound to gender. This also applies to this fresh, green-spicy fragrance composition. The perfume opens with the scent of damp earth. Whether it is dew or rain is up to the wearer to decide. This is complemented by the intensely spicy aroma of fresh sage leaves. The heart note brings autumnal memories: Cinnamon bark and cloves give it a dry, spicy character. The eau de parfum spray ends with green and woody notes: Patchouli and Virginia cedar form a natural, dreamy final chord.

listings.description: Munlark Ash Eau de Parfum Spray by Mihan Aromatics takes you on an olfactory journey through mysterious forests and misty landscapes. Clear, elegant and minimalist - it not only holds the coveted fragrance, but also embodies the vision behind this work of art. A fragrance that is suitable for both day and evening, emphasising the wearer's character with sophistication and depth. Munlark Ash Eau de Parfum Spray is more than just a fragrance. It is an ode to nature, a story that is retold with every drop. A masterpiece for all those who are looking for something special.

listings.rawTitle: Headspace Collection Extrait de Parfum Spray Tabac 50 ml
listings.description: The Headspace Tabac Extrait de Parfum Spray offers a woody and amber-scented fragrance composition that ensures a lasting presence in everyday life. The spicy top notes of aniseed, ginger and clove open the fragrance experience and create a striking start to the day. This is followed by a heart note of coffee, hay and tonka bean, which lends the fragrance a multi-layered structure and rounds off the wearing experience. Finally, the base note of tobacco leaves, ambroxan and vanilla rounds off the profile, leaving a warm trail on the skin. Perfumer Julien Rasquinet developed this fragrance for the French niche brand to strike a balance between spicy and soft elements. Thanks to its high fragrance concentration as an ‘Extrait de Parfum’, just a few sprays are enough to achieve an expressive result, allowing for efficient and economical use. The minimalist, transparent glass bottle with a black label and fluted cap blends unobtrusively into any perfume collection. listings.rawTitle: Headspace Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Cherry 100 ml
listings.description: The enticing excitement of a first date. The art of seduction, the instinctive attraction. The fragrance unfolds with a lush, liqueur-like cherry that delicately blends with the powdery, iridescent sake. Saffron with its leather facets merges into a firm, pleasant suede accord and weaves a complex tapestry of sensuality. listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Nuit Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: The Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Nuit Eau de Parfum Spray turns day into night - in a charming, sensual way! Experience precious moments with the perfume that emphasises your femininity and brings out your mysterious side. Bronze Goddess Nuit is your reliable companion for romantic dinners under the stars as well as for a break in the middle of the day. Magical and enchanting Spicy, even slightly smoky, but still exuding pure femininity with a hint of flowers: this is how the Eau de Parfum Spray by Estée Lauder can be aptly described. The mystical side of this exquisite fragrance is omnipresent and transports you to a world full of magic. Experience marvellous sunsets or the view of the stars, even if only during a short dream journey in everyday life. The fragrance nuances of Bronze Goddess Nuit are very versatile and start with sweet bergamot and exotic ylang-ylang. A peppery accord keeps the perfume interesting and exciting. A bouquet of flowers then unfolds, accompanied by coconut, which reminds you of faraway destinations in places like the Caribbean. Enjoy your personal everyday time-out again and again - with the fragrance from Estée Lauder!

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray My Devotion 30 ml
listings.description: With Dolce&Gabbana My Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense, you will discover a harmonious fragrance composition that enriches your everyday life with floral, fruity notes. The top note of delicate pear blossom and blackcurrant opens the experience and offers you a refreshing moment to start the day. Orange blossom and peony then unfold their floral accents, elegantly emphasising your charisma for every occasion. The base of ambroxan, warm Madagascar vanilla and amber rounds off the creation and leaves a long-lasting, gourmand presence on the skin that will accompany you reliably into the evening. This composition is encased in a shiny pink bottle with an ornate golden heart emblem. listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One For Men Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: This eau de parfum, launched in 2015, is a deeper and denser interpretation of the classic fragrance concept. Designed by Olivier Polge, the composition is characterised by a higher concentration of fragrance oils, which ensures a long-lasting fragrance experience. The opening is characterised by a combination of grapefruit, coriander and basil, which conveys an aromatic yet elegant freshness. As the fragrance progresses, a spicy heart unfolds, in which striking notes of ginger and cardamom meet the subtle nuance of orange blossom. These elements finally merge into a persistent base characterised by accords of tobacco, amber and cedar wood, giving the perfume its woody character. The design of the bottle emphasises the value of the contents: A heavy, rectangular glass body reveals the brown liquid and is topped with a colour-coordinated, dark brown cap. The clear, geometric lines are only accentuated by a silver inscription on the front, which completes the overall aesthetic look. Fragrance: Warm and spicy with woody and aromatic elements Head note: A fresh blend of grapefruit, coriander and basil. Heart note: Spicy accents of ginger and cardamom as well as orange blossom. Base note: Deep accords of tobacco, amber and cedarwood. Design: Rectangular glass bottle with brown contents and dark brown cap.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Only One captures the essence of elegant, mesmerising femininity. This composition impresses with a modern combination of violet and coffee notes. Like the woman it represents, the fragrance is a complex interplay of contrasts. This beguiling creation draws its special charm from the unexpected mocha violet note. The violet opens up the fragrance and combines with subtle notes of bergamot to create a lively, fresh and juicy bouquet. A harmonious whole emerges in the heart note with the fusion of seductive notes of rich coffee and charming iris, while the base delicately envelops the senses with a coating of vanilla and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue pour homme Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Parfum Spray offers an intense fragrance composition that transports you to the vast hilly landscapes of Tuscany. The creation is presented in a clear glass bottle with a light blue lid and subtle gold-coloured accents. The fine atomiser allows you to apply the perfume precisely and evenly to the desired areas of skin. Immediately after application, a fresh note of Sicilian lemon unfolds, providing a pleasant start to the day in the morning. Later on, the fruity nuances of fig combine with the warm, earthy character of Virginian cedarwood to create a well-rounded overall picture. This balanced combination gives you an aura of presence that is suitable for both business and leisure. As this is a highly concentrated eau de parfum, you benefit from a long-lasting fragrance that will reliably accompany you for many hours and makes constant refreshing unnecessary. Intense eau de parfum for a long-lasting fragrance presence without frequent re-spraying Fine atomiser enables precise and even application to the skin Fresh top note of Sicilian lemon supports a pleasant start to the day Warm base of cedar wood and fig emphasises a self-confident radiance in everyday life

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Devotion by Dolce&Gabbana is an eau de parfum spray that captures the essence of true devotion and passion. This beguiling eau de parfum spray opens with a vibrant explosion of citrus notes that immediately awaken the senses and exude an aura of energy and freshness. The top note consists of a carefully selected blend of sparkling bergamot, juicy citrus fruits, which together create an irresistibly attractive and invigorating opening. Exclusive perfume from Dolce&Gabbana At the heart of the fragrance, a floral bouquet of delicate orange blossom unfolds, creating a romantic and sensual atmosphere. These floral notes are skilfully interwoven with a hint of spicy patchouli, giving the perfume added depth and complexity. The base notes of Devotion perfume are warm and seductive, with rich accords of vanilla that give the fragrance an earthy, soothing quality and leave a lasting impression. These balsamic notes round off the fragrance and create a feeling of luxury and sophistication. Devotion Eau de Parfum Spray by Dolce & Gabbana is a fragrance for the confident woman who embraces her sensuality and does not shy away from expressing her passions. It is a fragrance that is suitable for both day and evening, enveloping the wearer in an aura of elegance and grace.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray is an exclusive and extraordinary fragrance that is noble, graceful and luxurious . The name translates as "The Empress". There is therefore no doubt that this is an extravagant perfume that envelops women in a distinguished, aristocratic aura . Fruity-sweet notes meet fresh and floral influences and give every woman a romantic, seductive and extremely attractive aura. A touch of decadence is used here as a playful stylistic device. Modern, decadent and elegant - a fragrance with an aristocratic signature Fruity notes of redcurrant, kiwi and rhubarb open the unmistakable fragrance composition in the top note. The heart note is perfectly complemented by the sounds of pink cyclamen and watermelon. The Dolce&Gabbana L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray is rounded off in the base with accords of grapefruit wood, musk and sandalwood. This is where the fragrance gains its depth and intensity. listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense 30 ml
listings.description: The One Eau de Parfum Intense is a fascinating reinterpretation of the well-known classic. Perfumer Quentin Bisch is responsible for this composition, which combines tried-and-tested elements with new accents. Bright notes of spicy pink pepper meet the freshness of mandarin and the fruitiness of blackcurrant in the opening. At the centre of the creation is a striking jasmine note that gives the fragrance a distinct floral character. This heart note transitions gently into a persistent base. Here, creamy vanilla and rich amber accords come together to create a harmonious finish. This combination creates an aura of opulence and warmth that remains perceptible for several hours. The high-quality content is also reflected visually. A heavy, rectangular bottle made of amber-coloured glass with clear, rounded edges houses the golden liquid. A wide, shiny metallic cap in a gold tone rounds off the design harmoniously. Black letters on the front provide a clear contrast to the warm colour of the glass and underline the modern elegance of the presentation. The eau de parfum is available in different quantities, such as 50 ml or 100 ml, to suit different needs. Intense reinterpretation of the classic fragrance by Quentin Bisch Composition of pink pepper, jasmine, vanilla and amber Rectangular amber-coloured glass bottle with gold accents Available in different sizes such as 50 ml and 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in a world of passion and elegance with the Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray. This intensified version of the popular Devotion fragrance is a tribute to the timeless beauty and power of love. With its unique fragrance composition, this perfume takes you on a sensual journey. The floral elegance of orange blossom unfolds at the heart of the perfume, lending the fragrance a delicate, feminine note. The base note rounds off the composition with warm, sweet vanilla, which ensures a long-lasting, seductive fragrance. The Eau de Parfum Intense Spray by Dolce&Gabbana is characterised by its particularly concentrated formulation, which ensures a long-lasting fragrance. The elegant bottle with its characteristic golden cap is not only a container for the precious fragrance, but also a real piece of jewellery for your dressing table. To optimise the fragrance, it is recommended to apply the perfume to pulse points such as the wrists, neck and décolleté. It is particularly suitable for special occasions and evening events, but also gives you an aura of luxury and sophistication in everyday life. Let yourself be enchanted by the unique combination of nutty, floral and sweet notes. Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray is more than just a perfume - it is an expression of devotion and elegance that accompanies you throughout the day and emphasises your individual personality.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray 200 ml
listings.description: With K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum , Dolce&Gabbana Beauty offers a fragrance for men that is as unique as it is sensual . Intense, attractive and sensual at the same time, K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum tells the story of an authentic and modern man. Right from the start, the perfume creates a sparkling opening with the fusion of fresh citrus fruits, tangy blood orange and fine essences of lemon torchio. The fragrance is intensified by a spicy note of cardamom and a hint of pimento essence. A combination of fresh geranium, soothing clary sage and exquisite lavender, refined by the addition of creamy fig milk, brings a hint of delicate sweetness to the heart of this delicate yet powerful fragrance. Finally, a sensual hint of wood, patchouli and vetiver is sprinkled through a warm Nagarmotha wood. K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum is a woody and spicy fragrance that offers an intimate glimpse into the heart of a modern king.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana K by Dolce&Gabbana Perfume 50 ml
listings.description: K by Dolce&Gabbana - a fascinating fragrance composition that embodies masculine elegance in its purest form. In this expressive eau de parfum by Dolce&Gabbana, Mediterranean freshness, aromatic spice and precious woods merge into an irresistible symbiosis. Exclusive perfume by Dolce&Gabbana for the modern man The elegant flacon presents itself like a precious treasure, its striking, handcrafted crown guarding a royal composition. Underneath, the sun-drenched sweetness of Italian blood orange first unfolds, immediately transporting the wearer to a Mediterranean garden and enchanting them with its invigorating freshness. While the citrusy notes of K by Dolce&Gabbana gently fade away, a perfectly balanced liaison of herbaceous, fresh sage and floral, spicy geranium develops at the heart of the fragrance. This aromatic combination creates a sophisticated masculinity that is both powerful and elegant in equal measure. In the depths of the composition, noble cedar and exotic nagarmotha come together in an impressive interplay. This precious root, also known as cypriol, enhances the woody-spicy character of the fragrance and ensures a long-lasting, unforgettable fragrance experience on the skin. K by Dolce&Gabbana thus embodies the perfect choice for the modern gentleman who values timeless elegance and a presence full of character - a seductive fragrance from Dolce&Gabbana that celebrates Italian perfumery craftsmanship at its finest.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray Intense 50 ml
listings.description: 2024 sees the launch of the Eau de Parfum Spray Intense K by Dolce&Gabbana. The perfume from Dolce&Gabbana is for men and has a fresh, oriental fragrance . Created by the grand mistress Nathalie Lorson and Daphné Bugey, this perfume only needs three ingredients to develop its casual elegance. Without a fragrance pyramid, the Eau de Parfum Spray Intense K by Dolce&Gabbana blends figs, leather and saffron. Dolce&Gabbana has succeeded in creating an expressive, sensual fragrance for men that is both elegant and casual, perceptible but not overpowering. A true all-rounder with depth Masculine fragrances are often over-present and, especially at work, men prefer to wear a fragrance that doesn't arrive 5 minutes before they do. The Eau de Parfum Spray Intense K by Dolce&Gabbana is just such a fragrance. It accompanies its wearer with a perceptible presence, but without imposing itself. Dolce&Gabbana's perfume is just as perfect for leisure as it is for work, regardless of the season. The stylish, dark blue bottle with a silver crown conceals a perfume that men like to wear and women like to notice on their counterparts. The more intense version of K from 2020 is simply ravishing .

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Dolce Eau de Toilette Spray Lily 75 ml
listings.description: Dolce Lily celebrates the charisma of the pink lily - a symbol of femininity and tenderness since time immemorial. The fragrance is a fresh, fruity, floral composition in which the delicate floral notes of the lily meet exotic passion fruit on a bed of soft, sensual musk. Powerful fruity notes open the composition - the sparkling citrus notes of Italian bergamot play with a touch of tropical passion fruit. This exotic touch leads into the floral heart note, in which sparkling pink lily blends with sophisticated rose tones. The radiance of these flowers contrasts with the soft musky notes that form a subtly sensual accord beneath and behind them. Sandalwood grounds the composition with its own depth, and vanilla tones allow the composition to linger long on the skin. The bottle picks up on the feminine elegance of the original Dolce silhouette, but now dresses in a bold pink, from which the vivacious personality of the Dolce girl shines out into the world. The familiar floral cap comes in the same vibrant pink and anticipates the fresh lily accord of the fragrance.

Who could resist this potpourri? Discover your royal charm with Dolce&Gabbana Experience the diversity of Q by Dolce&Gabbana! The Eau de Parfum Spray Intense is as individual as your look. It starts with a revelation of cherry and citrus fruits, then moves into a heart of heliotrope and cherry and garnishes the whole thing with a hint of jasmine. It is mysterious and almost unapproachable, but the sweetness makes it playful again. In the base, accords such as amber and cedarwood are true classics that prove themselves time and time again. Overall, the different components create a sophisticated, expressive fragrance that skilfully interweaves tradition and modernity. Feel like a queen at every moment with Q by Dolce&Gabbana! This is achieved on the one hand by the fragrance itself and on the other by the royal flacon, which is closed with a crown.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Dolce Eau de Toilette Spray Rose 50 ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana Beauty adds another flower to the Dolce bouquet: DOLCE ROSE. The lively and beguiling eau de toilette shows the world another facet of the Dolce girls. Bold, optimistic and sociable, they say what they think and light up the streets with their feminine spontaneity. Dolce Rose captures this carefree joy in a fragrance that is as powerful and spirited as any Dolce Girl. The first eau de toilette in the Dolce collection, Dolce Rose celebrates the queen of flowers, a symbol of love, beauty and femininity and a signature motif in Dolce&Gabbana's work. Created by master perfumer Violaine Collas, the fragrance combines delicate rose absolute and fresh centifolia notes with soft musk and tangy redcurrant. Full of energy and joie de vivre, Dolce Rose is an irresistibly enchanting composition. Intense fruity top notes open the composition in a triad of fresh green apple, juicy mandarin and tangy redcurrant. In the heart note, white peach appeals to our sense of taste and opens our senses to a floral bouquet of velvety magnolia blossoms and majestic roses. The unique character of the fragrance is created from a composition of two rose notes: The dewy clarity of a centifolia essence combines with the soft sensuality of rose absolute to create an unmistakable rose fragrance. This powerful note is embedded in a mantle of soft musk tones, to which sandalwood and other noble light wood notes lend a beguilingly sensual quality. The bottle shares its soft curves and elegantly feminine silhouette with the original Dolce fragrance, but now dips its glass in a rose-red colour in which the eponymous blossom seems to glow. The unmistakable flower cap is now also dressed in a bold red colour that expresses the personality of the Dolce girl and the fascinating facets of the fragrance.

The Dolce Peony eau de parfum spray from Dolce&Gabbana also leaves a lasting impression. The fragrance is perfect for women who savour every day and constantly face new challenges. The pastel purple glass bottle and the small black bow give the Dolce&Gabbana Dolce Peony Eau de Parfum Spray an additional cheerful effect with an elegant touch.

listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana presents Dolce Blue Jasmine Eau de Parfum, a harmonious composition that combines the sweetness of Sicilian blue fig with the sensual nuances of Arabian jasmine. This fascinating blend is rounded off by the warm and gentle accents of cedar wood. The fragrance unfolds with the milky and refreshing notes of fig, accompanied by green accents, and plunges into a floral heart of jasmine. The perfume is housed in an elegant bottle from the Dolce collection, whose delicate azure blue colour is crowned by a floral cap with a black bow. This carefully designed packaging reflects the sophistication and charm of the fragrance. Inspired by the vibrant atmosphere of the Sicilian countryside, Dolce Blue Jasmine Eau de Parfum invites you to savour life's unexpected moments to the full. A fragrance that embodies optimism and freedom and encourages you to consciously experience every moment.</p

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Fame Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Rabanne Fame Eau de Parfum Spray is a powerful yet sensual women's fragrance that emphasises its wearer's multifaceted nature and uniqueness. The fragrance emphasises the playful, romantic nature of femininity as well as its sensual traits. The perfume is suitable for women who like to express their individuality in an exclusive setting. With Fame Eau de Parfum Spray, the exceptional designer Rabanne succeeds in enveloping every woman in a fascinating and mysterious aura . A sensual fragrance for the exclusive moments in life In the top note, the citrus-fresh lightness of bergamot paired with the sweet fruitiness of tropical mango opens the elegant fragrance experience. The heart note brings out the oriental components of seductive jasmine and smoky, spicy incense. In the base note, the sweetness of vanilla and the aroma of soft sandalwood take the lead. This makes Fame Eau de Parfum Spray by Rabanne an olfactory hymn to femininity that subtly emphasises the different characteristics of women. A sophisticated fragrance for all seasons, which is particularly captivating in the warmer months thanks to its sweetness. The extravagant glass flacon in an eye-catching and opulent design leaves no doubt that this fragrance emphasises the uniqueness of its wearer and skilfully brings it to the fore. A highlight in any bathroom.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Phantom In Red Parfum Elixir 50 ml
listings.description: The Rabanne Phantom In Red Parfum Elixir is an intense reinterpretation of the well-known Phantom line, which is characterised by a high concentration of fragrance oils. This Parfum Elixir unfolds a complex, amber-aromatic and woody profile that picks up on the characteristic lavender note of the series and expands it with unexpected nuances. The opening is a combination of fruity plum liqueur and saffron, which creates a striking first impression. At the heart of the fragrance, classic lavender, sage and orange blossom combine to form a harmonious whole. The composition is rounded off by a warm base of benzoin, tobacco, oud and amberwood, which lends the fragrance depth and longevity. The design of the bottle picks up on the futuristic robot aesthetic and creates visual highlights with red accents and a black dot in a red oval on the top. It is a fragrance that has a multi-layered structure thanks to its earthy and woody facets and the integration of citrus notes such as bergamot oil. Fragrance family: Earthy-woody with amber-aromatic facets. Head notes: Plum liqueur and saffron. Heart notes: Lavender, sage and orange blossom. Base notes: Benzoin, tobacco, oud and amberwood. Special feature: High concentration as a perfume elixir for long-lasting intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Invictus Elixir Parfum Elixir 50 ml
listings.description: The Rabanne 1 Million Night Parfum Elixir unfurls an intense fragrance composition that offers a present radiance for the evening hours. The top note of mandarin opens the olfactory experience with a citrus-fresh prelude and ensures a clear first impression after spraying. The heart note of maple syrup adds a subtle sweetness that gives the fragrance a warm structure. The base of amber and benzoin rounds off the woody profile and leaves a long-lasting, ambery-balsamic finish. This harmonised combination makes the perfume particularly suitable for going out or festive occasions. As a vegan Intense Eau de Parfum, the creation has a high fragrance concentration, which means that just a few sprays are enough for a clearly perceptible result. The striking bottle in the shape of a goblet with a black and gold colour gradient visually completes the concept. Intense eau de parfum with a high fragrance concentration for long-lasting perceptibility Woody and ambery-balsamic fragrance with a fresh opening Vegan formulation that is completely free from animal ingredients Warm heart note of maple syrup for a pleasant fragrance development throughout the evening

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Olympéa Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense 30 ml
listings.description: The Rabanne Fame Intense Eau de Parfum envelops the senses with a warm, floral-woody fragrance composition that is reminiscent of the special atmosphere of Parisian dusk. Immediately after spraying, a fresh, slightly tropical top note of coconut and bergamot unfolds, providing a pleasant start to the fragrance experience. The perfume then develops a deep, intense presence through the heart notes of sunny jasmine, incense, ylang-ylang and patchouli. This combination is ideal for special occasions, elegant evening events or moments when an expressive appearance is desired in everyday life. The base note of sandalwood, musk and cedarwood gives the fragrance a long-lasting character, so that the composition remains reliably perceptible on the skin for many hours. The full potential of the individual fragrance chords can be unleashed by spraying onto pulsating areas of the body such as the inside of the wrists, the neck or behind the ears. The bulbous, transparent glass bottle with its elegant gold application rounds off the high-quality fragrance experience in a visually appealing way. listings.rawTitle: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: A fragrance bouquet as colourful and versatile as its composer - but with a deep black name that skilfully underlines the seduction of the perfume: Crystal Noir by Versace is an unforgettably beautiful fragrance for exciting experiences in the evening or at night. On the one hand delicate and unobtrusive, on the other unmistakably feminine and intense - the Eau de Parfum Spray delights its wearers with these characteristics. Crystal Noir by Versace consists of various woody, fruity and floral accords . The fragrance bouquet opens with top notes of spicy ginger, intense cardamom and pepper. Fresh and light, this first scent envelops the wearer. This is followed by a warm, feminine note composed of fresh orange blossom and floral gardenia, without forgetting the peony. Finally, a woody aura awaits the wearer, resulting from the base note with sandalwood, ambergris and musk. If you can resist this perfume on your skin, it's your own fault...</h2 The Eau de Parfum Spray is also visually impressive to match its contents: cuboid in shape, with a striking cap and in the sensual colours of burgundy and black, it is waiting to be discovered by you. For yourself or as a gift!

listings.rawTitle: Versace Versense Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Versace Versense is an eau de toilette that presents a composition of freshness and sensuality. The fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of Mediterranean fruits, in which bergamot, green mandarin and tangy citrus fruits meet the gentle sweetness of fig and pear. An elegant floral bouquet unfolds at the heart of the creation. Delicate notes of lily and jasmine combine with the special presence of narcissus and are rounded off with a hint of spicy cardamom. The base note gives the perfume a warm and earthy depth. A harmonious combination of sandalwood, cedarwood and the characteristic aroma of the olive tree is underlined by gentle musk. This woody-floral fragrance is a suitable companion for everyday wear, especially in the warmer months of the year. Fragrance direction: Woody, floral, musk Head note: A lively opening with bergamot, green mandarin and fig Heart note: A floral heart of lily and jasmine, refined with cardamom. Base note: A warm base of sandalwood, cedar and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Dylan Purple pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Versace takes you straight to Italy with Dylan Purple pour Femme! The summery country is bursting with joie de vivre - and you can too with this eau de parfum spray! Fruity notes will envelop you and bring the typical "dolce vita" to wherever you apply the fragrance. Plus point: Like all Versace fragrances, Dylan Purple also comes in an eye-catching bottle that is a harmonious addition to your collection. Exciting fragrance journey through Italy's sunny side The floral-fruity fragrance character of Dylan Purple pour Femme captures the positive characteristics of Italy. On the one hand, there are the fresh accords of pear juice and bitter orange and the floral accords of rose and iris . On the other hand, there are the warm and sensual nuances such as cedarwood, musk and amber, which represent the flirtatious and seductive side of Italy. The well-known fragrance brand behind the perfume has thought of everything here! The eau de parfum spray is also visually impressive with its characteristic bottle, which is a vibrant pink-violet colour on the one hand and stands for pure elegance with its golden cap on the other. If you already have similar fragrances from Versace, Dylan Purple will also fit in perfectly as a decorative element in the bathroom or on the dressing table.

listings.rawTitle: DKNY 24/7 Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Discover DKNY 24/7 Eau de Parfum Spray, a fragrance that captures the never-sleeping energy of the city of New York. This perfume by Donna Karan New York is the perfect choice for the self-confident, dynamic woman who wants to savour every moment of her life to the full. The perfume opens with a surprising and invigorating top note of spicy pepper, fruity quince and refreshing rhubarb. This unique combination awakens the senses and immediately conveys a feeling of energy and vitality. A lush bouquet of flowers unfolds at the heart of DKNY's Eau de Parfum Spray. Jasmine, rose and intense tuberose combine to create a seductive floral composition that radiates elegance and femininity. This floral heart note forms the perfect transition between the fresh opening and the warm base. The base note of 24/7 rounds off the fragrance harmoniously and ensures its longevity. The woody, ambery scent of ambroxan gives the fragrance depth and character, while sensual musk provides a warm, cosy note. This combination creates an unforgettable fragrance signature that lasts all day. DKNY 24/7 Eau de Parfum Spray is a versatile fragrance that accompanies you from morning to night. It is just as suitable for a busy day at the office as it is for going out in the evening. The modern and elegant bottle design reflects the urban character of the fragrance and makes it a real eye-catcher on any dressing table.

At the heart of the fragrance, a fascinating bouquet of intense osmanthus and elegant jasmine unfolds, which is given a special tension by a subtle spiciness. The base note rounds off the olfactory experience and leaves a lasting, warm impression. This is where light-coloured woods meet the striking note of cedarwood and sensual ambroxan, which gives the fragrance its self-confident radiance. As an eau de toilette, Wood Pour Femme is an ideal companion for the day, revealing its full splendour especially in spring and summer. Fragrance direction: woody-floral A composition of fruity, floral and warm woody notes Top notes characterised by mandarin, raspberry leaves and magnolia Ideal for everyday use, especially in spring and summer

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 ICON Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Dsquared2 ICON Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray has truly earned its name: the fragrance pyramid of this perfume is at least as iconic as the bottle. It shows in an impressive way how such a simple contrast between black and white can still attract attention almost magically. However, the big highlight of this perfume awaits you with the first spritz: it is immediately apparent why the bottle has such a high-contrast design - because the composition of this perfume is also characterised by many contrasts and natural counterparts. A masculine yet light fragrance On the nose, Dsquared2 ICON Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray opens with sparkling citrus fruits, which are given both a warm and spicy note by the addition of ginger. The play of contrasts in Dsquared2 ICON Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray continues in the heart, where spicy icons such as clary sage meet the floral and often rather soft accords of geranium, black tulip and lavender. In the base note, woody accords set the tone together with patchouli - the result is a masculine, modern, contrasting and, above all, bold fragrance that is highly addictive.
