listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Wood Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The men's fragrance Wood Pour Homme by Dsquared² was launched in 2018 together with the Eau de Toilette Spray Wood Pour Femme. As the name suggests, the fragrance is fresh and woody . The Wood Pour Homme bottle has a classic shape and is coloured a transparent brown. The closure of the bottle is reminiscent of a wooden cork, further emphasising the character of the fragrance. Equipped with above-average longevity and sillage, the eau de toilette spray delights with its masculine and modern presence that suits all occasions. More wood from Dsquared² for him Alberto Morillas creates a top note of mandarin, Sicilian lemon and Calabrian bergamot for the Wood Pour Homme fragrance. In the heart note, cardamom and ginger meet green-tart violet leaves. Finally, vetiver and ambrox combine with light-coloured woods to create a fine base note. The eau de toilette spray is a worthy successor to the numerous fragrances from Dsquared² that are dedicated to the theme of wood. The almost purist structure makes the fragrance interesting not only for lovers of woody scents. Dsquared² would like to divide the spirits, but with Wood Pour Homme this will be difficult, because it is the perfect summer fragrance for men.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Original Wood Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Original Wood Eau de Parfum Spray by Dsquared2 is a powerful fragrance composition inspired by the strength and complexity of wood. The fragrance opens with an invigorating freshness of violet leaf and aquatic notes, complemented by the spicy warmth of cardamom from Guatemala. A striking woody accord of vetiver, cedarwood and silver fir unfolds in the heart, reminiscent of the clear atmosphere of a forest after a rain shower. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a warm and creamy base of musk, Indonesian patchouli and herbal amber, which lends the fragrance a long-lasting depth. Presented in a straightforward bottle with brand-typical elements, Original Wood is a versatile companion for everyday life and special moments. Fragrance character: Woody, fresh and spicy Top note: A composition of violet leaf, aquatic notes and cardamom. Heart note: A striking woody accord of vetiver, cedarwood and silver fir. Base note: Warm notes of musk, patchouli and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Green Wood Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Green Wood Eau de Toilette Spray by Dsquared2 is a composition based on the interplay of fresh, spicy and woody notes. It opens with an energetic combination of tangy lemon and spicy bourbon pepper, accompanied by the aromatic plant santolina. In the heart note, the intense character of the fragrance unfolds through earthy vetiver, striking cedarwood and warm resins. This woody depth is rounded off in the base by a blend of ambroxan, cypriol and musk, which ensures a long-lasting and expressive finish. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, green glass bottle with a wooden cap that emphasises the natural aesthetic of the creation. Green Wood is a modern yet timeless everyday companion that leaves a confident signature. Product type: Eau de Toilette Spray Fragrance direction: Woody and spicy Character: Fresh, intense and close to nature Special feature: Elegant bottle with wooden cap

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 ICON Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The ICON Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray by Dsquared2 is a multi-layered, floral-fruity composition that exudes elegance and modernity. The fragrance opens with a sparkling top note of Italian mandarin, lemon and pear, which is given a lively freshness by blackcurrant and a hint of pink pepper. At the heart of the creation, a feminine bouquet of jasmine unfolds, which is given an appealing sweetness by a fine praline note without dominating. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm and sensual base note. This is where sandalwood, soft musk and sweet vanilla meet the special woody notes of Akigalawood and ash wood, which lend the perfume a long-lasting depth. The result is a multi-faceted fragrance that emphasises a self-confident yet graceful aura. Fragrance direction: Floral-fruity Top notes: Italian mandarin, lemon, pear, pink pepper Heart note: jasmine, praline Base notes: sandalwood, musk, vanilla, acigalawood

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Red Wood Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Red Wood Eau de Toilette Spray by Dsquared2 was created in 2019 and is a fruity and woody fragrance for women. It is not just the bright red colour of the bottle that makes the fragrance stand out. After all, the eau de toilette spray has top notes of cranberry and pink pepper. The heart note mixes roses and magnolias with lychees, while the base consists of musk, amberwood and cedarwood. Red Wood by Dsquared2 has above-average longevity and sillage, which is particularly suited to all women who like sweet fragrances. Wood can be so sexy With a name like Red Wood, you would naturally expect an eau de toilette spray with woody aromas. But the fragrance from Dsquared2 goes beyond that. Because the wood is the centrepiece of the fragrance. At the same time, however, the perfumers have succeeded in creating a fantastically feminine eau de toilette spray. The women's fragrance is sweet in a grown-up way. It is sexy , it is confident and suits many different occasions, both during the day and in the evening. Dsquared2 scores particularly well with this fragrance in the cool and cold season. If you like woods, you have to try Red Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 2 Wood Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: A fascinating unisex fragrance from the lifestyle label Dsquared2 from Canada: 2 Wood is a lively and vitalising fragrance for men and women. This is ensured by fresh notes of lemon, lemon and pepper in the top note. They combine with woody, energising aromas of fir, cedar and vetiver in the heart note. In combination with the elegant bottle, the eau de toilette spray is an expression of minimalism, clarity and character - a statement that characterises the Canadian label. The unisex fragrances from the world-famous fragrance manufacturer are for men and women who prioritise quality and sustainable luxury. The eau de toilette spray 2 Wood is an elegant and understated unisex fragrance from Dsquared2. The fragrance is full of character and suits every occasion. The fragrance appeals to all the senses and is an olfactory experience in a class of its own. This unisex fragrance inspires our imagination. It is reminiscent of the fantastic nature of Canada with its endless forests and deep blue waters. The eau de toilette spray from Dsquared2 is for modern trendsetters in the urban jungle. Just a few spritzes are enough to be inspired by this harmonious fragrance potpourri.

listings.description: Escada Yum Me! Coco Body & Hair Perfume Mist offers a simple way to add a light fragrance to your everyday life. Thanks to its fine mist, the spray can be applied effortlessly and evenly to the body and hair. It offers a quick refresh that can be seamlessly integrated into your daily morning routine without weighing down the hair. listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY GENTLEMAN GIVENCHY Eau de Parfum Spray Réserve Privée 60 ml
listings.description: The Gentleman Givenchy Réserve Privée Eau de Parfum Spray unfolds a fascinating duality, inspired by the world of exquisite spirits and high perfume art. This woody-floral amber composition is characterised by an unusual ingredient: an absolute of whisky extracted in Grasse from the barley of a Scottish distillery. In the top note, this warm, characteristic aroma meets the freshness of Italian bergamot. This is followed by a heart note that combines the powdery elegance of iris with the sweetness of chestnut and balsamic benzoin resin. The base of Virginia cedarwood, Haitian vetiver and Indonesian patchouli lends the fragrance a long-lasting, earthy depth. The result is a harmonious and intense composition that impresses with its sophistication and expressive character. Fragrance family: woody-floral-amber Speciality: Contains an exclusive absolute of whisky Character: Intense and harmonious Fragrance notes: Iris, chestnut and cedar wood

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Parfum Spray Scandal Elixir 30 ml
listings.description: The Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Elixir Parfum Spray presents itself as an intense reinterpretation of the well-known Scandal line and focuses on a fragrance composition rich in contrasts. At the centre of this olfactory experience is a striking top note of black cherry, which lends a fruity depth to the opening. This first impression is accompanied by a powerful heart of patchouli, which can provide an earthy yet elegant structure. The base note rounds off the fragrance profile with the warmth of tonka bean, creating a long-lasting and multi-faceted presence on the skin. Visually, the bottle reflects the intensity of the contents: the glass has a colour gradient from brown to transparent and features vertical indentations that give the design a special feel. A golden label with the characteristic lettering and a matching cap complete the aesthetic overall look of this perfume concentration, which is manufactured in Spain. Fragrance: Intense and contrasting with fruity and warm accents Head note: Black cherry. Heart note: Patchouli. Base note: Tonka bean. Flacon: Multifaceted glass design with colour gradient and golden details.

listings.rawTitle: Jil Sander Sunset Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the sensual world of Jil Sander with the Sunset Eau de Parfum Spray Intense. This exquisite fragrance is more than just a perfume - it is an ode to the magic of sunset. The top note opens with tangy lemon and spicy pink pepper, bringing an unmistakable fresh breeze to your day. It immediately gives way to a floral heart note of jasmine and rose. These floral nuances are reminiscent of a romantic stroll through a garden in bloom, while the sunset bathes the sky in warm colours. Magical fragrance for women by Jil Sander But the real centrepiece of Sunset Eau de Parfum Spray Intense is revealed in the base note. Here, sensual accents of amber and vanilla unfold, embedded in the warm aroma of sandalwood. This fine fragrance experience, reminiscent of an exotic journey, will take your breath away. Whether you are preparing for a special occasion or simply want to enhance your everyday life, this sunset fragrance is a must-have. The Eau de Parfum Spray Intense represents the modern woman who is both delicate and strong, who has the ability to transform every moment of her life into something special. The flacon reflects the elegance and class of Jil Sander. With a minimalist design, but with a striking colour scheme and golden lettering, similar to the colours of a breathtaking sunset, it radiates a modern aesthetic.

listings.rawTitle: Cacharel Yes I Am Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Yes I Am Eau de Parfum Spray by Cacharel is a multi-faceted composition that expresses self-confidence and modern femininity. This spicy-floral fragrance opens with a sparkling top note of fruity raspberry and invigorating mandarin peel, which creates a lively and playful opening. At the heart of the creation, a multi-layered bouquet of white gardenia and jasmine unfolds, which is given a fascinating depth by the subtle sharpness of ginger blossom and the warmth of amber. The base rounds off the fragrance experience with an extraordinary creamy, spicy accord in which notes of warm milk meet fine sandalwood and aromatic cardamom. This harmonious combination of sweet, spicy and floral elements gives the fragrance its long-lasting and intense character. The eau de parfum is presented in an iconic bottle, the design of which is reminiscent of a lipstick and visually emphasises the sensual radiance of the fragrance. Spicy-floral fragrance composition with fruity-creamy accents. Combines notes of raspberry, ginger blossom, warm milk and cardamom. Striking bottle in the design of a classic lipstick. Long-lasting fragrance with an intense presence.

listings.rawTitle: Cacharel Eden Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Cacharel Eden Eau de Parfum Spray is a timeless composition that has been inspiring since its creation in 1994 by perfumer Jean Guichard. The fragrance belongs to the family of floral-fruity perfumes and unfolds a multi-layered presence. It opens with a refreshing and sparkling top note of mandarin, bergamot and lemon, which is complemented by fruity nuances of peach. The heart of the composition reveals an opulent floral bouquet in which delicate water lily, lotus, lily of the valley and jasmine combine to create a feminine accord. The base note ensures a long-lasting and harmonious finish. This is where warm and sensual components such as sandalwood, patchouli, tonka bean and cedarwood come together and give the fragrance its depth. Eden presents itself as a lively and elegant fragrance that is suitable for a variety of occasions and is available in a stylish spray bottle. listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Ralph's Club Eau de Parfum Spray by Ralph Lauren is a composition that exudes self-confidence and understated elegance. This men's fragrance, created by perfumer Dominique Ropion, opens with an aromatic freshness of lavandin and clary sage, which is subtly complemented by a fine note of cardamom. At the heart of the creation, the striking warmth of Virginia cedarwood unfolds, harmoniously interacting with rose geranium absolute and echoing the lavender and sage notes. The matt black bottle with copper-coloured accents and the iconic monogram on the hinged lid reflects the sophisticated character of the fragrance. A woody, spicy men's fragrance with an elegant appeal. Composition with notes of lavender, Virginia cedarwood and vetiver. Versatile for everyday wear and special occasions. listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Vanilla Eau de Toilette Spray 25 ml
listings.description: The Vanilla Eau de Toilette Spray by Alyssa Ashley is a harmonious composition that combines fresh accents with warm nuances. Since 1990, this fragrance has stood for an unmistakable combination of effervescence and gentle sweetness. The top note opens the olfactory experience with invigorating accords of bergamot and lemon, which provide a clear and bright prelude. A floral bouquet then unfolds at the heart of the creation, in which jasmine plays a central role and creates an elegant transition. The arrangement is supported by a dominant base note of vanilla, which gives the eau de toilette its characteristic, creamy and soft character. Subtle hints of caramel or musk can also be detected, emphasising the depth of the fragrance. The brand has also opted for a classic design: a rectangular glass bottle provides a clear view of the yellow-coloured liquid inside. A beige-coloured, shiny cap and the striking yellow label with the curved red lettering "Vanilla" complete the look. The balanced blend of ingredients makes the spray suitable for daily use and is gentle on the skin. Classic fragrance with a dominant, creamy vanilla note Fresh opening with citrus accords such as bergamot and lemon Floral heart with jasmine and a warm base Rectangular glass bottle with beige-coloured shiny cap Established composition for everyday use since 1990

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Vanilla Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Since 1968, the Alyssa Ashley label has been known for capturing the classic fragrances of the flower power generation in original recipes and new fragrance formulas in flacons. Musk, patchouli and vanilla, among others, inspire the "créateurs de parfum" behind the label to constantly create new fragrances. Sensual, sweet, elegant: perfumes with a strong vanilla note are a timeless, enduring trend for women and increasingly for men. For more than 100 years, these sweet fragrances have found a place on the shelves of the most exclusive perfumeries. With the unisex fragrance Vanilla , Alyssa Ashley enriched the long line of successful vanilla fragrance creations in 1990 with her own new interpretation on the theme of vanilla. Vanilla by Alyssa Ashley - an uncompromising fragrance The top note opens with the invigorating tropical fruits bergamot and lemon. This tart, tangy opening ensures that the eau de parfum spray does not lose itself in an excess of sweetness later on. The floral heart note is characterised by the intense yet delicate aroma of jasmine blossom. Deep and powdery, the base note is grounding with vanilla essences. The result is an irresistible eau de parfum spray for lovers of sweet fragrances. If you want to wrap yourself in vanilla from head to toe, you will find numerous care products from the same fragrance line here.

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Essence De Patchouli Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Essence De Patchouli by Alyssa Ashley gets to the point The Essence De Patchouli eau de parfum spray draws attention to itself with an unusual combination . The perfume captivates with its simple top and heart notes, which consist solely of geranium, roses and iris roots. It becomes opulent and interesting in the base, which, in keeping with the name, naturally consists primarily of patchouli. The eau de parfum spray also features vanilla and musk, coumarin and French labdanum as well as guaiac wood and Virginia cedar. The result is a long-lasting, very sensual and warm perfume that is simply perfect for all women who embrace and know how to deal with their sensual femininity. With Essence De Patchouli, Alyssa Ashley celebrates femininity, the beauty that women stand for and the strength that is inherent in every woman. The aromatic, sensual fragrance has been around since 2009 and you should definitely give it a try if you like warm fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Ambre Gris Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Since its launch in 2002, Ambre Gris Eau de Parfum Spray by Alyssa Ashley has been synonymous with a multi-faceted and profound fragrance signature. The composition combines fresh, citrusy elements with warm, ambery accords to create a harmonious overall picture. The olfactory experience opens with a sparkling top note in which Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian lemon meet, lending a certain lightness to the opening. This is followed by a floral heart, which is characterised by the fine aromas of Bulgarian rose, Indian jasmine and orange blossom. The complex base note, which combines precious ambergris, sandalwood and Madagascar vanilla with Virginia cedarwood and musk, ensures a long-lasting and sensual finish. This blend lends the fragrance a timeless elegance that can unfold regardless of the season. The design of the bottle also reflects the classic claim: a rectangular clear glass container reveals the light-coloured liquid and is crowned by a black label with gold lettering and a shiny, gold cap. The intertwined symbol embossed on the front rounds off the visual appearance and emphasises the brand's identity. Combination of fresh citrus notes and warm amber accords Contains high-quality essences such as Bulgarian rose and Madagascar vanilla Classic clear glass bottle with elegant gold and black accents Timeless fragrance composition that is suitable for every season

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley White Musk Eau de Toilette Spray 25 ml
listings.description: The White Musk Eau de Toilette Spray by Alyssa Ashley is a fragrance composition that combines timeless elegance with a clear structure. Known for its sophisticated interpretation of the musk theme, this fragrance uses synthetic components to create a pure and soft aroma that does not contain any animal ingredients. The olfactory prelude is a fresh top note in which sparkling bergamot blends with the spicy accents of tarragon. This is followed by a complex heart note that unfolds a lush floral bouquet. Here, nuances of jasmine, rose and ylang-ylang meet the floral accords of lilac and geranium, giving the perfume a multi-layered floral depth. The base note is dominated by the eponymous musk, which is complemented by earthy patchouli tones and ensures a warm, long-lasting finish. The bottle reflects this straightforwardness and is made of transparent glass in a classic, rectangular shape. A gold-coloured cap crowns the design, while the white lettering "WHITE MUSK ALYSSA ASHLEY" together with the characteristic symbol on the front adds a visual accent. Fragrance: A combination of floral notes and pure musk. Head note: Fresh bergamot and spicy tarragon. Heart note: A bouquet of jasmine, rose, ylang-ylang, lilac and geranium. Base note: Warm musk and earthy patchouli. Design: Rectangular glass bottle with gold-coloured cap and white lettering.

listings.rawTitle: Armani My Way Eau de Parfum Spray - Refillable 30 ml
listings.description: My Way by Giorgio Armani is a luminous, floral fragrance composition inspired by discoveries and meaningful encounters. The fragrance opens with a sparkling top note of Calabrian bergamot and Egyptian orange blossom, which provides a fresh start. A radiant bouquet of Indian tuberose and jasmine unfolds in the heart, giving the eau de parfum its characteristic expression. The base note of warm cedarwood, creamy vanilla from Madagascar and soft white musk leaves a lasting impression. The bottle itself is an elegant piece of jewellery whose blue and gold cap represents a talisman and symbolises solidarity. In the spirit of sustainability, the bottle can be refilled easily and drip-free thanks to an innovative system. A luminous floral fragrance with notes of orange blossom, tuberose and vanilla. Refillable bottle to help conserve resources. Elegant design with a symbolic blue and gold cap. Innovative and clean refill system for use at home.

The composition opens with the sparkling note of lime primofiore. The transparent elegance of Sambac jasmine unfolds in the heart, complemented by subtle accents of sweet peony that lend a gentle sensuality. The base of warm cedar wood provides a subtle depth and harmoniously rounds off the fragrance experience. The design of the bottle picks up on the theme of nature: its curved shape is reminiscent of a drop of water, while the mint green colour and emerald-like cap emphasise the aquatic element. Acqua di Gioia is a tribute to optimism and a connection with nature. Floral-aquatic fragrance by Giorgio Armani Composition of lime, Sambac jasmine and cedar wood Embodies freshness, lightness and naturalness Flacon in the design of a drop of water

listings.rawTitle: Armani Code Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Armani Code Femme Eau de Parfum Spray by Giorgio Armani is a composition full of warmth and sensuality. It opens with an invigorating combination of jasmine, sweet orange and a subtle accent of bitter orange. The full splendour of orange blossom unfolds at the heart of the creation, which, together with more jasmine and a surprising note of ginger, creates a fascinating depth. The fragrance experience is rounded off and anchored by a base of soft honey, creamy vanilla and fine sandalwood. As a fragrance from the floral family, this eau de parfum unfolds its character particularly well on cooler days in autumn and winter as well as on special occasions in the evening. Fragrance family: Floral Character: Warm and sensual Fragrance notes: Orange, jasmine, ginger, honey, vanilla Occasion: Ideal for the evening and the cool season

listings.rawTitle: Armani Si Eau de Parfum Spray - Refillable 30 ml
listings.description: The Si Eau de Parfum by Giorgio Armani is a tribute to modern femininity. This chypre fragrance cleverly combines fruity, floral and woody notes to create a harmonious composition. It opens with an interplay of blackcurrant and mandarin, which leads into a floral heart of rose, freesia and osmanthus. The base note provides a warm and long-lasting depth, in which chords of musk, vanilla and patchouli unfold. The eau de parfum comes in a purist and timelessly elegant bottle that reflects the style of the brand. Thanks to the refillable design, the product emphasises a conscious use of resources. Elegant chypre fragrance with fruity-floral notes Composition of blackcurrant, rose and vanilla Refillable bottle for more sustainable consumption Intense and sophisticated fragrance experience

listings.rawTitle: Armani Emporio Armani You Eau de Parfum Spray Stronger With You Powerfully 50 ml
listings.description: The Emporio Armani You Eau de Parfum Spray Stronger With You Powerfully expands the Italian fashion house's popular fragrance collection with an intense and characterful composition. This men's fragrance presents itself as a powerful interpretation of the classic fougère structure, enriched with warm amber accents. The opening surprises with a dynamic interplay of fresh mandarin and bergamot, which meet the spicy sharpness of black pepper. An aromatic depth unfolds in the heart, characterised by diva lavender and a striking accord of spices such as saffron, cinnamon and clove. These spicy facets are subtly rounded off by fruity nuances of apricot or cherry. The base note provides a long-lasting and warm finish, combining sweet vanilla and bourbon vanilla with the characteristic aroma of candied and roasted chestnut. Amberwood and leather lend the base an additional masculine structure. The rectangular glass bottle with its rounded corners and metallic cap visually emphasises the robustness of the fragrance. Fragrance family: Ambery fougère with spicy and warm accents. Top notes: Fresh citrus notes of mandarin and bergamot combined with black pepper. Heart note: Aromatic lavender meets spices such as saffron and cinnamon. Base note: Warm vanilla accords combined with roasted chestnut and amberwood. Design: Striking glass bottle with metallic cap and dark-coloured liquid.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Code Homme Parfum- refillable 30 ml
listings.description: The Armani Code Homme fragrance by Giorgio Armani is a woody, aromatic composition that impresses with its multi-faceted structure and long-lasting character. It opens with an invigorating freshness of green mandarin and bergamot, which leads into a spicy heart of nutmeg essence, sage and iris. The base note provides a warm and sensual depth, combining tonka bean absolute with nuances of vanilla and cedarwood. The result is a fragrance with a harmonious yet dynamic expression. The perfume is bottled in an elegantly designed bottle that can be easily refilled thanks to its innovative system, which emphasises the sustainable concept behind the creation. A woody, aromatic fragrance with a sensual depth. Long-lasting fragrance full of character. Composition of fresh, spicy and warm notes. Presented in an elegant and refillable bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Emporio Armani You Eau de Toilette Spray Stronger With You 50 ml
listings.description: The Emporio Armani Stronger With You Eau de Toilette Spray is an aromatic fragrance inspired by the vibrant energy and self-confident lifestyle of modern metropolises. For optimal development of the facets, spraying on warm skin areas such as the neck or wrists is recommended. listings.rawTitle: Armani Acqua di Giò Homme Parfum- refillable 30 ml
listings.description: Armani Acqua di Giò Homme Parfum captures the infinite expanse and powerful freshness of the sea in an intense fragrance for men. The composition opens with sparkling bergamot from Calabria and aquatic marine notes reminiscent of an invigorating coastal breeze. At the heart, an aromatic bouquet of geranium, lavender and sustainably sourced clary sage unfolds, lending the fragrance a modern depth. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a base of Guatemalan patchouli and vetiver, which provide a woody and masculine signature. This fragrance experience is presented in an elegant bottle with a design that reflects the timeless aesthetics of Giorgio Armani with a black gradient lacquer effect and a magnetic cap. In the spirit of more conscious consumption, the bottle is refillable. Fragrance direction: Aromatic, woody and aquatic . Fragrance notes: A composition of marine notes, lavender and patchouli. Fragrance intensity: An intense eau de parfum with a long-lasting character. Special feature: Refillable bottle to reduce packaging material.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Emporio Armani You Parfum Spray Absolutely 50 ml
listings.description: Stronger With You Absolutely by Emporio Armani is a composition with an intense and sensual presence. The fragrance opens with a striking rum accord, which is given a special facet by tangy bergamot and resinous elemi resin. Aromatic diva lavender from the south of France unfolds in the heart note, combined with essential davana oil. The base gives the perfume its depth and long-lasting character through a combination of Madagascan vanilla, an accord of glazed chestnut, smoky cedarwood and warm patchouli. As part of the fougère fragrance family, the perfume is characterised by ambery and spicy accents that create a warm, gourmand aura. The bottle has a sophisticated design to match the fragrance: the simple glass casing displays the rum-coloured liquid, while a smoky lacquer finish on the base of the bottle visually emphasises the intensity of the composition. An intense men's fragrance with a sensual aura Fragrance family: Fougère with ambery and spicy notes Main notes: Rum accord, diva lavender, vanilla and glazed chestnut Warm and gourmand character

listings.rawTitle: Armani Acqua di Giò Homme Eau de Parfum Spray - refillable Profondo 30 ml
listings.description: Acqua di Giò Profondo by Armani is an intense interpretation of the classic maritime fragrance that explores a new depth. The aromatic-aquatic fougère composition opens with the sparkling freshness of green mandarin and bergamot, accompanied by clear marine notes. An aromatic bouquet of rosemary, lavender and cypress unfolds in the heart, giving the fragrance a distinctive facet. The base note anchors the olfactory experience with woody nuances of patchouli and cedarwood, which are given a modern signature by mineral ambergris and a hint of musk. The deep blue bottle with its silver-grey accents is reminiscent of the unfathomable vastness of the ocean. As an eau de parfum, this fragrance is also designed to be refillable. The spray head can be removed so that the bottle can be easily refilled with the separately available refill bottle. An aromatic fougère fragrance with an aquatic character . Composition of green mandarin, rosemary and mineral amber. The bottle of the eau de parfum is refillable. Modern interpretation with a deep, woody-maritime signature.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Emporio Armani Eau de Parfum Spray Emporio She 50 ml
listings.description: The Emporio Armani She Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition that captivates with its soft and feminine aura. It opens with a fruity combination of mandarin and pear, which blends harmoniously into a floral heart note of delicate jasmine and heliotrope. At the centre of the fragrance is a soft vanilla essence, which is accompanied by an accord of angelica and creates a subtle, warm presence. The fragrance character is deliberately unobtrusive and remains pleasantly close to the skin, making it a suitable companion for everyday wear, especially during the cooler seasons such as autumn and winter. To optimise the bouquet, we recommend spraying the fragrance onto warm areas of skin, such as the inside of the wrists, from a distance of around 20 cm. Bottled in a simple yet sophisticated bottle, the design emphasises the subtle elegance of the fragrance creation. Fragrance character: Gentle, feminine and warm Fragrance notes: A composition of vanilla, jasmine, mandarin and pear Occasion: An ideal companion for everyday wear and the cooler seasons Presentation: Bottled in a timelessly elegant bottle

listings.rawTitle: Armani I WILL Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani I Will Eau de Parfum Spray is a striking fragrance composition featuring woody and amber-like notes. Its intense concentration as an Eau de Parfum ensures a long-lasting fragrance experience that reliably accompanies the wearer throughout the day. Warm, woody accords blend with gentle amber nuances to create a distinctive aura that is particularly well-suited to evening occasions or important business meetings. Just a few sprays on the pulse points are enough to leave an expressive fragrance signature. The combination of earthy and warm elements lends the fragrance a pleasant depth that is neither overpowering nor fleeting. The simple, elegant bottle holds 100 millilitres and sits comfortably in the hand when spraying. The fine atomiser distributes the liquid evenly over the skin or clothing, allowing the individual components of the fragrance to unfold to their full potential. Fragrance character: Woody and amber-like notes create a warm, distinctive aura. Long-lasting: The Eau de Parfum concentration provides reliable companionship throughout the day. Easy to use: A fine atomiser ensures the fragrance is distributed evenly. Generous size: The bottle contains 100 ml for regular everyday use.

listings.rawTitle: Armani My Way Eau de Parfum Spray Sunny Vanilla 30 ml
listings.description: The composition of Giorgio Armani My Way Eau de Parfum Spray Sunny Vanilla presents itself as a radiant interpretation of the well-known My Way collection. This fragrance, which was launched in 2025, combines fruity accents with a floral depth and gourmand nuances. It opens with a tangy combination of bergamot and pineapple, which can provide immediate freshness. At the heart, an opulent bouquet of tuberose and a special jasmine grandiflorum superinfusion unfolds, emphasising the floral signature of the line. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a warm base of vanilla infusion and a creamy musk accord. Particularly noteworthy is the origin of the vanilla used, which comes from the Sava region in Madagascar and is part of a sustainable sourcing programme. The jasmine is also obtained in a natural and sustainable way. Visually, the bottle reflects the elegance of the contents: a transparent glass container reveals the delicate pink-coloured liquid, while the striking golden cap with its organic shape adds a sophisticated accent. Blue lettering on the glass echoes the classic aesthetic of the brand. Fruity-floral gourmand fragrance with notes of pineapple and bergamot Heart notes of tuberose and jasmine grandiflorum superinfusion Warm base with vanilla from Madagascar and creamy musk Use of sustainably sourced ingredients Elegant bottle with organically shaped, golden cap

listings.description: My Way Ylang Eau de Parfum Spray by Giorgio Armani expands the well-known fragrance collection with a bright, fruity-floral composition. Carefully selected ingredients are used for this fragrance, such as ylang-ylang essence, which is sustainably sourced in Madagascar. listings.rawTitle: Armani Acqua di Giò Homme Eau de Parfum Spray - refillable 50 ml
listings.description: Acqua di Giò Eau de Parfum by Giorgio Armani presents itself as a modern interpretation of the iconic fragrance classic, combining maritime freshness with a new, aromatic depth. The composition opens with an invigorating top note of sparkling green mandarin and clear aquatic notes that immediately evoke the vastness of the sea. At the heart of the creation, an aromatic interplay of sage, lavandin and geranium unfolds, lending the fragrance an elegant yet tart facet. This commitment is underpinned by the selection of sustainably sourced ingredients and CO2-neutral production. A fresh, maritime composition with an aromatic, woody depth. listings.rawTitle: Jean-Charles Brosseau Ombre Rose Eau de Toilette Spray L'Original 30 ml
listings.description: Ombre Rose L'Original by Jean-Charles Brosseau is a classic fragrance that has captivated with its timeless elegance since its launch in 1981. Created by perfumer Françoise Caron, the composition unfolds as a subtle, floral-powdery experience. The opening is characterised by a blend of aldehydes, rosewood, peach and geranium. The heart of the fragrance combines a rich floral bouquet of rose, ylang-ylang, violet and lily of the valley with the characteristic note of orris root. Sandalwood and cedarwood add a soft, woody facet. The base anchors the composition with the warmth of musk, tonka bean, honey and a hint of vanilla, giving the eau de toilette a sophisticated character. With its moderate fragrance intensity, it is a suitable companion for the day at any time of year. listings.rawTitle: Isabey Paris Gardénia Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: The Gardénia Eau de Parfum Spray by Isabey Paris enchants with its powdery, woody bouquet that is refreshed by tangerine. Romantic, creamy fragrance for women with ylang-ylang In 1924, Maurice Loewe opened his perfume house Isabey in Paris, whose fragrances were soon celebrated in Parisian society and received many awards. In 1941, at the beginning of the Second World War, the house had to close, but was revived in 2006 by the perfume company Panouge. The brand produces the original fragrances according to a slightly modernised recipe, bringing perfumes to the market that are reminiscent of the 1920s and have lost none of their seductive appeal . Gardénia Eau de Parfum Spray by Isabey Paris is a romantic fragrance for women that has been available since 2006. When sprayed on, it releases the refreshing notes of tangerine and African orange blossom , which are given an enchanting powdery accent by ylang-ylang. In the heart note, the floral tones of gardenia, rose, jasmine and iris come together and then flow into a warm base consisting of musk, sandalwood and ambergris.

listings.rawTitle: Masakï Matsushïma Matsu Sunshine Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: A bright yellow colour not only dominates the look, but also reflects the olfactory character of the Masakï Matsushïma Matsu Sunshine Eau de Parfum spray. This creation by the Japanese designer combines Asian minimalism with the French art of perfumery and aims to create a sunny, positive aura. The opening is already full of energy with sparkling notes of lemon that meet the gentle sweetness of fig and herbaceous davana. This is followed by a pronounced floral heart that decisively characterises the composition and lends it a soft note. Chords of exotic frangipani, jasmine, yellow freesia and ylang-ylang combine to create a harmonious melody. To give the fragrance the necessary depth, the base is characterised by warmer, woody nuances such as sandalwood, musk and ambroxan, which form a gentle contrast to the initial freshness. The design of the bottle also consistently picks up on this theme: The curved, semi-circular shape in rich yellow is visually reminiscent of the sun and sits comfortably in the hand thanks to the integrated side handle. It is a fruity-floral fragrance that can be worn in a variety of ways. listings.description: The Zadig Eau de Parfum Spray by Zadig & Voltaire is a woody-floral fragrance that captures the essence of an independent and strong personality. The composition opens with an extraordinary top note of a posidonia accord, black and white sesame and a light ginger spiciness. At the heart of the creation, a luminous bouquet of neroli essence and orange blossom unfolds, leading into a warm base. There, sensual, roasted vanilla, a creamy Chantilly accord and fine sandalwood combine to create an unforgettable aura. The fragrance is presented in an eye-catching, wing-shaped bottle with a jewel-like metal finish. The spray head can be unscrewed to refill the bottle. The formula is also vegan-certified and consists of around 89% ingredients of natural origin. Inspired by the iconic ZADIG Eau de Parfum, this more intense interpretation takes the feeling of freedom to a new level. listings.rawTitle: Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Blue Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The First Instinct Blue fragrance for men by Abercrombie & Fitch is a fragrant reminder that the freedom of choice combined with one's own instincts offers truly limitless possibilities in this world. Self-confident men appreciate the freedom and invigorating freshness inherent in this fragrance as an eau de toilette spray. Just as human instincts play a central role in every area of daily life, this eau de toilette spray from Abercrombie & Fitch is equally suitable for work, leisure and evening occasions. The overall fruity and spicy composition of the men's fragrance First Instinct Blue emphasises a masculine appearance in all situations. First Instinct Blue: tried-and-tested fragrance nuances in a refreshing new combination The First Instinct Blue eau de toilette spray for men by Abercrombie & Fitch evokes memories of the familiar with its selection of tried-and-tested fragrance components. However, although this is based on a certain activation of instinct and gut feeling, the fragrance by Abercrombie & Fitch can also inspire with a refreshingly new and invigorating bouquet of scents. In the top note of the fragrance, the refreshing fruitiness of apple is combined with the spicy intensity of cardamom and bergamot. The lavender as the central scent of the heart note is entwined with hints of rosemary and pepper. The eau de toilette spray is rounded off with a classically inspired base note of sandalwood, tonka bean and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Annayake Tomo Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Annayake Tomo Eau de Toilette Spray is a masculine, woody fragrance composition that is characterised by a dynamic and multi-faceted development. The fragrance opens with an invigorating freshness, combining aromatic notes of lavender and rosemary with the brightness of citrus fruits and a hint of cardamom. This initial lightness soon gives way to a warm and intense heart, in which the striking presence of tobacco meets a spicy blend of coriander and sage. This combination gives the fragrance its unmistakable character. Finally, a mysterious and alluring depth unfolds in the base, which lingers on the skin for a long time. Chords of tonka bean, resinous labdanum and black musk, accompanied by soft woody notes such as sandalwood, create a memorable finish. The result is a fragrance with velvety and slightly smoky facets that offers a pleasant presence for everyday wear. A masculine fragrance with a woody, spicy character. J'ose Femme is a play of contrasts that creates an elegant balance between invigorating and profound accords. listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg L'Art du Parfum Eau de Parfum Spray LE PÉCHÉ 50 ml
listings.description: The eau de parfum Le Péché Homme is part of the L'Art du Parfum line from Eisenberg Paris and presents a complex olfactory combination of woody, floral and musky elements. At the beginning, a top note unfolds that is characterised by the presence of osmanthus and subtle nuances of orange blossom and hibiscus. This rather light opening is in deliberate contrast to the further development of the fragrance. At the heart of the creation, jasmine combines with the sweetness of vanilla and transparent amber, giving the composition significantly more depth. Finally, the base note grounds the fragrance experience in powerful, earthy accords. Patchouli and sandalwood merge with vetiver and musk to create a long-lasting finish. Visually, the bottle reflects the clear lines of the brand. The container is square and in a deep black colour, on which the lettering "LE PÉCHÉ" and the brand name stand out in contrasting white capital letters. A transparent spray head with a silver finish and a black cap complete the design of this eau de parfum.
